atha brāhmaṇasya mahāpātakādipatitakarmāṇi bhavanti cedatra sapiṇḍaḥ kiṃ kuryāditi | nindite'hni sāyāhne sapiṇḍāḥ saha tiṣṭhanti catuṣpathe tathā kāryaṃ gomayenopalepanam ninditaṃ caiva śītoṣṇamudakumbhaṃ pratiṣṭhipet asyadāsī tataḥ paścādadbhiḥ kumbhaṃ prapūrayet uttiṣṭhantaḥ sapiṇḍāstamidaṃ vacanamabruvan sambhāṣaṇaṃ ca saṃyānaṃ sabhāśayanameva ca aśanaṃ ca tathā tena na ca kuryāditaḥ param iti vācaṃ visṛjyaiva kuryāt kumbhaṃ pradakṣiṇam tāḍayed vāmapādasya pārṣṇyā tat tasya sannidhau anavekṣamāṇāste sarve gatvā paścād yathoditam prāyaścittaṃ yathāśāstraṃ vividhaṃ cātha cet kṛtam evaṃ pūtastataḥ paścāt snātvā śuddhe jalāśaye puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu praviśecca catuṣpatham gomayenopalipyātha navakumbhaṃ pratiṣṭhipet dāserādbhiḥ prapūryātha sapiṇḍān paryupāsayet svastivākyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kumbhaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam udaṃ pītvātha kumbhasthaṃ svagehaṃ tu pravekṣayet brāhmaṇān bhojayitvātha sapiṇḍaiḥ saha bhojayet evaṃ hi śuddhātmānaṃ pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahā asya kulavṛddhāścāśiṣo vācayitvā ata ūrdhvaṃ sarvān kāmān sa hi kuryāditi kuryāditi ||7||
atha śubhāśubhanimittānāṃ vāyasānāṃ balividhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | grāmāt prācīmudīcīṃ diśamupaniṣkramya gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya prokṣya lakṣaṇamullikhyādbhiravokṣya pradakṣiṇaṃ vāyasānāmāsanaṃ kalpayati | aṅkatebhyaḥ kalpayāmi | kaṅkatebhyaḥ kalpayāmi | kadruputrebhyaḥ kalpayāmi | vāsebhyaḥ kalpayāmi | brahmaputrebhyaḥ kalplayāmi | athaitānāvāhayati | na kapilān na kokilān nāriṣṭān na mahāriṣṭān vāyasamātrakān | āyāntu śakunāḥ śīghraṃ vāyasā balibhojinaḥ | aṅkatānāmāhayāmi | kaṅkatānāvāhayāmi | kadruputrānāvāhayāmi | vāyasānāvāhayāmi | brahmaputrānāvāhayāmi ityāvāhya āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena mārjayitvā amuṣmai namo'muṣmai nama iti gandhapuṣyadhūpadīpairabhyarcya amuṣmai svāhāmuṣmai svāhā iti pāyasodanena piṇḍaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ dadyāt | amuṣmai namo'muṣmai nama ityupasthāya satyāḥ stha satyaṃ vadata satye ramata vāyasāḥ tatsatyamiha no brūyānna mithyābalimaśnīyāt ityāha athainaṃ mātṛghātena pitṛghātena vā punaḥ tad duṣkṛtaṃ pratigṛhṇīyād yo mithyābalimaśnīyāt kapilānāṃ śataṃ hutvā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ duṣkṛtaṃ pratigṛhṇīyād yo mithyābalimaśnīyāt iti brūyāt bhāvāya pūrvaṃ gṛhṇīyādabhāvāya tu dakṣīṇam nāstītyaparaṃ caiva bhaviṣyatyapi vottaram madhye sarvārthalābhāya ityāha | evaṃ jñātvā sarvakarmāṇyārabhet sarvakarmāṇyārabhediti ||8||
atha yajñopavītavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | āpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre brāhmaṇakanyā brāhmaṇavidhavā vā suprakṣālitapāṇipādā śuciḥ śuklamanārdramācchādya yatra kārpāsastiṣṭhati tatra gatvā pakaphalaṃ parigṛhya gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya tanmadhye yantraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prāṅmukhī udaṅmukhī vā upaviśya uparyupari tantuṃ tatya na kadācana nīcaṃ karoti | brāhmaṇāya dadāti | atha brāhmaṇo hiraṇyena parikrīya vā dhānyena vā dhanena vā suprakṣālitapāṇipāda apa ācamya pavitrapāṇiḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vopaviśya dakṣiṇahastāṅgulībhiḥ śliṣṭābhiḥ ṣaḍadhikena navatyā parigaṇya triguṇīkṛtamathādbhirmārjayati āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena | brāhmaṇānāhūya prāgekaḥ sthitvā pratyag dvau sthitvā dakṣiṇahastaṃ parivrājena bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ iti sūtraṃ kṛtvā triguṇīkṛtya yājñike vṛkṣe visṛjati | tṛṇena tāḍayati | hastena hastaṃ sūtramādāya jānubhyāṃ pariveṣṭayati bhūragniṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokān saṃvatsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda iti atha dvitīyaṃ bhuvo vāyuṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokān saṃvatsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda iti atha tṛtīyaṃ svarādityaṃ ca divaṃ ca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokān saṃvatsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda iti atha granthiṃ kṛtvā bhūrbhuvaḥsvaścandramasaṃ ca diśaśca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokān saṃvatsaraṃ ca prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda iti | atha yajñopavītī bhavati yajñasyopavītena upavyayāmi dīrghāyuṣṭvāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya sarveṣāṃ vedānāmādhipatyāya śriyai yaśase brahmaṇe brahmavarcasāya iti | ācāntaḥ sarvakarmārho bhavati sarvakarmārho bhavati ||9||
atha devatārādhanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | śuci śuklamanārdramācchādya pavitrapāṇirācāntaḥ sandhyāmupāsyātha kṛtāgnikāryo devamāvāhayet maṇḍale sthaṇḍile vāpsu hṛdi dīpte ca pāvake tathaiva pratimāyāṃ vā harimāvāhya pūjayet hṛdayābhyantare padmaṃ manasā cintayed budhaḥ padmasya karṇikāmadhye tasya jyotirvyavasthitam jyotirmadhye mahāviṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ evaṃ dvādaśanāmabhirāvāhya keśavāyeti candanādi pradīpāntaiḥ pūjayecca tataḥ param maṇḍale ca tathā sarvaṃ sthaṇḍile ca tathaiva ca tathaiva pāvake dīpte harimāvāhya pūjayet atha cet pratimāṃ kurvan svarṇamayena vā lohamayena vā aśaktau śilāmayena vā śaṅkhacakragadādharaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā agāre vā vimāne vā pratiṣṭhāpya āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākenābhiṣekaṃ karoti | atha devamāvāhayāmi iti keśavādināmabhirāvāhya atha vastraṃ pradāya yuvaṃ vastrāṇi iti atha gandhaṃ pradāya gandhadvārām iti atha puṣpaṃ pradāya yo'pāṃ puṣpaṃ veda iti atha dhūpaṃ pradāya dhūrasi iti atha dīpaṃ pradāya uddīpyasva iti taccheṣeṇānulepanaṃ karoti | arhaṇīyamudakam ityathārghyaṃ pādyamudakam iti pādyaṃ dadyād ācamanīyamudakam ityācamanīyam | atha caruṃ śrapayati | āḍhakena āḍhakārdhena vā prasthena vājyena vā payasi śrapayati | athānnaṃ bhavati | pradāya satyaṃ tvarttena pariṣiñcāmi iti ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmi iti pariṣecanaṃ karoti | athānnamabhimṛśya ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtasya iti daśarcena sūktena amṛtopastaraṇamasi iti upastaraṇaṃ karoti | atha prāṇāhutiḥ | prāṇe niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | prāṇāya svāhā iti prāṇāya apāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | apānāya svāhā ityapānāya vyāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | vyānāya svāhā iti vyānāya udāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | udānāya svāhā ityudānāya samāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo mā viśāpradāhāya samānāya svāhā iti samānāya evaṃ pañcavidhāṃ prāṇāhutiṃ karoti | atha devamupasthāya keśavādidvādaśanāmabhiḥ viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pravocam iti japati | athāvaraṇaṃ karoti amṛtāpidhānamasi ityapa ānīya pidhāya yo'pāmāyatanaṃ veda | āyatanavān bhavati ityācamanīyaṃ karoti | atha tāmbūlaṃ pradāya devamudrāsayati | kṣīrārṇave vā merau vā ādityamaṇḍale vā keśavamudvāsya naivedyamapsu nidhāya caturthāśaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadāti ityāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||10||
athāto ravikalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | āyuṣkāmasya vā tejaskāmasya vā yaśaskāmasya vā bhūtikāmasya vā putrakāmasya vā rūpakāmasya vā bhavati | na naktamaśnīyāt mṛcchayaśca maithunavarjam | śuci śuklamanārdramācchādya prayataḥ śucirbhavati | atha śvobhūte ādityavāre āditye'bhyuditamātre gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya madhye svarṇamathavā rajataṃ vā padmaṃ nidhāya athavā bhūmau vilikhedaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam pūrvapatre nyaset sūryamāgneyyāṃ ca divākaram nyasya yāmye vivasvantaṃ nairṛtyāṃ tu bhagaṃ nyaset varuṇaṃ paścime patre vāyavye cendrameva ca savitāramathaiśānyāmādityaṃ cottare nyaset sakarṇikāpūrvapatre nyasedarkaṃ savājinam sahasrāṃśuṃ dakṣiṇe ca mārtāṇḍaṃ paścime diśi uttare tu raviṃ devaṃ tanmadhye bhāskaraṃ nyaset evaṃ dvādaśādityān yathākramaṃ vinyasya madhye sarvādityarūpaṃ vinyasyāthādbhirmārjayate āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena | atha raktacandanena raktapuṣpeṇa raktavarṇa ācāryaḥ amuṣmai namo'muṣmai namaḥ iti gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpairabhyarcya pādmamudakaṃ namaskāraṃ kṛtvā amuṣmai namo'muṣmai nama iti atha daivatānudvāsayati | dvādaśanāmabhiryathā pūrvamāvāhanaṃ karoti tathodvāsanam | gurave yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | evaṃ saṃvatsarasyārkavāreṣu pūjāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā āyuṣkāmī dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt | tejaskāmī tejasvī yaśaskāmī yaśasvī bhūtikāmī bhūtimān bhavati putrakāmī putraṃ labhate | sarvakāmī sarvaṃ labhate | ityāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||11||
praṇavaṃ cāgnidaivatyaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇam chandastu devī gāyatrī ṛṣirbrahmeti kīrtitaḥ praṇavaṃ namaskaromi sarvadevatāmayaṃ śṛṇu viṣṇumabravīditi praṇavaṃ tryakṣareṇa | akārokāramakārākṣareṇa | akāro'gniḥ ukāraḥ sūryaḥ makāraścandraḥ | akāro brahmā ukāro viṣṇuḥ makāra īśvaraḥ | akāro napuṃsakaḥ ukāraḥ pullim̐ṅgaḥ makāraḥ strīliṅgaḥ | akāro miśravarṇaḥ ukāro raktavarṇaḥ makāraḥ śvetavarṇaḥ | upamārahitāḥ aumakārātmakāḥ kālatrayātmakāḥ lokatrayātmakāḥ ṛgyajussāmātmakāḥ avasthātrayātmakāḥ praṇavoccāraṇena mahadaiśvaryadāyakāḥ mūlādhārānāhatabhrūmadhye sthitāḥ akārokāramakārāḥ udāttānudāttasvaritāḥ vakṣyāmy tirahasyamiti | ṛgvede praṇavaṃ yajurvede praṇavaṃ sāmavede praṇavaṃ triḥ brūyāt | tasyottarā bhūyase nirvacanāya ||12||
athaśālāṃkariṣyan vāstoṣpate athataṭākakalpaṃvyākhyāsyāmaḥ athakūśmāṇḍairjuhuyād athātaḥpūtakāmaḥ athaśatābhiṣekam athabrāhmaṇasyamahāpātakādi athaśubhāśubhanimittānām athayajñopavītavidhim athadevatārādhanam athātoravikalpaṃvyākhyāsyāmaḥ praṇavaṃcāgnidaivatyaṃ dvādaśa
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre dvitīyapraśne caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
<2.5 pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ>
athāto grahātithyabalikarmopahārān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ aśraddadhānamahutamajapaṃ tyaktamaṅgalam grahā nayanti suvyaktaṃ puruṣaṃ yamasādanam grahāṇāmugraceṣṭānāṃ nakṣatrapathacāriṇām upahārān pravakṣyāmi śāntyarthaṃ tu yathāvidhi māsi māsyṛtāvṛtāvayane candragrahe sūryagrahe janmanakṣatre viṣuve śubhāśubhe vā tadgrahāṇāmātithyaṃ saṃvatsarādapi prayuñjānaḥ sarvān kāmānavāmotīti | uktamekāgnividhānaṃ kṛtvā bhāskarāṅgārakau raktau śvetau śukraniśākarau somaputragurū caiva tāvubhau pītakau smṛtau kṛṣṇaṃ śanaiścaraṃ vidyād rāhuketū tathaiva ca grahavarṇāni puṣpāṇi prājñastatropakalpayet baliṃ caivopahāraṃ ca gandhamālyaṃ tathaiva ca yathākrameṇopaharet sarveṣāmanupūrvaśaḥ | iti arkasamidhamādityāya pālāśaṃ somāya svādiramaṅgārakāya apāmārgaṃ budhāya aśvatthaṃ bṛhaspataye audumbaraṃ śukrāya śamīṃ śanaiścarāya rāhoḥ dūrvāṃ ketoḥ kuśamiti | madhye vṛttamādityāya āgneyyāṃ caturaśraṃ somāya dakṣiṇe trikoṇamaṅgārakāya īśānyāṃ vāṇākāraṃ budhāya uttare dīrghacaturaśraṃ bṛhaspataye prāk pañcakoṇaṃ śukrāya paścime dhanurākāraṃ śanaiścarāya nirṛtyāṃ śūrpākāraṃ rāhave vāyavyāṃ dhvajākāraṃ ketubhyaḥ | paridhānaprabhṛtyagnimukhāntaṃ kṛtvā pakvājjuhoti | ā satyena agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe eṣāmīśe ityādityāya | āpyāyasva apsu me somo abravīt gaurī mimāya iti somāya | agnirmūrdhā syonā pṛthivi kṣetrasya patinā ityaṅgārakāya | udbudhyasva idaṃ viṣṇuḥ viṣṇo rarāṭamasi iti budhāya | bṛhaspate ati indra marutvaḥ brahma jajñānam iti bṛhaspataye | pra vaḥ śukrāya indrāṇīm indram vo viśvataspari iti śukrāya | śanno devīḥ prajāpate na tvat imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīda iti śanaiścarāya | kayā naścitra ābhuvat ā yaṃ gauḥ yatte devī nirṛtirāvabandha iti rāhave | ketuṃ kṛṇvan brahmā devānāṃ sacitra citraṃ citayantamasmai iti ketave | ghṛtānvaktānāṃ samidhāmaṣṭasahasramaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatiṃ vā pratyṛcaṃ haviṣā juhuyāt | pratyṛcamājyena juhuyāt | haviṣyānnamādityāya ghṛtapāyasaṃ somāya gulaudanamaṅgārakāya kṣīraudanaṃ budhāya dadhyodanaṃ bṛhaspataye ghṛtaudanaṃ śukrāya tilamiśrapiṣṭamāṣaudanaṃ śanaiścarāya rāhormāsaudanaṃ ketościtraudanam ityupahāraḥ sarveṣāmalābhe haviṣyam | aryamaṇaṃ somaṃ rājānam iti sviṣṭakṛtaṃ juhoti | jayāprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | agreṇāgniṃ grahānabhyarcayati | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena mārjayitvā svena svena mantreṇa gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpairabhyarcya balimupahṛtya namaskṛtya pravāhya jaghanenāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśya adbhirmārjayate āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva ityādibhiḥ | atha dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti | kapilāṃ dhenumādityāya śaṅkhaṃ somāya raktamanaḍvāhamaṅgārakāya kāñcanaṃ budhāya vāso bṛhaspataye rajataṃ śukrāya kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ śanaiścarāya rāhośchāgaṃ ketoḥ kuñjaramiti | sarveṣāmalābhe hiraṇyaṃ vā yena vā tuṣyatyācāryaḥ yathā samutthitaṃ yantraṃ yantreṇa pratihanyate evaṃ samutthitaṃ ghoraṃ śīghraṃ śāntiṃ nayet sadā yathā śastraprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ bhavati vāraṇam evaṃ daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam ahiṃsakāsya dāntasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca nityaṃ ca niyamasthasya sadā sānugrahā grahāḥ grahā gāvo narendrāśca brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ pūjitāḥ pūjayantyete nirdahantyavamānitāḥ devatā graharūpeṇa darśayanti śubhāśubham darśayanti śubhāśubhamiti ||1||
atha yadyakāle sthūṇā virohet va kapoto vāgāramadhye'dhipated gaurvā gāṃ dhayet gaurātmānaṃ pratyaṅ dhayet anaḍvānvā samullikhet anagnau vā dhūmo jāyeta anagnau vā dīpyeta madhu vā jāyeta niryāsaṃ vopajāyeta chatrākaṃ vopajāyeta maṇḍūko vā bhūmau dadṛśe śvānaḥ prasūte vā gṛhapatiṃ jāyāṃ vopatapati anyeṣu cādbhutotpāteṣu | atha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā juhoti vāstoṣpate iti dve | vāstoṣpate śaṃ naḥ indrāgnī kayā naścitra ā bhuvat ko adya yuṅkte bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau iti | sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | apareṇāgniṃ śamīparṇeṣu hutaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya iti | sthālīsaṃkṣālanamājyaśeṣamudakaśeṣaṃ ca pātryāṃ samānīyaiteṣūtpāteṣu ninayet | prokṣayedvā tacchaṃyorā vṛṇīmahe iti | annaṃ saṃskṛtya brāhmaṇān sampūjyāśiṣo vācayati śivaṃ śivam iti | adbhuto vyākhyātaḥ ||2||
āhutānukṛtirāyuṣyahomacaruḥ saṃvatsare saṃvatsare ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu māseṣu caturṣu caturṣu māseṣu māsi māsi vā janmanakṣatre kriyeta | atha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā vrīhīn nirvapati agnaya āyuṣmate vo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi iti | tūṣṇīṃ vā | atha dhānyān nirvapati prāṇāya vo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi iti | tūṣṇīṃ vā | tānabhyukṣyāvahatya triṣphalīkṛtya triḥ prakṣālya nidadhāti | atha tiraḥpavitraṃ sthālyāmapaḥ payo vānīyādhiśritya tiraḥpavitraṃ taṇḍulānāvapati | athājyamadhiśrityobhayaṃ paryagni kṛtvā mekṣaṇaṃ ca sruvaṃ ca saṃmārṣṭi| athaitaṃ caruṃ śrapayitvābhighāryodañcamudvāsya pratiṣṭhitamabhighārayati | sa eṣa eva sarveṣāṃ sthālīpākānāṃ carukalpaḥ | paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā pakvājjuhoti āyuṣṭe viśvato dadhad iti puronuvākyāmanūcya āyurdā agne haviṣo juṣāṇaḥ iti yājyayā juhoti | ājyāhutīrupajuhoti | athāntareṇāgniṃ cājyasthālīṃ carusthālīṃ nidadhāti | sahasrasaṃpātābhihutaṃ karoti | yo brahmā brahmaṇa ujjahāra prāṇeśvaraḥ kṛttivāsāḥ pinākī | īśāno devaḥ sa na āyurdadhātu tasmai juhomi haviṣā ghṛtena svāhā | vibhrājamānaḥ sarirasya madhyādrocamāno gharmarucirya āgāt | sa mṛtyupāśādapanudya ghorādihāyuṣe no ghṛtamattu devaḥ svāhā | brahmajyotirbrahmapatnīṣu garbhaṃ yamādadhāt pururūpaṃ jayantam | suvarṇarambhagrahamarkamarcaṃ tamāyuṣe vardhayāmo ghṛtena svāhā | śriyaṃ lakṣmīmaupalāmambikāṃ gāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ jayāmindrasenetyudāhuḥ tāṃ vidyāṃ brahmayoniṃ sarūpāmihāyuṣe tarpayāmo ghṛtena svāhā | dākṣāyaṇyaḥ sarvayonyaḥ sayonyaḥ sahasraśo viśvarūpā virūpāḥ | sasūnavaḥ sapatayaḥ sayūthyā āyuṣeṇo ghṛtamidaṃ juṣantāṃ svāhā | divyā gaṇā bahurūpāḥ purāṇā āyuśchido naḥ pramanthantu vīrān | tebhyo juhomi bahudhā ghṛtena mā naḥ prajām̐ rīriṣo mota vīrān svāhā | ekaḥpurastādya idaṃ babhūva yato babhūva bhuvanasya gopāḥ | yamapyeti bhuvanam̐ sāṃparāye sa no havirghṛtamihāyuṣe'ttu devaḥ svāhā | vasūn rudrānādityān maruto'tha sādhyān ṛbhūn yakṣān gandharvāścam̐ pitṝṃśca viśvān | bhṛgūn sarpām̐ścāṅgiraso'tha sarvān ghṛtaṃ hutvā svāyuṣyā mahayāma śaśvat svāhā | iti ṣaḍviṃśatiśataṃ kṛtvā tadāhutīnāmaṣṭasahasraṃ saṃpadyate | itarasmāt pakvāt sauviṣṭakṛtaṃ juhoti | havyavāhamabhimātiṣāham iti puronuvākyāmanūcya sviṣṭamagna iti yājyayā juhoti | jayāprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | athāgreṇāgniṃ dūrvāstambe hutaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti mā no mahāntaṃ mā nastoka iti dvābhyām | apareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśya vāgyataḥ sthālīpākaṃ sagaṇaḥ prāśnāti āyurasi viśvāyurasi sarvāyurasi sarvamāyurasi sarvaṃ ma āyurbhūyāt sarvamāyurgeṣam iti | prāśyācamya jaṭharamabhimṛśati yata indra bhayāmahe svastidā viśaspatiḥ iti dvābhyām | kumārāṇāṃ grahagṛhītānāmāyuṣyeṇa ghṛtasūktenāharahaḥ svastyayanārthaṃ svādhyāyamadhīyīta | etaireva mantrairāhutīrjuhuyāt | etaireva mantrairbaliṃ haret | agato haiva bhavati | tadetadṛddhamayanaṃ bhūtopasṛṣṭānāṃ rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ pañcaśoḍāya sarpāhutirgandharvāhutiriti | agato haiva bhavati | tadetadṛddhamayanaṃ hutāhutānukṛtayo'nye homā āśramānukṛtayaḥ saṃśrayā iti ||3||
athāto'pamṛtyuñjayakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | puṇye nakṣatre janmanakṣatre janmavāre vā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ vā devālaye nadītīre goṣṭhe puṇyatame sthale vā svagṛhe vā gomayenopalipya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā atha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ svāhā iti prāyaścittaṃ hutvā śvetadūrvāḥ pālāśasamidho'ṣṭasahasramaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatiṃ vā dadhimadhughṛtapayāṃsi samudāyutya triyambakaṃ yajāmahe iti mantreṇa hutvātha apaitu mṛtyuḥ paraṃ mṛtyo mā no mahāntaṃ mā nastoke triyambakam ye te sahasram iti hutvā sviṣṭakṛtamavadāyāthājyāhutīścopajuhoti nakṣatre rāśau jātasya śarmaṇaḥ mṛtyurnaśyatvāyurvardhatāṃ bhūḥ svāhā pūrvavat śarmaṇaḥ mṛtyurnaśyatvāyurvardhatāṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā pūrvavat śarmaṇaḥ mṛtyurnaśyatvāyurvardhatāṃ svaḥ svāhā pūrvavat śarmaṇaḥ mṛtyurnaśyatvāyurvardhatāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ svāhā iti | atha sviṣṭakṛtaṃ havyavāhamabhimātiṣāham iti puronuvākyāmanūcya sviṣṭamagna iti yājyayā juhoti | jayābhyātānān rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ iti hutvā tantraśeṣaṃ samāpya darbhastambe hutaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti tacchaṃyorā vṛṇīmahe iti | atha dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | yathācāryastuṣṭaḥ prasannahṛdayo bhavet tathā dadyāt | śeṣebhyo'pi yathāśakti dattvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet ||4||
atha jayānāmeva homo jayāhe nāṣṭyaṃ tu kalpayate | vādhaḥsruvaṃ ca srucaśca vādhaka evainaṃ vaibhītakamidhmamabhyajyābādhakena sruveṇopasṛjya bādhakāyāṃ sruci caturgṛhītena juhoti | catuṣpādaḥ paśavaḥ | paśūnevāvarundhe | cittaṃ ca cittiścākūtaṃ cākūtiśca vijñānaṃ ca vijñātaṃ ca manaśca śakvarīśca darśaśca pūrṇamāsaśca bṛhacca rathantaraṃ ca prajāpatirjayānindrāya vṛṣṇe prāyacchadugraḥ pṛtanājyeṣu tasmai viśaḥ samanamanta sarvāḥ sa ugraḥ sa hi havyo babhūva svāhā iti | atha vaibhītakamidhmamiti | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan sa indraḥ prajāpatimupāghāvat tasmā etāñjayān prāyacchat tānajuhot tato vai devā asurānajayan yadajayan tajjayānāṃ jayatvaṃ spardhamānenaite hotavyā jayatyeva tāṃ pṛtanām iti | brāhmaṇamahnaiva bhavati yena karmaṇertset tatra hotavyā iti sa yatkarmertsedidaṃ me samṛddhyata iti ||5||
prajārthihomaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | nadītīre'śvatthacchāyāyāṃ vā gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya prācyāṃ diśi brahmāṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pārśvayordhātāraṃ vidhātāraṃ ca dakṣiṇato dhātāraṃ vāmato vidhātāraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ dhātāraṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vidhātāraṃ caturmukhaṃ citravarṇaṃ tatastānarcayet | pūrvaṃ brahmāṇamāvāhayet | parameṣṭinamāvāhayet | hiraṇyagarbhamāvāhayet ityāvāhya pranavena āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena mārjayitvā śuddhānnaṃ brahmaṇe mudgānnaṃ dhātre pītānnaṃ vidhātre | yajamānasyathaināṃ striyamāhūya tattvamasi jyotirasi viśveśānaṃ gatā nāmadā iti amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmayanadvaye ca vyatīpāte viṣuve tiṣyarohiṇyāṃ śravaṇāyāṃ tasyā janmani ṛtusnātāyām ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpya hiraṇyamācāryāya dattvākliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi paridhāyācamya gandhaśuklapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya atha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyagnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvā saptaṛṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi iti strīṣu dakṣiṇopaviśya paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā pakvāt puruṣasūktena juhuyāt | juhoti yājyāṃ puronuvākyāmiti dvau dvau | pratyṛcamathājyāhutīrupajuhoti | sāvitryāṣṭottarasahasraṃ juhuyāt | apa upaspṛśya sudarśanenāṣṭasahasram agnibījenāṣṭasahasraṃ sapraṇavaṃ juhoti | aṣṭasahasraṃ sapraṇavamaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatiṃ vā | madhyamaṃ juhotyaṣṭaśatamiti kīrtitam | sviṣṭakṛtāt prabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | athainaṃ sampātaṃ mūrdhni juhoti | praṇavena namaskārāntaṃ yajñavāstu kurvīta | tadasya garbhiṇī bhavati | evamutpāditaputrā na lupyante kadācana na lupyante kadācaneti | atha viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ bhagavantamarcayitvā sudarśanenāṣṭasahasraṃ japtvā triḥ paryāyam āvaśyakaḥ putro bhavatītyāha putro bhavatītyāha | śaivokteṣu kāleṣu nadīṣu vā śuddhajalāśaye vā madhyamena ca palāśaparṇena vāṣṭasahasreṇāṣṭaśatena vāṣṭāviṃśatyā vā āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākenābhiṣecanaṃ kṛtvā gāyatryāṣṭasahasreṇābhiṣecanaṃ karoti | puruṣasūktena ca sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa ityetenānuvākena | putro bhavatītyāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||6||
atha viṣṇubaliḥ | aṣṭame māsi pūrvapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre dvādaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ śravaṇāyāṃ vā brāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā atha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā upotthāyāgreṇāgniṃ daivatamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhuvaḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi oṃ svaḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi ityāvāhya paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā daivatamarcayitvā āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena mārjayitvāthādbhistarpayate keśavaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mādhavaṃ govindaṃ viṣṇuṃ madhusūdanaṃ trivikramaṃ vāmanaṃ śrīdharaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ dāmodaraṃ tarpayāmi iti | etaireva nāmabhiḥ gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpaiḥ amuṣmai namo'muṣmai nama iti | atha vaiṣṇavāhutīrjuhoti viṣṇornukaṃ tadasya priyaṃ pra tadviṣṇuḥ paro mātrayā vicakrame trirdeva iti | jayāprabhṛti siddhamādhenuvarapradānāt | gulapāyasaṃ ghṛtamiśramathānnasya bali mupaharati amuṣmai svāhāmuṣmai svāhā iti dvādaśabhiryathāliṅgam | vaiṣṇavībhiḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvabhiḥ stutibhiḥ stuvanti | vyāhṛtībhiḥ puruṣamudvāsayati puruṣamudvāsayāmi iti | annaśeṣaṃ patnīṃ prāśayati pumāṃsaṃ janayatīti vijñāyate ||7||
atha śūlagavaḥ saṃvatsare saṃvatsare mārgaśīrṣapaurṇamāsyāṃ kriyeta | api vārdrāyām araṇye'gnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīryā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā barhirādāya gāmupākaroti īśānāya tvā juṣṭamupākaromi iti | tūṣṇīmityeke | tāmatraiva pratīcīnaśirasīm udīcīnapadīṃ sajñapayati | tasyai saṃjñaptāyā adbhirabhiṣekam | prāṇānāpyāyya tūṣṇīṃ vapāmutkhidya hṛdayamuddhārayati | prajñātāni cāvadānāni | tānye teṣveva śūleṣūpanīkṣyaitasminnevāgnau śrapayanti | athaitāni śūlebhyo'parikṣipya punaḥ kumbhyāṃ niśrapayanti | athaitāni abhighāritānyudvāsya pratiṣṭhitamabhighārayati | paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā daivatamāvāhayati ā tvā vahantu harayaḥ sacetasaḥ śvetairaśvaiḥ saha ketumadbhiḥ | vātājitairmaghavadbhirmanojavairāyāhi śīdhraṃ mama havyāya śarvom iti | atha sruveṇoṣastīrṇābhighāritāṃ juhoti | sahasrāṇi sahasraśa iti puronuvākyāmanūcya īśānaṃ tvā bhuvanānāmabhiśriyam iti yājyayā juhoti | athājyāhutīrupajuhoti | atraitānyavadānānīḍāsūne pracchidyaudanaṃ māṃsaṃ yūṣamityājyena samudāyutya mekṣaṇenopaghātaṃ pūrvārdhe juhoti | bhavāya devāya svāhā śarvāya devāya svāhā īśānāya devāya svāhā paśupataye devāya svāhā rudrāya devāya svāhā ugrāya devāya svāhā bhīmāya devāya svāhā mahate devāya svāhā iti | atha madhye bhavasya devasya patnyai svāhā śarvasya devasya patnyai svāhā īśānasya devasya patnyai svāhā paśupaterdevasya patnyai svāhā rudrasya devasya patnyai svāhā ugrasya devasya patnyai svāhā bhīmasya devasya patnyai svāhā mahato devasya patnyai svāhā iti | athāparārdhe juhoti | bhavasya devasya sutāya svāhā śarvasya devasya sutāya svāhā īśānasya devasya sutāya svāhā paśupaterdevasya sutāya svāhā rudrasya devasya sutāya svāhā ugrasya devasya sutāya svāhā bhīmasya devasya sutāya svāhā mahato devasya sutāya svāhā iti | athājyāhutīrjuhoti | namaste rudra manyava ityāntādanuvākasya | sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | athāpareṇāgnimarkaparṇeṣu hutaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti yo rudro agnau yo apsu ya oṣadhīṣu yo rudro viśvā bhuvanā viveśa tasmai rudrāya namo astu iti | sthālīsaṃkṣālanamājyaśeṣamudakaśeṣaṃ ca pātryāṃ samānīya vetasaśākhayāvokṣya triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gāḥ paryeti ā gāvo agmannuta bhadramakran ityetena sūktena | mahat svastyayanamācakṣate | atha yadi gāṃ na labhate meṣamajaṃ vālabhate | īśānasthālīpākaṃ vā śrapayati yad gavā kāryam | sa śūlagavo vyākhyātaḥ | evamevāṣṭamyāṃ pradoṣe kriyetaitāvadeva nānā | nātropākaraṇaṃ paśoḥ ||8||
athāto gṛhakarmaṇo gṛhavṛddhimicchan māsi māsi ṛtāvṛtau saṃvatsare saṃvatsare pūrvapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre gṛhaśāntimārabheta | apāmārgapālāśaśirīṣaudumbarasadābhadrā amṛtatṛṇamindravallībhirbaddhvā gṛhān parisaṃmārṣṭi | parisamūhyāpo'bhyukṣya pañcagavyena darbhamuṣṭinā samprokṣya sarṣapān saṃprakīryāgnimukhāt kṛtvā madhye vāstoṣpate vāstoṣpate iti dve āhutī hutvā sāvitryā sahasraṃ juhuyāt | tato dakṣiṇapurastāt tato dakṣiṇapaścāt tata uttarapaścāt madhye vā | jayāprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | gāṃ vāso hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti brāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā | evaṃ prayuñjāna āntaṃ mahāntaṃ poṣaṃ puṣyati | bahavaḥ putrā asya bhavanti | na ca bālāḥ pramīyante | nāgnirdahati | na daṃṣṭriṇaḥ khādayeyuḥ | na taskarāḥ sapatnā rakṣāṃsi piśācā api bādhante | yadi gāvaḥ pratapyeran gavāṃ madhye āhutisahasraṃ juhuyāt | etenaiva kalpenāśvoṣṭrakharājāvikamahiṣahastikulamanyatarad dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ ca vyākhyātam ||9||
vṛṣṭikāmasya sambhārān | kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇāśvaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣaṃ kṛṣṇorabhraḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca kṛṣṇavrīhayaśca kṛṣṇamadhu cāmā ca kumbhī kharjūrasaktavaḥ karīrasaktavaśca varṣābhūṇāṃ srajasnīṇi ca puṣkaraparṇāni daśasahasraṃ vaitasasamidhāmityete'sya saṃbhārā upakḷptā bhavanti | agnimupasamādhāya yasmin kāle paścādvāto vāti tasmin kāle kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣam paridhatte mārutamasi marutām ojo'pāṃ dhārāṃ bhindhi ramayata marutaḥ śyenamāyinaṃ manojavasaṃ vṛṣaṇam̐ suvṛktim | yena śardha ugramavasṛṣṭameti tadaśvinā paridhattaṃ svasti | agreṇāgniṃ kṛṣṇamaśvaṃ kṛṣṇamabhraṃ purastāt pratyañcaṃ dhārayanto dakṣiṇata āmāṃ kumbhīṃ nimiñcanti varṣābhūṇāṃ srajaḥ paścāt sthāpayanti | saṃparistīrya nirvapān kṛtvā devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ varuṇāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi iti trīn muṣṭīn yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | patnyavahanti | triṣphalīkṛtya triḥ prakṣālya tiraḥpavitraṃ sthālyām apa ānīyādhiśritya paryagni kṛtvābhighārya carumudvāsyābhighārayati | paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā tasmin kharjūrasaktūṃśca karīrasaktūṃśca kṛṣṇamadhuṣā saṃyauti māndā vāśāśśundhyūrajirā jyotiṣmatīstamasvarīrundatīḥ suphenāḥ iti | trīn piṇḍān kṛtvaiteṣu puṣkaraparṇeṣūpaninahya kṛṣṇamurabhramanulepanaṃ karoti | yacciddhi te yat kiñcedaṃ kitavāsaḥ imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvanno agne sa tvanno agne tvamagne ayāsi ava te heḍa uduttamaṃ triyambakaṃ yajāmahe ityetairdaśabhirmantraiḥ śataśo'bhyasya pratimantraṃ samidho juhuyāt | etairmantrairevamabhyasya haviṣo juhuyāt | tathaivābhyasyājyasya juhuyāt | jayāprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | gurave gāṃ dadāti | kṛṣṇamaśvamadbhirabhyukṣati divā cittamaḥ kṛṇvanti parjanyenodavāhena | pṛthivīṃ yadvyundanti ā yaṃ naraḥ sudānavo dadāśuṣe divaḥ kośamacucyavuḥ | viparjanyāḥ sṛjanti rodasī anu dhanvanā yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ iti | sayati kṛṣṇo'śvodbhirabhyukṣya udīrayathā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ na vo dasrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanurathā avṛtsata iti | sayeti kṛṣṇorabhrī radbhirabhyukṣya ādhūnute varṣati yadi śakṛtkaroti vā varṣati yadi palāyate vopaviśati vā na varṣati iti | āmāṃ kumbhīmadbhiḥ saṃpūrayati | sṛjā vṛṣṭiṃ diva ādbhiḥ samudraṃ pṛṇa | abjā asi prathamajā balamasi samudriyam annambhaya pṛthivīṃ bhindhi divyaṃ nabhaḥ | udno divyasya no dehīśāno vi sṛjā dṛtim | sa yadyāmāṃ kumbhīmadbhiḥ sampūrṇāṃ bhidyate varṣati yadi dhārayate na varṣati | apāṃ pūrṇāṃ srucaṃ varṣāhvayā juhoti unnambhaya pṛthivīm iti | atha yadi na varṣedeteṣāmeva kṛṣṇavrīhīṇāṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā saptāhaṃ savanatrayahomaṃ kuryāt | santiṣṭhate vṛṣṭikāmaḥ santiṣṭhate vṛṣṭikāmaḥ ||10||
atha bhūtabaliṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | vṛṣṭikāmo'dhikārī kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇā gauḥ kṛṣṇayorabhrī kṛṣṇā vrīhayaśca kṛṣṇamadhu cāmā ca kumbhī kharjūrasaktavaśca sarpiśca trīṇi puṣkaraparṇānītyete'sya sambhārā upakḷptā bhavanti | yad bhūtebhyo baliṃ harati tad bhūtayajñaḥ santiṣṭhate iti brāhmaṇam | saṃvatsare saṃvatsare ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu māseṣu yadāmāvāsyāṃ śuṣyo bhavati yadā vṛṣṭerudaghātaṃ vindedatha bhūtabaliṃ dadyāt | taṭākaṃ gatvā śucau deśe uddhatyamānam ityuddhatya śanno devīḥ ityavokṣya devayajanaṃ parigṛhya parilikhitam iti parilikhati | yasmin kāle paścād vāto vāti tasmin kāle brāhmaṇo mārutamasi marutāmoja iti kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ paridhāya apa upaspṛśya yajñopavītaṃ dhṛtvāpa ācamya udapātramādāya paścād bhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyārcayati | vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvāṣṭau vātanāmāni juhoti puro vāto varṣañjinvarāvṛt svāhā iti | atha kṛṣṇavrīhīṇāṃ carūṇāṃ juhoti mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ svāhā agnaye dhāmacchade svāhā marudbhyaḥ svāhā sūryāya svāhā agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā iti | vāruṇyādisviṣṭakṛdantaṃ hutvātha kaṃse vā śarāve vānnaśeṣaṃ kharjūrasaktuṃ samavadāya sarpiṣā madhunā vā saṃyauti | māndā vāśā iti dvābhyām | apareṇāgniṃ triṣu puṣkaraparṇeṣu nirvaped devā vasavyā iti | tisṛbhirannaśeṣasyārdhaṃ nivedayati devasya tvā iti | tata udakaṃ gatvāvaśiṣṭasya trīn piṇḍān śrapsu juhoti | udno dattodadhiṃ bhinta iti tribhiḥ svāhākārāntaiḥ | athāñjalināpa upahatyotkṣipet udīrayathā maruta iti dvābhyām | atha vāstudevaṃ gatvā | ye vāstudaivatāḥ krūrarakṣobhūtagaṇāśca ye | tebhyo baliṃ vṛṣṭikāmo harāmi śāntāḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu | namaḥ sarvebhyo namo bhūtebhyo namo ityāmāṃ kumbhīṃ cādbhiḥ pūrayitvā unnambhaya pṛthivīm iti kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ ca | ye devā divi bhāgā ityatha devatā upatiṣṭhate | yantu nadayo varṣantu parjanyā iti parjanyān upatiṣṭhate puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā | yadi varṣet tāvatyeva hotavyaṃ yadi na varṣet śvobhūte havirnirvapet iti brāhmaṇam ||11||
atha bījanivāpanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | rohiṇyāṃ tiṣyamūyoḥ viśākhayormaghāsu śravaṇāyāṃ revatyāṃ mitrāvaruṇayormaruta uttarāsvekasmin nakṣatre bījānādāya datvādhivāsaṃ karoti | eṣu nakṣatreṣu ekasmin nakṣatre kṣetraṃ gatvā pūrvāyāṃ diśi gandhādibhirārādhya śirīṣaparṇairavakīrya gandhaśeṣairātmānamupalipya karṣakāya gandhādi dattvā bījāni vaped yā jātā oṣadhaya ityetenānuvākena | athālahvānāt pūrvaṃ carūrjaṃ śrapayitvātha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā adbhirmārjayitvā āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākenātha piṇḍaṃ dadāti kṣetrasya pate madhumantamūrmiṃ dhenuriva payo asmāsu dhukṣva | madhuścutaṃ ghṛtamiva supūtamṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛḍayantu atha dakṣiṇāpurastāt tato dakṣiṇāpaścāt tataḥ purastāduttarataḥ paścād atha madhye yathoditaṃ lavanaṃ karoti | tena dhānyena paścādāgrayaṇaṃ karoti | ||12||
athātograhātithyabalikarmopahārān athayadyagāresthūṇāvirohed āhutānukṛtiḥ athāto'pamṛtyuñjayakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ atha jayānāmeva prajārthihomam athaviṣṇubaliḥ athaśūlagavaḥ athātogṛhakarmaṇo vṛṣṭikāmasya athabhūtabalim athabījanivāpanaṃ dvādaśa |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre dvitīyapraśne pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
<2.6 ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ>
athāta ācamanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā dvau pāṇī prakṣālya baddhaśikho yajñopavītī jale vātha sthale vāntarjānu navivarāṅgulībhiḥ gokarṇākṛtivat karaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhan na praṇato na hasanna jalpan na vrajan noṣṇābhirna vivarṇābhirna budbudābhiḥ na calo jalaṃ māṣamagnamātraṃ pibet | brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇe haste pañca tīrthāni pañca daivatāni bhavanti | aṅgulīmadhye daivaṃ tīrthaṃ aṅgulyagre ārṣaṃ tīrtham aṅguṣṭhatarjanyormadhye paitṛkaṃ tīrtham aṅguṣṭhamūlasyottarato rekhāsu brāhmaṃ tīrtham madhye agnitīrtham | aṅguṣṭhe agniḥ pradeśinyāṃ vāyuḥ madhye prajāpatiḥ anāmikāyāṃ brahmā kaniṣṭhikāyāmindraḥ | atha trirācāmet praṇavena | prathamaṃ yat pibati tena ṛgvedaṃ prīṇāti | dvitīyaṃ yat pibati tena yajurvedaṃ prīṇāti | tṛtīyaṃ yat pibati tena sāmavedaṃ prīṇāti | prathamaṃ yat parimṛjati tenātharvavedaṃ prīṇāti | dvitīyaṃ yat parimṛjati tena itihāsaṃ prīṇāti | yad upaspṛśati tenāgniṃ yat pādāvabhyukṣate tena viṣṇuṃ sahyaṃ pitṝn cirasyā ṛṣīn tena candrādityau yannāsike tena prāṇāpānau yacchrotraṃ tena diśo yadbāhū tena indraṃ yannābhiṃ tena pṛthivīṃ yad hṛdayaṃ tena rudraṃ yacchirastena saptarṣīn prīṇāti | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu cakṣuṣī samupaspṛśet pradeśinyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ tu nāsike aṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ śrotre madhyamāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ bāhvoḥ aṅguṣṭhena nābhau aṅgulyagreṇa hṛdi sarveṣāmaṅgulītalānāṃ tu śirasi iti sarvān kāmān samardhayantu iti | atha ūrdhvaṃ snānavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | snānārthaṃ mṛdamutkhanati mṛttike hana me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam tvayā hatena pāpena jivāmi śaradaḥ śatam mṛttike dehi me puṣṭiṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | iti apa ānayati gandhadvārāṃ durādharṣāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm īśvarīm̐ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam iti piṇḍīkaroti ||1||
atha hastapādau prakṣālya kamaṇḍaluṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca saṃgṛhya tīrthaṃ ca gatvā triḥ pādau prakṣālayate | trirātmānam | atha haike bruvate śmaśānamāpo devagṛhaṃ goṣṭhaṃ yatra ca brāhmaṇāḥ naprakṣālya pādau tatra na praveṣṭavyam iti | athāpo'bhiprapadyate hiraṇyaśṛṅgaṃ varuṇaṃ prapadye tīrthaṃ me dehi yācitaḥ | yanmayā bhuktamasādhūnāṃ pāpebhyaśca pratigrahaḥ yanme manasā vācā karmaṇā vā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam tanna indro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā ca punantu punaḥ punaḥ | iti athāñjalinā apa upaharati sumitrā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu iti | tāṃ diśaṃ nirukṣati yasyāmasya diśi dveṣyo bhavati durmitrāstasmai bhūyāsuryo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ iti | athāpa upaspṛśya triḥ pradakṣiṇamudakamāvartate yadapāṃ krūraṃ yadamedhyaṃ yadaśāntaṃ tadapagacchatāt iti | apsu nimajjyonmajjya nāpsumataḥ prayamaṇaṃ vidyate | na vāsasaḥ patpūlanaṃ nopasparśanaṃ yadyavaruddhāḥ syustena tenopatiṣṭhate | namo'gnaye'psumate nama indrāya namo varuṇāya namo vāruṇyai namo'dbhyaḥ ityuttīryācamya ācāntaḥ punarācāmet āpaḥ punantu pṛthivīṃ pṛthivī pūtā punātu mām | punantu brahmaṇaspatiḥ brahma pūtā punātu mām | yaducchiṣṭamabhojyaṃ yadvā duścaritaṃ mama | sarvaṃ punantu māmāpo'satāṃ ca pratigrahaṃ svāhā iti | pavitre kṛtvādbhirmārjayate | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena mārjayitvāntarjalagato'ghamarṣaṇena trīn prāṇāyāmān dhārayitvottīrya vāsaḥ pīḍayitvā prakṣālitopavātānyakliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi paridhāyāpa ācamya darbheṣvāsīno darbhān dhārayamāṇaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayecchatakṛtvo vā daśāvaramiti | athādityamupatiṣṭhate udvayaṃ tamasaspari udutyaṃ citraṃ taccakṣurddevahitaṃ ya udakāt iti | athāpyudāharanti praṇavo vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrī cetyete pañca brahmayajñā aharahaḥ brāhmaṇaṃ kilbiṣāt pāvayanti | pūtaḥ pañcabhirbrahmayajñairathottaraṃ devatāstarpayatīti ||2||
agniḥ prajāpatiḥ somo rudro'ditirbṛhaspatiḥ sarpā ityetāni prāgdvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | vasūn tarpayāmi | pitaro'ryamā bhagaḥ savitā tvaṣṭā vāyurindrāgnī ityetāni dakṣiṇadvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | rudrān tarpayāmi | mitra indro mahāpitara āpo viśvedevā brahmā viṣṇurityetāni pratyagdvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi sāhorātrāṇi samuhūrtāni tarpayāmi | ādityān tarpayāmi | vasavo varuṇo'ja ekapād ahirbudhnyaḥ pūṣā aśvinau yama ityetāni udagdvārāṇi daivatāni sanakṣatrāṇi sagrahāṇi brahmarṣīṃstarpayāmi | rājaṛṣīṃstarpayāmi | devaṛṣīṃstarpayāmi | śrutaṛṣīṃstarpayāmi | taparṣīṃstarpayāmi | saptarṣīṃstarpayāmi | kāṇḍarṣīṃstarpayāmi | ṛṣikāṃstarpayāmi | ṛṣiputrīstarpayāmi | ṛṣiputrāṃstarpayāmi | bodhāyanaṃ tarpayāmi | āpastambaṃ tarpayāmi | sūtrakāraṃ tarpayāmi | satyāṣāḍhaṃ tarpayāmi | hiraṇyakeśinaṃ tarpayāmi | vyāsaṃ tarpayāmi | praṇavaṃ tarpayāmi | vyāhṛtīstarpayāmi | sāvitrīṃ tarpayāmi | chandāṃsi tarpayāmi | ṛgvedaṃ tarpayāmi | yajurvedaṃ tarpayāmi | sāmavedaṃ tarpayāmi | atharvavedaṃ tarpayāmi | itihāsapurāṇāṃstarpayāmi | sarvadevajanāṃstarpayāmi | sarvabhūtāni tarpayāmi | atharvāṇaṃ tarpayāmi | prācīnāvītī | pitṝn svadhā namastarpayāmi | pitāmahān svadhā namastarpayāmi | prapitāmahān svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātṝḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | pitāmahīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | prapitāmahīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātāmahān svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātuḥ pitāmahān svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātuḥ prapitāmahān svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātāmahīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātuḥ pitāmahīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | mātuḥ prapitāmahīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | ācāryān svadhā namastarpayāmi | ācāryapatnīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | gurūn svadhā namastarpayāmi | gurupatnīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | sakhīn svadhā namastarpayāmi | sakhipatnīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | jñātīn svadhā namastarpayāmi | jñātapatnīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | amātyān svadhā namastarpayāmi | amātyapatnīḥ svadhā namastarpayāmi | sarvān svadhā namastarpayāmi | anutīrtham apa utsiñcanti ūrjaṃ vahantīramṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutaṃ svadhā stha tarpayata me pitṝn tṛpyata tṛpyata iti || nārdravāsā naikavastro daivatāni karmāṇyanusaṃcaret | pitṛsaṃyuktāni cetyekeṣāmekeṣām ||3||
athātaḥ svādhyāyavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | prāṅmukho vā udaṅmukho vā grāmānniṣkramya apa āplutya yajñopavītyācānto'klinnavāsā darbhāṇāṃ mahadupastīrya prākkūlānāṃ teṣu prāṅmukha upaviśyopasthānaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇottarau pāṇī sandhāya pavitravantau vijñāyate'pāṃ vā eṣa oṣadhīnāṃ raso yad darbhāḥ sarasameva brahma karoti dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ sandhimīkṣamāṇaḥ sammīlya vā yathā vā yuktamātmānaṃ manyeta tathā yukto'dhīyīta svādhyāyam | oṃpūrvā vyāhṛtayaḥ | sāvitrīmanvāha paccho'rdharcaśaḥ sarvāmiti tṛtīyam | atha svādhyāyamadhīyīta ṛco yajūm̐ṣi sāmānyatharvāṅgiraso brāhmaṇāni kalpān gāthā nārāśaṃsīritihāsapurāṇānīti | yadṛco'dhīte payasaḥ kūlyā asya pitṝn svadhā upakṣaranti yadyajūm̐ṣi ghṛtasya kūlyā yatsāmāni madhvaḥ kūlyā yadatharvāṅgirasaḥ somasya kūlyā yad brāhmaṇāni kalpān gāthā nārāśaṃsīritihāsapurāṇānītyamṛtasya kūlyāḥ | sa yāvanmanyeta tāvadadhītyaitayā paridadhāti namo brahmaṇe namo astvagraye namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyo namo vāce namo vācaspataye namo viṣṇave bṛhate karomi iti | ata ūrdhvaṃ devayajñaḥ sarveṣāmupadiśyate | yatrātmāvirodhena pratiniyatānāmoṣadhīnāṃ kodravacīnarājamāṣamamūrakulatthavarakavarjaṃ nirvapāṇi yavānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ prātaḥ patnīṃ dadyāt | svayaṃ vātha śrapayet | susaṃmṛṣṭagṛhadvāropalepanaḥ pratiniyataḥ sāyaṃprātaḥ anyadāvaśyakān kuryāt agnaye jātavedase svāhā ityagnau tūṣṇīṃ dvitīyam | udutyaṃ jātavedasam ityādityamupatiṣṭhate | brahmaṇe nama iti brahmasthale baliṃ haret | somāya ityudakumbhe vāyava iti vāstugṛhe gṛhapataya iti gṛhadvāri prajāpataya iti gargagṛhe viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ iti devagṛhe śanno devīḥ ityabhriṇyādikṣu tatpuruṣebhya iti pratidiśaṃ gṛhebhya ityantarikṣe sarvataḥ paśūnāṃ pataye namo devebhya iti prāgudīcyāṃ brahmasthale vā svadhā pitṛbhya iti dakṣiṇe nidadhāti | anena vā pūrvoktena vāsabaliharaṇena vā balim ||4||
vaiśvadevaṃ hutvā āgordohamātrakṣaṇamākāṅkṣe datithīn | śrotriyo vedavratī yatirdharmanaiṣṭhikaḥ samānavṛttiḥ manasvatyāhutistasya prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā vicchinne pramādādakṛteṣu ca tisrastantumatīrhutvā catasro vāruṇīryajet daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā vicchinneṣu tu sarvaśaḥ catasro'bhyāvartanīrhutvā kāryastāntumataścaruḥ yasya strī vānupeto vā gṛheṣvagnibaliṃ haret kūśmāṇḍyastatra hotavyo hutvā yajñasamṛddhaye pravāsaṃ gacchato yasya gṛhe kartā na vidyate pañcānāṃ mahatāmeṣāṃ sa yajñaiḥ saha gacchati pravāse kurute cainān yadannamupapadyate na cedutpadyate cānnamadbhirenā samāviśet adbhireva vrataṃ kuryādyathālābhamanuvratam devānāṃ devayajñena dvijo gacchati sāmyatām pitṝṇāṃ pitṛyajñena bhūtānāṃ yajñabhūtikaiḥ manormanuṣyayajñena brahmaṇo brahmayajñataḥ eteṣāṃ sāmyatāṃ gatvā daivatānāṃ śataṃ samāḥ ānandaṃ brahma gacchanti dhruvaṃ śāśvatamavyayam | iti athāsyātithirbhavati guroḥ samānavṛttirvaikhānaso yadi snātako vā rājā vā dharmayuktaḥ | teṣāmabhyutthāyāsanaṃ pādyamarhaṇamardhyaṃ prayacchati | yāstatra oṣadhayaḥ santi tā deyāḥ | anyāṃ vā prakriyāṃ prakurvīta | oṣadhivibhāgastu vibhavavatā kāryaḥ | abhāve bhūmirudakaṃ tṛṇāni kalyā vāgiti etāni vai sato'gāre na kṣīyante kadācana iti | tānetān paraṃ brahmetyācakṣate | teṣāṃ grahaṇe dvādaśarātraṃ vrataṃ cared akṣāralavaṇabhojanam adhaśśayanaṃ brahmacaryam | trirātropocittaḥ utkṣepaṇau parau gṛhṇīyāt | baliharaṇaṃ vyākhyātam ||5||
atha madhuparkaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | catvāri pātrāṇi kāṃsyaturyāṇi dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ kūrcatrayaṃ ca vāsasī kuṇḍalayugmaṃ ca darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhairapidadhāti | tiraḥpavitraṃ prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtyemāni prokṣya pavitrāntarhite pātre'pa ānīyotpūya arhaṇīyārthānnadhāyaivameva pādyamevamevācamanīyakaṃ kaṃse tiraḥpavitraṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtamānīya punarāhāraṃ trirutpūya madhuparkārthānnidhāyācāryaśvaśurapitṛvyamātulasnātakātithirājabhyo dadyāt | vivāhe varāya | athādbhyaḥ karmaṇi ca dadyād ayaṃ kūrca iti kūrcam | tasmin prāṅmukha upaviśati rāṣṭrabhṛdasyācāryāsandī mā tvadyoṣam iti | athāsmai kūrcābhyāṃ parigṛhyārhaṇīyaṃ dadyād arhaṇīyamudakam iti | tadabhimantrayate ā mā gāttejasā varcasā yaśasā saṃsṛja payasā ca iti | tadañjalino'asaṃgṛhya prāk sektavā ityuktvā prāñcaṃ visṛjati | evameva pādyaṃ dadyāt pādyamudakam iti | tadabhimantrayate yaśo'si yaśo mayi dhehi rāṣṭramasi rāṣṭraṃ mayi dhehi iti | tenāsya pādāvanyaḥ prakṣālayati | avanektuḥ pāṇiṃ saṃmṛśati mayi maho mayi bhargo mayi yaśaḥ iti | upaspṛśya mayīndriyaṃ vīryam ityātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati | ācamanīyamudakam iti | tenācāmati amṛtopastaraṇamasi iti | ācamya athāsmai madhuparkaṃ dadyād ayaṃ madhuparka iti | tadabhimantrayate sa māvatu sa mā pātu sa mā juṣatām iti | vāsasī kuṇḍale ca dadyāt | svāmā tanūrāviśa ityahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāyaivamāsaṃgyaṃ kuṇḍale ca gṛhya yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvāpa ācamya madhuparkaṃ gṛhṇāti śrīrasyehi mayi śrayasva iti | tadaṅguṣṭhena mahānāmśyrācopasaṃgṛhyāvajighrati grāṇemaṃ te baliṃ harāmi śraiṣṭhyaṃ ma ādhipatyaṃ gamaya iti | apa upaspṛśya aṅgulībhiḥ samudāyutyācāmati priyatamo nāmāsi devayādurmahyaṃ tvā śriyai yaśase gṛhṇāmi iti | somo'si somapaṃ mā kuru iti dvitīyam | annamasyannādaṃ mā kuru iti tṛtīyam | pītvocchiṣṭaṃ nidhāya amṛtāpidhānamasi ityācamanīyenācamya upavītaṃ gāmabhimantrayate jahi me pāpmānamupavettuśca iti | tāmudvā sṛjata kuruteti vā brūyāt | yadyutsṛjati tāmabhimantrayate gaurdhenurbhavyā iti dvābhyām | tasyāmutsṛṣṭāyāṃ meṣamajaṃ vālabhate | āraṇyena vā māṃsena | na tvevāmāṃso'rghyaḥ syāt | aśaktau vā yavasaktumiśramodanaṃ yathālābhaṃ dadyāt ||6||
pañca yajñān tataḥ kṛtvā brahmayajñādyanukramāt devayajñaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṛyajñaṃ tataḥ param bhūtayajñaṃ ca kṛtvā tu yajñaṃ mānuṣyameva ca kṛtvaivaṃ pañcadhā yajñān yathāśāstrānusārataḥ gomayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gṛhadvāre tu deśataḥ patitāya śunādibhyaḥ piṇḍān samyaṅ nivedayet devavihitāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya kṣatriyasya trikoṇamupalipya vaiśyasya vṛttamupalipya bhojanaṃ kurute | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śrīrhutāśana eva ca maṇḍalenopajīvanti tasmāt kurvīta maṇḍalam yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ ghnanti vai balamannasya maṇḍalena vivarjitam | iti vacanāt prayatnato maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvārdrapādaḥ prāṅmukha upaviśya bhūmau savyaṃ pādaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyādhomukho vāgyataḥ parṇamayaṃ vā kāṃsyamayaṃ vā pātraṃ savyena hastena saṃspṛṣṭvā snehalavaṇavyañjanādyannenājyenākūro dātavyaḥ | tato bhoktavyamityāhuḥ | udakyādibhirna darśitamannam | darśanamātre ā mastakādā hṛdayādvā dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimuddharet | ājyenābhighārayati | athodakena pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṣiñcati | ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmi iti sāyam | satyaṃ tvarttena pariṣiñcāmi iti prātaḥ | pāṇiṃ prakṣālyānnasūktenānnamabhimṛśati ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtasya iti daśarcena sūktena | atha apa ācāmayati amṛtopastaraṇamasi iti | atha prāṇāhutīrjuhoti prāṇe niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo mā viśāpradāhāya prāṇāya svāhā iti prāṇāya | apāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo mā viśāpradāhāya apānāya svāhā ityapānāya | vyāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo mā viśāpradāhāya vyānāya svāhā iti vyānāya | udāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo mā viśāpradāhāya udānāya svāhā ityudānāya | samāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi śivo mā viśāpradāhāya samānāya svāhā iti samānāya | prāṇāya svāhā apānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā udānāya svāhā samānāya svāhā iti vā | etā āhutīrhutvā yathākāmaṃ bhuṅkte mūlaphalādivyañjanāni na dantena khādet pādoddhṛtāni sarvāṇi snehadravyāṇi vyañjanāni | punaḥ punaḥ pānenāsti doṣaḥ | dadhnā havirmiśrena trivṛtānnena yathākarma hutvāthāpa ācamya amṛtāpidhānamasi ityācāntaḥ punarācamya prāṇānāṃ granthirasi sa mā visrasa iti nābhideśamabhimṛśati | evaṃ bhojane bhojane kurvan ahorātropavāsaphalamaśnute | yadi śayanamicchennodakcchirā na vaṃśavaśo na dvārāya pādābhyāṃ na parvaṇe notsaveṣu na bhasi ca na grahāyatanabhūtāyatanāgnyāyataneṣu na nagno nāśuciḥ na sandhyayorna viśīrnakhaṭvāyāṃ na śmaśānāyatanamahāvṛkṣacchāyāsu nānyat pramādamastīti manyate | prākcchirā dakṣiṇaśirā vā saṃviśediti ||7||
athāparāhṇe tāmramayaṃ vā mṛṇmayaṃ vā kamaṇḍalumādāya grāmāt prācīmudicīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramya tīrthe gatvodakaṃ gṛhītvā śucau deśe śaucārthe mṛdaṃ parigṛhya nasiktaṃ napurīṣaṃ noṣaraṃ navalmīkaṃ naśarkarāmiśraṃ naśāḍvalamiśraṃ karṇasthabrahmamūtraḥ pavitramasi iti tṛṇairavakīrya teṣu mūtrapurīṣaṃ visṛjati | na cityāṃ na nadyāṃ na śāḍvalopavanadivyacchāyāsu na pathi na bhasmani na kṣetramadhye kṛṣṇe na gomaye na śmaśānamahāvṛkṣavalmīkacchāyāsu | divāsandhyayorudaṅmukhaḥ rātrau ced dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | śiśnaṃ gṛhītvotthāya yathā gandhalepakṣayakaraṃ tathātandritaḥ śaucaṃ kuryāt | ekayā ca kamaṇḍalumupaspṛśya prakṣālya pāṇipādau cācamya oṃkāraṃ manasā dhyātvā śucirbhavet | athāstaṃgate'rke adbhirmārjayate dadhikrāviṣṇo'kāripam iti | athāpo'śnāti agniśca mā manyuśca ityetenānuvākena | apa ācamyādbhirmārjayate āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ | tūṣṇīṃ pradakṣiṇamudakena pravartayet | athāñjalinodakamādāyotthāyādityābhimukhastiṣṭan praṇavena vyāhṛtībhiḥ saha gāyatryābhimantrya trirūrdhvaṃ prakṣipet | tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt | athopaviśyādbhistarpayate dhātāraṃ tarpayāmi | aryamṇaṃ tarpayāmi | mitraṃ tarpayāmi | varuṇaṃ tarpayāmi | aṃśumantaṃ tarpayāmi | bhagaṃ tarpayāmi | indraṃ tarpayāmi | vivasvantaṃ tarpayāmi | pūṣaṇaṃ tarpayāmi | parjanyaṃ tarpayāmi | tvaṣṭāraṃ tarpayāmi | viṣṇuṃ tarpayāmi iti | athodakasamīpe darbhairavakīryopaviśya pavitrapāṇiḥ pratyaṅmukha upaviśya gāyatrīṃ manasāvāhayet | āyātu varadā devyakṣaraṃ brahmasammitam | gāyatrī chandasāṃ mātedaṃ brahma juṣasva naḥ | ojo'si saho'si balamasi bhrājo'si devānāṃ dhāma nāmāsi viśvamasi viśvāyuḥ sarvamasi sarvāyuḥ abhibhūraoṃ gāyatrīmāvāhayāmi | sāvitrīmāvāhayāmi | sarasvatīmāvāhayāmi | ityāvāhya oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ suvaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ oṃ satyaṃ oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ityetamanuvākaṃ trirabhyasya trīn prāṇāyāmān dhārayitvā nakṣatrāṇāmudayāt pūrvaṃ praṇavena vyāhṛtībhiḥ saha sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayet śatakṛtvo vā daśāvaraṃ vā | atha devīmudvāsayet uttame śikhare iti | athotthāya vāruṇīṃ diśamupatiṣṭhate yacciddhi te viśo yathā iti tisṛbhiḥ imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhī havam iti dvābhyām | dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumanuparyāvṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ diśamupatiṣṭhate yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca | vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca | audumbarāya dadhnāya nīlāya parameṣṭhine | vṛkodarāya citrāya citraguptāya vai namaḥ | iti | evameva uttarāṃ diśamupatiṣṭhate ṛtam̐ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam | ūrdhvaretaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ | iti | evameva paryāvṛtya pratyaṅmukhaḥ sthitvā yadapsu te sarasvati goṣvaśveṣu yanmadhu | tena me vājinīvati mukhamaṅgdhi sarasvati iti mukhamabhimṛśati | piśaṅgabhṛṣṭimaṃbhṛṇaṃ piśācamindra saṃvṛṇu | sarvaṃ rakṣo nibarhaya iti skandhamabhimṛśati | trīṇi pradakṣiṇāni kṛtvābhivādanaṃ karoti | evaṃ prātaḥsandhyāmupāsyāpośanakāle sūryaśca māmanyuśca ityetenānuvākenābhimantrya prāśnāti | prāṅmukhastiṣṭhan sāvitrīṃ japet | prācīṃ diśamupatiṣṭhate mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛta iti tisṛbhiḥ | prasiddhaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā madhyāhne sandhyāmupāsya āpaḥ punantu pṛthivīm ityapo'śnāti | athodakamādāya ā satyena ityabhimantryordhvaṃ prakṣipyādityamupatiṣṭhate udvayaṃ tamasaspari udutyaṃ citram iti tisṛbhiḥ taccakṣurdevahitaṃ ya udagāt iti dvābhyāṃ ca | diśopasthānameva | snānavidhiyuktena vā santiṣṭhate sandhyopāsanaḥ santiṣṭhate iti ||8||
athātaācamanavidhiṃvyākhyāsyāmaḥ athahastapādauprakṣālya agniḥ prajāpatiḥ athātaḥsvādhyāyavidhiṃ vaiśvadevaṃhutvā athamadhuparkaṃvyākhyāsyāmaḥ pañcayajñān athāparāhṇe aṣṭau
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre dvitīyapraśne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
<2.7 saptamo'dhyāyaḥ>
punarupanayanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | agurorucchiṣṭabhakṣī madhumāṃsabhakṣī bhavati | sandhyākārya udakumbhe'gnikārye ciralopī bhavati | aguroḥ spretamanugacched dahedvā | ubhayatra daśāhāni kulānyannavejañca brahmacaryakṣatirbhavati | etaiścānyaiśca nimittāni bhavanti cet pūrvapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre gomayena gocarmamātraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya yamaniyamayantraiḥ vratopavāsaiśca prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā agnimupasamādhāya samparistīryā daṇḍapradānāt pūrvavadupanayanaṃ kṛtvā sāvitrīṃ vācayati bhikṣāṃ na kurvannaśnāti na ca śmaśrūṇi vāpanam śiromuṇḍaṃ na kurvanna vāsasaḥ paridhāpanam nālaṅkāraṃ tataḥ kurvan brahmasūtrasya dhāraṇam mekhalādhāraṇaṃ caiva na caivāmbaradhāraṇam na cābhimantraṇaṃ kurvan nājinasya ca dhāraṇam na pradānaṃ ca daṇḍasya na bhaikṣācaraṇaṃ tathā vāsaso grahaṇaṃ nāsti vratopanayanaṃ tathā evaṃ hi vidhivat kṛtvā pūto bhavati mānavaḥ punaḥsaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā pūto bhavati | tadahareva sāvitrīvrataṃ kṛtvā tadahareva visṛjed ityāha ||1||
yaḥ pāṇigrahādiragnistamaupāsana ityācakṣate | tasmin gṛhṇāṇi karmāṇi kriyante | tasyaupāsanenāgnihotritvaṃ yathā pārvaṇena carūṇāṃ darśapūrṇamāsayājitvam | tasmānnityo dhāryo'nugato manthyaḥ śrotriyāgārādvāhāryaḥ | upavāsaścānugate bhāryāyāḥ patyurvā | etāścāhutīrjuhuyāt mitrāya svāhā varuṇāya svāhā somāya svāhā sūryāya svāhā agnaye svāhā agnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate svāhā agnaye śucaye svāhā agnaye jyotiṣmate svāhā agnaye vratapataye svāhā iti vyāhṛtībhirvihṛtābhiḥ samastābhiśca | atha yadi dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā sāyaṃprātarvicchinno bhavati agnaye tantumate juhuyāt | yadi sthālīpākasyātipātanaṃ bhavati agnaye pathikṛte agnaye vaiśvānarāya vā juhuyāt | asyāpi vyākhyātāvāgrayaṇapiṇḍapitṛyajñau | dvādaśāhāni vicchinnaḥ punarādheyaḥ pratisaṃkhyāya vā homān juhuyāt | punarādhānaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | pariśrite uddhatyāvokṣya sikatopopta udumbaraśākhābhiḥ plakṣaśākhābhiḥ pālāśaśākhābhirvā pracchādya yājñikāt kāṣṭhādagniṃ mathitvā śrotriyāgārādvāhṛtya sate kṛtvā prajvalayitvā śākhām apohya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaraoṃ pratiṣṭha iti nyupyopasamādadhāti | vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā tisrastantumatīrjuhoti tantuṃ tanvan udbudhyasvāgne trayastrim̐śattantavaḥ iti | atha catasro'bhyāvartanīrjuhoti agne'bhyāvartin agne aṅgiraḥ punarūrjā saha rayyā iti | etāṃ prājāpatyāṃ manasvatīṃ sāptapatīṃ ca hutvā dve mindāhutī juhoti yanma ātmano mindābhūt punaragniścakṣuradāt iti | prāyaścittīyāṃ juhoti ayāścāgneranabhiśastīśca satyamitvamayā asi | ayasā manasā ghṛto'yasā havyamūhiṣe ayāno dhehi bheṣajaṃ svāhā iti | daśahotāraṃ manasānudrutya sagṛhaṃ hutvā imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvanno agne sa tvanno agne tvamagne ayāsi prajāpate yadasya karmaṇo'tyarīricam iti ca | atraike jayābhyātānān rāṣṭrabhṛta ityupajuhvati | yathā purastād brāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā prasiddha āgneyaḥ sthālīpākaḥ | atra gurave varaṃ dadāti vāsasī dhenumanaḍvāhaṃ vā | yadi pravased oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ iti upasthāya pravaset | yadi prayāyād vyākhyātamātmanyaraṇyoḥ samāropaṇamupāvarohaṇaṃ ca | samidhi vā samāropanamupāvarohaṇaṃ ca | samidhi vā samāropayedaraṇīkalpena | yatra vāsastasmin śrotriyāgārādagnimāhṛtya ājuhvānaḥ udbudhyasva iti dvābhyāmavadhāya paristīrya yasyāṃ samārūḍhatāmādadhāti | vyākhyāto homakalpaḥ | ||2||
atha gṛhasthasya dve bhārye | agnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīryājyaṃ bilāpya utpūya sruksruvau niṣṭapya sammṛjya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvānvārabdhāyāṃ patnyāṃ yajamāno juhoti namastarṣe gada | avyavāyai tvā svadhāyai tvā | mā na indrābhitastvadṛṣvāriṣṭāsaḥ | evā brahman tavedastu svāhā iti | athainamagniṃ samāropayate ayaṃ te yonirṛtviya iti | samāropya pūrvāgnau samidhamādhāya ājuhvānaḥ udbudhyasva iti dvābhyāṃ saṃparistīryājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruksruvau niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvānvārabdhayoḥ patnyoḥ yajamāno juhoti yo brahmā brahmaṇa ujjahāra ityetena sūktenaikaikaśaścaturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā | ā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā catuśśarāvamodanaṃ śrapayitvābhighāryodañcamudvāsya pratiṣṭhitamabhighārayati | paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā pakvājjuhoti | samitaṃ saṃkalpethām iti puronuvākyāmanūcya agne purīṣyādhipā bhavā tvanna iti yājyayā juhoti | adhājyāhutīrupajuhoti purīṣyastvamagne ityāntādanuvākasya | sviṣṭakṛt prabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | santiṣṭhate aupāsanatantraḥ santiṣṭhate aupāsanatantraḥ ||3||
atha gṛhyaprāyaścittāni juhoti anugate'gnau kālātikrame homayoḥ darśapūrṇamāsayośca āgrayaṇamakṛtvā navānnaprāśane'kṛtasīmantāyāṃ prasūtāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ strīṣu goṣu ca yamalajanane parāgamane rajasvalāgamane divāmaithune kumārasyājātasaṃskāre mantraviparyāse karmaviparyāse brahmacāriṇo vrataviparyāse mekhalācchedane daṇḍabhinne yajñopavītasyādhāraṇe sandhyālope agnikāryalope udakumbhalope ityetaiścānyaiśca kalpadṛṣṭamagnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya ghṛtaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā pāhi no agna enase svāhā iti | purastāccopariṣṭācca mahāvyāhṛtībhirhutvā etadevāsya prāyaścittamavicchinnakaraṇaṃ santataṃ bhavatīti | upanayanāgnirvivāhāgniḥ sūtakāgniḥ śmaśānāgnirā caturahādā daśāhādā sañcayanādudvātaḥ syāt apahatā asurā rakṣām̐si piśācā ye kṣayanti pṛthivīmanu | anyatreto gacchantu yatraiṣāṃ gataṃ manaḥ ityadbhiravokṣya kṣipraṃ bhasmasamāropaṇam | ayaṃ te yonirṛtviya iti śrotriyāgārādagnimāhṛtya ājuhvānaḥ udbudhyasva iti dvābhyāmavadhāya paristīrya pariṣicya prāyaścittaṃ juhoti ayāścāgneḥ pañcahotāraṃ brāhmaṇa ekahotāraṃ manasvatīmindāhutīvyāhṛtībhiḥ | athāpivā caturahaḥsadyaskālaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vicchinatti sārasvatena homena manasvatīmindāhutīmahāvyāhṛtīnāṃ sapraṇavaṃ juhuyāt ||4||
atha brahmacāryavakīrṇī bhavati yo'yonau retaḥpātena vā sandhyālopena vodakumbhalopenāgnikāryalopena vā | anyāni nimittāni bhavanti cecchuklamanārdramācchādya kṛtopavāsaḥ kṛtaniyamayantro'māvāsyāyāṃ rātryāmagnimupasamādhāya vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā dvirājyasyopaghātaṃ juhoti kāmāvakīrṇo'smyavakīrṇo'smi kāmakāmāya svāhā kāmābhidrugdho'smyabhidrugdho'smi kāmakāmāya svāhā iti | punarmāmaitvindriyam ityetamanuvākamaṣṭaśatamājyasya juhuyāt | yaddevā devahelanam ityetamanuvākaṃ pratyṛcamājyasya juhuyāt | vāruṇyādijayāprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | gurave gāṃ dadāti | atha svapne śuklaṃ pated vāsāṃsi visṛjyānyat paridadhāti | upavyuṣasi grāmāt prācīmudīcīṃ diśamupaniṣkramya nadīṣu snāyāt | samudragānadīsnānāt trirātraṃ phalamaśnute samudragānadīsnānāt pakṣopoṣaṇameva ca saritpatestvamāvāsyāmanantamayane viṣau ityevaṃ snānaṃ yathāvidhi tathā karoti | punarmāmaitvindriyam ityetenānuvā kena japtvā pūto bhavatītyāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||5||
athartusnānād bharturmukhe nānvīkṣamāṇā prayatnādvāharmukhaṃ darśayet na tadahaḥ saṃveśanaṃ kuryāt | yadi saṃveśayet tadaharjāyate putraḥ so'lpāyurdhanavarjitaḥ pañcamyāṃ tu śramedyā vā vandhyāṃ nārīṃ prasūyate ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu yā śramet sādhvī putrapautravatī bhavet saptamyāṃ tu tathā nārī aṣṭamyāṃ ṣaṇmukhopamaḥ paripriyā navamyāṃ tu daśamyāmuttamaḥ sutaḥ ekādaśyāṃ tu duṣṭātmā dvādaśyāṃ tu dhaneśvaraḥ trayodaśyāṃ tu daurbhāgyā caturdaśyaghavān sutaḥ labhet pativratāṃ nārīṃ pañcadaśyāṃ tathaiva ca ṣoḍaśyāṃ labhate putraṃ brahmakīrttiṃ natādṛśam tadūrdhvopayamaṃ nāsti kāmabhogaiva kevalam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ṣoḍaśyantaṃ pratiśramet śuklotkarṣe labhet putraṃ śoṇitasya sriyaṃ labhet nindite'hani saṃveśaṃ na kuryāttu prayatnataḥ yadi pramādāt kuryāccejjapet tāṃ vaiṣṇavīmṛcam keśavādīni nāmāni japettu vividhāni ca agnyagāre tato gatvā hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ evaṃ janmatrayaṃ vāpi śravaṇaṃ ca na saṃviśet parvadvaye ca tatkuryāt śrāddhaṃ dattvā na vāhani somavāre'rkavāre ca bhaumavāre śanaiścare viṣuve ayane caiva vyatīpāte ca saṅkrame etānyanyāni nindyāni divasāni na saṃviśet viṣṭiraṣṭamyathānye ca pakṣacchidrāstathaiva ca ṣoḍaśe dvādaśe vāpi pañcadaśyāṃ tathaiva ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ ca ṣaṣṭhyāmaṣṭama eva ca etānyanyatamaṃ vīkṣya śaucaṃ kuryādyathoditam abhivīkṣya sunakṣatraṃ puṇyaṃ caiva grahodayam prakṣālya pāṇipādau dvāvācamya manasā harim dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam asyā dakṣiṇahastena bhagaṃ caiva pradarśayet śivena tvābhimṛśāmīti śiśnaṃ yonau praveśayet ekayā ṛṣabheṇeti ṛcā samyaganīkṣaṇaḥ yathā ratyantaṃ kṛtvā tathā śaucaṃ kṛtvā paścājjapedṛcaḥ samyak āte yonim iti | ya evaṃ jñātvābhimṛśati sa satputraṃ labhate budhaḥ | evameva māsi māsi ṛtuvelāyāṃ kṛtvā putraṃ cārubuddhimantaṃ baliṣṭaṃ labhate baliṣṭhaṃ labhata ityāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||6||
brahmakūrcaṃ pravakṣyāmi kāyaśodhanamuttamam vedādijayahomaṃ ca mantrahīnamasaṃskṛtam śudrānnabhojane caiva vedānāṃ vikrayeṣu ca kākaśvānāvalīḍhe cotkaṇṭhake mṛgapakṣiṇām pañcamamlecchasaṃsparśe pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam nīlavarṇyāstu gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇāgomayamuddharet tāmravarṇīpayaścaiva śvetāyā dadhireva ca kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam alābhe sarvavarṇānāṃ kapilādekāttu grāhyakam gomūtraikapalaṃ dadyādaṅguṣṭhārdhaṃ tu gomayam kṣīraṃ saptapalaṃ dadyād dadhi tripalameva ca ghṛtamekapalaṃ dadyāt tathaiva ca kuśodakam sāvitryā grāhya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇṇa iti vai dadhi ājyaṃ śukramasītyevaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva ityāloḍya mā nastoke ityabhimantrya praṇavenoddhṛtya praṇavena nirmathya praṇavenaiva pibet | agnaye somāya irāvatī idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame mā nastoke prajāpate gāyatrīṃ ca hutvā madhyamena palāśaparṇena padmapatreṇa tat pibet yat tvagasthigataṃ pāpaṃ dehe niṣṭhati māmake brahmakūrcodakāt sarve dahatyagnirivendhanam | iti ||7||
athāto naimittikāni prāyaścittāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sarvatra vaiṣṇavarcaṃ japet viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pravocam iti | atha karmāntare yadi kṣudhedvā niṣṭhīvedvā sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa iti japati | apa upaspṛśyāṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ dakṣiṇakarṇamupaspṛśet yadi mūtraṃ kuryāt pādau prakṣālyācamya oṃkāraṃ manasā dhyātvā śucirbhūtvā puruṣa evedam̐ sarvam iti dve ṛcau japet | yadi mehet pūrvavacchaucaṃ kṛtvā tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣa iti tisra ṛco japet | yadyaśucisparśe śuddhajalāśaye snātvāma ācamya tasmādyajñātsarvahuta iti catasra ṛco japet | yadi caṇḍālapatitādidarśe apa ācamya ādityamabhivīkṣya brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīt | bāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ | ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ | padbhyām̐ śūdro ajāyata | candramā manaso jātaḥ | cakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata iti tisra ṛco japet | yadi homo madhye vicchinnaḥ syād vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam iti tisra ṛco japet | dve mindāhutī hutvā punaḥ śeṣaṃ samāpayet | yadi pātrāṇi śunādyavalīḍhe dārumayānyagnau prakṣipet mṛṇmayāni cāpsu prakṣipet lohamayāni bhasmanā śudhyanti | anyāni navāni pātrāṇi saṃgṛhya viṣṇo tvanno antamaḥ viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pravocam iti dve ṛcau japet | yanma ātmano mindābhūt punaragniścakṣuradāt imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvanno agne iti ṣaḍāhutīrjuhuyāt | yadyagnimudakyādyavalīḍhe agnimudvāsya pūrvavat śaucaṃ kṛtvā agniṃ mathitvā laukikaṃ vāhṛtya sruksruvau niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā pūrvavat saṃskāraṃ karoti | yadyaraṇyaśucirbhaved anyāmāhṛtyaiva caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā puruṣasūktena manasānudrutya juhoti | yadi sūtako mṛtako bhavet tanmadhye homaṃ na karoti sthālīpākaṃ ca tānyāhāni | vyatīpāte taddravyaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadātītyāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||8||
athāto gṛhyāṇi prāyaścittāni smaryante tāni vakṣyāmaḥ | śeṣāṇi vaitānikāni | ya āhitāgnerdharmassa dharmo ya āhitāgneḥ lokassa auṣāsanikasya iti śāṭyāyanīyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati | tatra ye puroḍāśāsta iha caravaḥ | payodadhipṛṣadājyānām ājyavat saṃskāro na dadhno'dhiśrayaṇaṃ pratyasanaṃ prativeṣaṇam agni raudrarākṣasapaitṛkanairṛtacchedanabhedananirasanātmābhimarśanāni ca kṛtvā apa upaspṛśet | sarvatra skanne bhinne kṣāme dagdhe viparyāse'ntarite ca dve mindāhutī juhuyāt yanma ātmano mindābhūt punaragniścakṣuradād iti | skanne santvā siñcāmi iti skannamabhimantryāpohyāvasicya bhūḥ ityupasthāya askāndyauḥ pṛthivīm iti dve āhutī juhuyāt | ājyaṃ ced devāñjanavanaspatimaṃhasa iti cānumantrya kiñcicca dadyāt | atha bhinne bhūmirbhūmnā iti bhinnamabhimantrya unnambhaya pṛthivīm ityapohyāvasicya trayastriṃśattantava ityetayā juhuyāt | agnau prakṣiped dārumayāṇi | atha kṣāme nirṛtyai tvā iti dagdhamabhimantrya kiñcit tvaṃ parācī tvamavācī tvaṃ rakṣām̐si gaccha iti dakṣiṇāparamuttarāparaṃ vā diśaṃ pratinirasya agnī rakṣām̐si sedhati iti tisra ājyāhutīrjuhuyāt | haviṣāmabhigamanasyaikadeśaṃ ceduddhṛtya tatkṛtvaitayā juhuyāt | etenāśṛtaduḥśṛtau vyākhyātau | apo'bhyavaharet | rudrāya tvā ityaśrṛtamabhimantrya yamāya tvā iti duḥśṛtamatha paristaraṇadāhe agnaye kṣāmavate namo namaḥ kṣāmavanmā mā hiṃsīḥ mā me gṛhaṃ mā me dhanaṃ mā me paśūn ityabhimantrya agnaye kṣāmavate svāhā iti juhuyāt | indraṃ vo viśvataspari iti punaḥ paristirya indrāya svāhā iti juhuyāt | atha paridhidāhe pradāvyāyāgnaye namo namaḥ pradāvyāya iti | samānamata ūrdhvam agneḥ samidasi iti paścārdhaṃ yamasya samidasi iti dakṣiṇārdham somasya samidasi ityuttarārdham | indhānāstvā śataṃ hi mā iti dve āhutī juhuyāt | juṣṭe'nyaṃ paridadhyāt gandharvo'si iti pratimantram | atha viparyāse tvanno agne sa tvanno agne tvamagne ayāsi prajāpate iti catasra āhutīrjuhuyāt | etā evāntarite mano jyotiḥ pañcamīmantaritaṃ ca kuryāt | saṃsthite cet kiñcicca dadyāt | uttarasmin kāla āgate homaśced anivṛttaḥ pūrvasya seyaṃ kālātipattistasyāṃ prāyaścittaṃ mano jyotiḥ iti pūrvasya juhuyāt | tathāparasya juhuyāt | evaṃ pratihomam ā daśarātrāt prāṇāyāmaḥ | ekādaśīprabhṛtyā viṃśatirātrādupavāsastriṃśadrātrādata ūrdhvaṃ prājāpatyaṃ vihitam | ekādaśīprabhṛti tisrastantumatīrdvādaśāhāni vicchinnaḥ punarādheya ityuktamevaṃ vā | atha parvaṇyatīte mano jyotiḥ ayāścāgne yadasmin svasti na indra iti catasra āhutīrhutvāgnaye pathikṛte sthālīpākaṃ kuryāt prāgaṣṭamāt | ata ūrdhvaṃ sopavāsaḥ kāryaḥ dve triṣu ca tisra ityevamatīteṣu prāyaścittaṃ pārvaṇavaddhomaḥ pitṛyajñe'tīte pakṣadvaye copavāsaḥ kārya iti siddham | atha mahāyajñānām ekasminnahani mano jyotiḥ iti dvayostriṣu caturṣu pañcasu vā ṣaṭsu prabhṛtīti tisrastantumatīrhutvā catasro vāruṇīrjapet imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi yatkiñca ava te heḍa ityā navarātrāt | ata ūrdhvamā daśarātrāccatasro'bhyāvartinīrjuhuyāt | sarveṣāmantato vyāhṛtībhiriti siddham ||9||
ata ūrdhvaṃ vānaprasthavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | anavadyaṃ gṛhadharmaṃ caritvā yajñān yajati | putramutpādya saṃskṛtya vedamadhyāpya vṛttiṃ vidhāya guṇavati putre kuḍumbabhāraṃ niyojya uttarāyaṇe pūrvapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre kuśacīracarmavalkalavāsā jaṭī kṛṣṇājinottarīyaḥ kṛtaprasthānaliṅgo'gnimātmasamāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā sapatnīko vāpyapatnīko vā vanamāśrayet | śramaṇamagnimādhāya veṇuśyāmākanīvārādibhirāraṇyamūlaphalairoṣadhībhiḥ sāyaṃprātaragniṃ paricaret | phālākṛṣṭābhiḥ devabrāhmaṇapitṛbhūtamanuṣyayajñānaharaharhutvāraṇyorvā kāle śaktitaḥ śarīraṃ pariśoṣayed yamaniyamamantropavāsādibhiḥ | jīrṇaparṇāhāraḥ dantolūkhalikaḥ śailakuṭṭo ye kāla āgaccheyustebhyo'pi dadyāt | sthaṇḍilaśāyī ūrdhvaretāḥ atithipriyaḥ amatsarī vivādapaiśunyamṛṣāvādavajīṃ sadāśuciḥ grāmasya chadiṃ na darśedaraṇyavāsagniyo'bhayadāyī sarvabhūtānāṃ parairabhimṛṣṭānyāśramāntarahitāni nābhyavaharedekāgniparāyaṇaḥ apramādī sabījāṃ proṣitāṃ bhūmiṃ nākramet | tapodhikāya yajñādhikāya vayodhikāya phalodakaṃ dadyāt | evaṃ mṛgaiḥ saha caritvāparispandyasahavāsī svakālaṃ vyapohya svargalokaṃ gamiṣyatīti | athavā tṛtīyamāyurbhāgaṃ vānaprasthavrataṃ caritvā caturthamāyurbhāgaṃ parivrajedvā ||10||
athātaḥ saṃnyāsavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre pūrvakālamupoṣya saṃbhārānupakalpayate | kāpāyavāsasī plakṣapavitrapādukāsanavaiṇavadaṇḍaśikyakamaṇḍalvalāvupātraṃ kuśabandhamityevamādisaṃbhārānupakalpayate | agnimāropya vanād grāmaṃ praviśya keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayitvā nadīṣu snāyāt śuddhe jalāśaye vā | apa ācamya nadītīre devagṛhe vā brāhmaṇānabhigamyākrodhano'dveṣaṇaḥ sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyaset | na veda saṃnyaset | vedasaṃnyāsācchūdro bhavati | tasmād vedaṃ na saṃnyaset | brāhmaṇasannidhau mantramuktvāpaḥ pibet saṃnyastaṃ mayā iti | gṛhasthenopanītān vaiṇavāntān saṃbhārān parigṛhya savitṛmaṇḍalamudvīkṣamāṇaḥ saṃnyastaṃ mayā iti trirucaiḥ prabrūyāt | atha brāhmaṇaṃ nivītaṃ bahuyājinamabhigamya daṇḍāndātavā ityuktvā daṇḍān parigṛhya kṛtanāmānikṛto'nujñāto yaterdharmān samyak paricaret nityaśikhī nityayajñopavītī nityasandhyopāsī nityaprātaḥsnāyī nityaṃ bhaikṣāśī nityaṃ yamaniyamayantravratopavāsī nityamīśraropāsī nityaṃ godevagṛhavāsī apagatabhayakāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryaḥ iti | evamādidharmaṃ caritvā svargalokaṃ gamiṣyati | athavā brāhmaṇeṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu pūrvavacchaucaṃ kṛtvā sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyasya praiṣaṇamapo'śnāti | īśvaramevopāsya pūto bhavatītyāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||11||
punarupanayanaṃvyākhyāsyāmaḥ yaḥpāṇigrahādiragniḥ athagṛhasthasyadvebhārye athagṛhyaprāyaścittānijuhoti athabrahmacāryavakīrṇī bhavati athartusnānāt brahmakūrcaṃ pravakṣyāmi athātonaimittikāni athātogṛhyāṇiprāyaścittāni ataūrdhvaṃvānaprasthavidhim athātaḥsaṃnyāsavidhim ekādaśa |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre dvitīyapraśne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ dvitīyaḥ praśnaḥ samāptaḥ
<3 tṛtīyaḥ praśnaḥ>
<3.1 prathamo'dhyāyaḥ>
amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe māsikam aparapakṣasya vāyukṣvahassu pitṛbhyo'nnaṃ saṃskṛtya dakṣiṇāgrān darbhānāsanāni kalpayitvā brāhmaṇān śucīn mantravataḥ samāṅgānayugmānāmantrayate | yonigotramantrasambandhān arthāpekṣo na bhojayet | agnimupasamādhāya dakṣiṇāprāgagrairdarbhaiḥ paristīrya ekapavitrāntarhitāyāmājyasthālyāmājyaṃ nirupya saṃskṛtya tataḥ apasavyaṃ pariṣiñcati | audumbaramidhmamabhyādhāya audumbaryā darvyā juhoti | ājyabhāgāntaṃ kṛtvā prācīnāvītī pitṝnāvāhayati āyāta pitaraḥ saumyā gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pūrvyaiḥ prajāmasmabhyaṃ dadato rayiṃ ca dīrghāyutvaṃ ca śataśāradaṃ ca iti | etāmeva diśamabhyapaḥ prasiñcati āpo devīḥ prahiṇutāgnimete yajñaṃ pitaro no juṣantām | āsīnāmūrjamuta ye bhajante te no rayiṃ sarvavīrān niyacchatāt iti | vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā prācīnāvītī juhoti somāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ svāhā | yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ svāhā | yāḥ prācīḥ saṃbhavantyāpa uttarataśca yāḥ | adbhirviśvasya bhuvanasya bhartrībhirantaranyaṃ piturdadhe svadhā namaḥ svāhā | antardadhe parvatairantarmahyā pṛthivyā | divā digbhiranantābhirūtibhirantaranyaṃ pitāmahāddadhe svadhā namaḥ svāhā | antardadha ṛtubhiḥ sarvairahorātraiḥ sasandhibhiḥ | ardhamāsaiśca māsaiścāntaranyaṃ prapitāmahāddadhe svadhā namaḥ svāhā | atha nāmadheyairjuhoti amuṣmai svadhā namo'muṣmai svadhā nama iti | yanme mātā pralulobha caratyananuvratā tanme retaḥ pitā vṛṅktāmābhuranyo'vapadyatāṃ svadhā namaḥ svāhā | evaṃ dvitīyam | tathā tṛtīyam | yanme pitāmahī yanme prapitāmahī iti mantraṃ sannamati ||1||
ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yām̐śca vidma yām̐ uca na pravidya | agne tān vettha yadi te jātavedastayā prattaṃ svadhayā madanti kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā | yadvaḥ kravyādaṅgamadahallokānanayan praṇayan jātavedāḥ | tadvo'haṃ punarāvedayāmyariṣṭāḥ sarvairaṅgaiḥ saṃbhavantu pitaraḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā | vahājyaṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatraitān vettha nihitān parāke | ājyamasya kūlyā upa tāṃ kṣarantu satyā eṣāmāśiṣaḥ santu kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā | evaṃ dvitīyaṃ tathā tṛtīyam | pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhya iti mantraṃ sannamati | evamannasya juhoti | vahānnam iti mantraṃ sannamati | atha sauviṣṭakṛtīṃ juhoti agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā nama iti | dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe hutvānuprahṛtya darvīmathānnamabhimṛśati pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇastvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayorjuhomyakṣitamasi mā pitṝṇāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmin loke pṛthivīṃ samantassame'gnirupadraṣṭā dattasyāpramādāya ṛcaste mahimā | pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇastvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayorjuhomyakṣitamasi mā pitāmahānāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmin loke'ntarikṣaṃ samantassame vāyurupaśrotā dattasyāpramādāya yajūm̐ṣi te mahimā | pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇastvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayorjuhomyakṣitamasi mā prapitāmahānāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmin loke dyauḥ samantassame ādityo'nukhyātā dattasyāpramādāya sāmāni te mahimā iti | brāhmaṇānupasparśayati | bhuktavato'nuvṛttyā śeṣam anujñāpya ||2||
udakumbhaṃ darbhamuṣṭiṃ cādāya dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān paristīrya teṣvavācīnapāṇirdakṣiṇāpavargāṃstrīnudapātrānupari ninayati mārjayantāṃ pitaraḥ saumyāsaḥ mārjayantāṃ pitāmahāḥ saumyāsaḥ mārjayantāṃ prapitāmahāḥ saumyāsaḥ iti | asāvavaneniṅkṣva asāvavaneniṅkṣva iti vā teṣvavācīnapāṇirdakṣiṇāpavargān trīn piṇḍān dadāti | etatte tata asau iti pitre piṇḍaṃ dadāti etatte pitāmaha asau iti pitāmahāya etatte prapitāmaha asau iti prapitāmahāya | tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | sa kṛtākṛto vā | yadi nāmadheyāni na vidyāt svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthivīṣadbhya iti pitre piṇḍaṃ dadāti | svadhā pitāmahebhyo'ntarikṣasadbhya iti pitāmahāya | svadhā prapitāmahebhyo diviṣadbhya iti prapitāmahāya | atrāñjanābhyañjane vāsaścānupiṇḍaṃ dadāti | āṅkṣvāsāvāṅkṣvāsau iti trirāñjanam | abhyaṅkṣvāsāvabhyaṅkṣvāsau iti trirabhyañjanam | etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsāṃsyato no'nyat pitaro mā yoḍhum etāni vaḥ pitāmahā vāsāṃsyato no'nyat pitāmahā mā yoḍhum etāni vaḥ prapitāmahā vāsāṃsyato no'nyat prapitāmahā mā yoḍhum iti daśāmūrṇāstukāṃ vā chittvā nyasyati pūrve vayasi svaṃ loma chittvā uttare | atha pātraṃ saṃkṣipya ninayati putrān pautrānabhitarpayantīrāpo madhumatīrimāḥ | svadhāṃ pitṛbhyo'mṛtaṃ duhānā āpo devīrubhayām̐starpayantu iti | nyubjapātraṃ pāṇī vyatyasya namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya iti ṣaḍbhirnamaskārairupatiṣṭhate | udakāntaṃ gatvā trirudakāñjalidānenodakāñjalīn dadāti eṣa te tata piturmadhumām̐ ūrmiḥ sarasvān yāvānagniśca pṛthivī ca tāvatyasya mātrā tāvānasya mahimā tāvantamenaṃ bhūtaṃ dadāmi yathāgnirakṣito'nupadasta evaṃ me tatāya pitre'kṣito'nupadastaḥ svadhā bhavatāṃ tvam̐ svadhāmakṣitaṃ taiḥ sahopajīvāsau ṛcaste mahimā eṣa te pitāmaha piturmadhumām̐ ūrmiḥ sarasvān yāvān vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ ca tāvatyasya mātrā tāvānasya mahimā tāvantamenaṃ bhūtaṃ dadāmi yathā vāyurakṣito'nupadasta evaṃ me pitāmahāya pitre'kṣito'nupadastaḥ svadhā bhavatāṃ tvam̐ svadhāmakṣitaṃ taiḥ sahopajīvāsau yajūm̐ṣi te mahimā | eṣa te prapitāmaha piturmadhumām̐ ūrmiḥ sarasvān yāvānādityaśca dyauśca tāvatyasya mātrā tāvānasya mahimā tāvantamenaṃ bhūtaṃ dadāmi yathādityo'kṣito'nupadastaḥ evaṃ me prapitāmahāya pitre'kṣito'nupadastaḥ svadhā bhavatāṃ tyam̐ svadhāmakṣitaṃ taiḥ sahopajīvāsau sāmāni te mahimā iti | pratyetya pratiṣṭhitamudapātreṇāpa upapravartayati parāyāta pitaraḥ saumyā gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pūrvyaiḥ prajāmasmabhyaṃ dadato rayim | atha māsi punarāyāta no gṛhān havirattuṃ suprajasaḥ suvīrāḥ iti | etena arghyāvarṣa vyākhyātatantram | māṃsaṃ niyataṃ māṃsābhāve śākam ||3||
amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe yecehapitaraḥ udakumbhaṃdarbhamuṣṭiṃ trīṇi
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.2 dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ>
aṣṭakāṃ kariṣyamāṇa upakalpayate ukṣāṇaṃ vā vehataṃ vrīhīnannaṃ madhuśca sarpiśca | prasiddhaṃ śaucam | anūrādhāyāmagnimupasamādhāya paristīryāpareṇāgniṃ vrīhīnekapavitro'tha nirvapati imamapūpaṃ catuśśarāvaṃ virvapāmi kleśāpahaṃ pitṝṇāṃ saṃparāye | devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pitṛbhyastvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi iti pitṛbhyastvā pitṛbhyastvā ityevaṃ catuśśarāvaṃ nirvapati | prokṣya tūṣṇīṃ haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjya yathā puroḍāśamevamevaitamapūpaṃ padakapālamadhiśrayati | ekakapālaṃ vā | śṛte tasminnājyaṃ dadhi vilāpyotpūyātha pariṣiñcati adite'numanyasva iti dakṣiṇataḥprācīnam anumate'numanyasva iti paścādudīcīnaṃ sarasvate'numanyasva iti uttarataḥprācīnaṃ deva savitaḥ prasuva iti sarvataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṣicyāghārāvāghārya ājyabhāgau juhoti | ājyena prāyaścittaṃ juhoti yā tiraścī nipadyase'haṃ maryādā vidharaṇī iti | tāṃ tvā ghṛtasya dhārayā juhomi vaiśvakarmaṇīṃ kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | ||1||
athaitasyāpūpasya madhyādavadāyopastīrṇābhighāritamaudumbaryā darvyā juhoti | apūpaṃ juhoti ghṛtavantamadya svadhāvantaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇāya vaha havyaṃ pitṛbhya āhutīrjuhomi kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti atha purastāddakṣiṇato'vadāya paścādarṣīyo juhoti iyameva sā yā prathamā vyaucchadantarasyāṃ carati praviṣṭā | vadhūrjajāna navagajjanitrī traya enāṃ mahimānaḥ sacante kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | tṛtīyāṃ juhoti aulūkhalā grāvāṇo ghoṣamakrata apaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇām | ekāṣṭake suprajā vīravanto vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇām kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | caturthīṃ juhoti yāṃ janāḥ pratinandanti rātriṃ dhenumivāyatī | saṃvatsarasya yā nī patnī sā no astu sumaṅgalā kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | pañcamīṃ juhoti prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni paritā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇāṃ kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | ṣaṣṭhīṃ juhoti yadasya karmaṇo'tyarīricaṃ yadvā nyūnamihākaram | agniṣṭat sviṣṭakṛdvidvān sarvam̐ sviṣṭaṃ suhutaṃ karotu me agnaye sviṣṭakṛta suhutahute sarvahute sarvaprāyaścittāhutīnāṃ kāmānāṃ samardhayitre kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | davīṃ prakṣālya nidhāya tathaiva parimṛjya pariṣicya piṇḍāvṛtaitān piṇḍān dattvātraitamapūpaṃ ghṛtavantaṃ madhumantaṃ śraddhābhimarśanenābhimṛśati ||2||
pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇastvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayorjuhomyakṣitamasi mā pitṝṇāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmin loke pṛthivī samantassame'gnirupadraṣṭā dattasyāpramādāya ṛcaste mahimā | pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇastvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayorjuhomyakṣitamasi mā pitāmahānāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmin loke'ntarikṣaṃ samantassame vāyurupaśrotā dattasyāpramādāya yajūm̐ṣi te mahimā | pṛthivī te pātraṃ dyaurapidhānaṃ brahmaṇastvā mukhe juhomi brāhmaṇānāṃ tvā vidyāvatāṃ prāṇāpānayorjuhomyakṣitamasi mā prapitāmahānāṃ kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmin loke dyauḥ samantassame ādityo'nukhyātā dattasyāpramādāya sāmāni te mahimā ityetena | brāhmaṇān vidyāvataḥ pariviśati | pariviśyodakāya gatvodakāñjalidānenodakāñjalīn dadāti eṣa te tata piturmadhumām̐ ūrmissarasvān yāvānagniśca pṛthivī ca tāvatyasya mātrā tāvānasya mahimā tāvantamenaṃ bhūtaṃ dadāmi yathāgnirakṣito'nupadastaḥ evaṃ me tatāya pitre'kṣito'nupadastaḥ svadhā bhavatāṃ tvam̐ svadhāmakṣitaṃ taiḥ sahopajīvāsāvṛcaste mahimā ||3||
eṣa te pitāmaha piturmadhumām̐ ūrmissarasvān yāvān vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ ca tāvatyasya mātrā tāvānasya mahimā tāvantamenaṃ bhūtaṃ dadāmi yayā vāyurakṣito'nupadasta evaṃ me pitāmahāya pitre'kṣito'nupadastaḥ svadhā bhavatāṃ tvam̐ svadhāmakṣitaṃ taiḥ sahopajīvāsau yajūm̐ṣi te mahimā | eṣa te prapitāmaha piturmadhumām̐ ūrmissarasvān yāvānādityaśca dyauśca tāvatyasya mātrā tāvānasya mahimā tāvantamenaṃ bhūtaṃ dadāmi yathādityo'kṣito'nupadasta evaṃ me prapitāmahāya pitre'kṣito'nupadastaḥ svadhā bhavatāṃ tvam̐ svadhāmakṣitaṃ taiḥ sahopajīvāsau sāmāni te mahimā iti | etāvadetat tadahaḥkarma bhavati | etaddhasma vai tadvidvāṃsaḥ pūrva ṛṣaya evamaṣṭakyamapūpaṃ catuśśarāvamevamakalpayaṃstena vaite pitṝnatarpayaṃsta enāṃstṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhiratarpayaṃstato ha pitṛbhirmitramakurvata mitraṃ hyeṣāṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyāsan | sa yo ha vā evaṃ vidvān aitamaṣṭakyamapūpaṃ catuśśarāvamevaṃ kalpayati | tena vai sa pitṝṃstarpayati yena tṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhistarpayanti | ato ha pitṛbhirmitraṃ kurute | mitraṃ hyasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavanti | ya evaṃ vidvān etamaṣṭakyamapūpaṃ catuśśarāvamevaṃ kalpayati ||4||
śvo jyeṣṭhāyāmagnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya tathaiva pariṣicyāghārāvāghāryājyabhāgau juhoti | prāyaścittīyāṃ hutvopākaraṇīyāṃ juhoti imāṃ pitṛbhyo gāmupākarotyūrjasvatīṃ svadhāvatīṃ tanme juṣantāṃ pitaraḥ paretāḥ | sā me pitṝn saṃparāye dhinotu kāmaiḥ svāhā iti | athaibhyo gāmṛpākaroti pitṛbhyastvā juṣṭāmupākaromi iti | athaināṃ prokṣati pitṛbhyastvā juṣṭāṃ prokṣāmi iti | tāmatraiva pratīcīnaśirasaṃ dakṣiṇāpadīṃ saṃjñapayanti | tasyai saṃjñaptāyā adbhiḥ prāṇān āpyāyayati tūṣṇīm | athāsyai vapāmuddhṛtya viśālayopatṛṇatti tūṣṇīmeva athāsyai hṛdayamuddhārayanti prajñāte ca matasne | tānyeteṣveva śūleṣu saṃpraṇīkṣyaitasminnevāgnau śrapayanti | śṛteṣu tredhā vapāṃ vicchidyodumbaradarvyā upastīrṇābhighāritāṃ juhoti vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatraitān vettha nihitān parāke | medasaḥ kūlyā upa tān kṣarantu satyā eṣāmāśiṣaḥ santu kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | athaitasya māṃsasyopastaraṇābhighāritaudumbaryā darvyopaghātaṃ juhoti ||5||
ekāṣṭakāṃ paśyata dohamānāmannaṃ māṃsavad ghṛtavat svadhāvat | tad brāhmaṇairatipūtamanantamakṣayyaṃ sphītiṃ gacchatu kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | dvitīyāṃ juhoti ekāṣṭakā tapasā tapyamānā saṃvatsarasya patnī duduhe prapīnā | tāṃ dohamupajīvātha pitaraḥ sahasradhā mucyamānāṃ kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | tṛtīyāṃ juhoti ekāṣṭakā tapasā tapyamānā jajāna garbhaṃ mahimānamindram | tena dasyūn vyasahanta devā hantāsurāṇāmabhavacchacībhiḥ kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | caturthīṃ juhoti aulūkhalā grāvāṇa iti | pañcamīṃ juhoti yāṃ janāḥ pratinandanti iti | ṣaṣṭhīṃ juhoti prajāpate iti | saptamīṃ juhoti yadasya karmaṇo'tyarīricam iti | darvīṃ prakṣālya nidhāya tathaiva pariṣicya piṇḍāvṛtaitān piṇḍān dattvā śraddhābhimarśanenābhimṛśati pṛthivī te pātram ityetena | brāhmaṇān vidyāvataḥ pariviśati | pariviśyodakāya gatvodakāñjalidānenodakāñjaliṃ dadāti eṣa te tata pituḥ iti | etāvadevaitadahaḥkarma bhavati | etaddhasma vaitadvidvāṃsaḥ pūrva ācāryā evamaṣṭakyāṃ gāmevamakalpayaṃstayā vaite pitṝnatarpayaṃsta enāṃstṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhiratarpayan tato ha pitṛbhirmitramakurvata mitraṃ hyeṣāṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyāsan | sa yo ha vā evaṃ vidvānetāmaṣṭakyāṃ gāmevaṃ kalpayati | tena vai sa pitṝṃstarpayati | te yena tṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhistarpayanti | ato ha pitṛbhirmitraṃ kurute mitraṃ hyasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavanti | ya evaṃ vidvānetāmaṣṭakyāṃ gāmevaṃ kalpayati ||6||
tṛtīye'hni bhūyo'tha śrāddhamannaṃ ca dhanaṃ ca kalpayitvāgnimupasamādhāya paristīrya tathaiva pariṣicyāghārāvāghāryājyabhāgau hutvājyena prāyaścittīyāṃ hutvāthaitasyānnasyopastīrṇābhighāritaudumbaryā darvyā juhoti vahānnaṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatraitānvettha nihitān parāke | annasya kūlyā upa tān kṣarantu satyā eṣāmāśiṣaḥ santu kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | dvitīyāṃ juhoti saṃvatsarasya pratimāṃ yāṃ tvā rātryupāsate | prajāṃ suvīrāṃ kṛtvā viśvamāyurvyaśnuvat kāmaiḥ svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti | tṛtīyāṃ juhoti yāṃ janāḥ pratinandanti iti | caturthīṃ juhoti prajāpate iti | pañcamīṃ juhoti yadasya karmaṇo'tyarīricam iti anuprahṛtya darvīṃ tathaiva pariṣicya piṇḍāvṛtaitān piṇḍāna dattvā śraddhābhimarśanenābhimṛśati pṛthivī te pātram ityetena | brāhmaṇān vidyāvataḥ pariviśati | pariviśyodakāya gatvodakāñjalidānenodakāñjaliṃ dadāti | eṣa te tata iti | etāvadevaitadahaḥkarma bhavati | etaddhasma vaitadvidvāṃsaḥ pūrve śrotriyā evamaṣṭakyamannamevamakalpayaṃstena vaite pitṝnatarpayaṃsta enāṃstṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhiratarpayan tato ha pitṛbhirmitramakurvata mitraṃ hyeṣāṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyāsan sa yo ha vā evaṃ vidvānetamaṣṭakyamannamevaṃ kalpayati | tena vai sa pitṝṃstarpayati | te yena tṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhistarpayanti | ato ha pitṛbhirmitraṃ kurute mitraṃ hyasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavanti | ya evaṃ vidvān tṛtīye'hni yathāśraddhamannaṃ ca dhanaṃ ca dadāti tato vai tasyāparimitānnadhanāḥ paśavo bhavanti | ya evaṃ vidvān tṛtīye'hni yathāśraddhamannaṃ dhanaṃ ca na dadāti tasyāparimitānnadhanā na vai paśavo bhavanti ||7||
aṣṭakāṃkariṣyamāṇaḥ athapurastāddakṣiṇato'vadāya pṛthivītepātraṃ eṣatepitāmahapituḥ śvojyeṣṭhāyām ekāṣṭakāṃ tṛtīye'hni sapta
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.3 tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ>
athātaḥ śrāddhaśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | pūrvedyuḥ sāyamaupāsanaṃ hutvā prāṇāsāyamya saṃkalpya śvaḥ pitṛbhyo māsiśrāddhaṃ kariṣya iti vā śvo yajñaśarmaṇaḥ nakṣatraśrāddhaṃ kariṣya iti vā śvo yajñaśarmaṇaḥ tripakṣaśrāddhaṃ kariṣya iti vā śvo yajñaśarmaṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsaśrāddhaṃ kariṣya iti vā śvo yajñaśarmaṇaḥ saṃvatsaraśrāddhaṃ kariṣya iti vā śvo yajñaśarmaṇaḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaśrāddhaṃ kariṣya iti vā saṃkalpya brāhmaṇān śucīn śrotriyān daridrān vedajñān samāṅgān agotrānasamānārṣeyān kṣaṇaṃ karoti | dvau viśvedevebhyaḥ trayaḥ pitṝṇām | sapiṇḍīśrāddhaṃ cedeko'dhikam | pretaśrāddheṣvekameva varayet | śvaḥ pitṛbhyo māsiśrāddhaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tasya bhavatā prasādaḥ karaṇīya iti evameva śvaḥ pitṛbhyo'ṣṭakāśrāddhaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tasya bhavatā prasādaḥ karaṇīya iti śvaḥ pitṛbhyo nityaśrāddham ekoddiṣṭaṃ nakṣatraśrāddhamiti sarvatroktvā gandhādibhirārādhya tilapiṣṭādibhirbhakṣyadravyairyathāvakāśo'sti tathārādhya tāmbūlādi dadyāt | śvobhūte prātaraupāsanaṃ hutvāvaṭau khanati | pretaśrāddheṣvekameva khanati | sapiṇḍīkaraṇe trīn khātvā avaṭe tiladarbhān prakīrya brāhmaṇānāhūya kṣaṇaṃ karoti | uttare'vaṭe viśvedevayoḥ pādān prakṣālya madhyame pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇe pratasya pādau prakṣālya tānārādhya tāmbūlaṃ dadyāt | pādaprakṣālanakrameṇa sarvaṃ kuryāt prācīnāvītī | aparāhṇe brāhmaṇabhojanārthamaupāsane sthālīpākaṃ kuryāt | pitṝṇāmāvāhanakāle prācīnāvītī dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ sthitvā āvāhya brāhmaṇānāhūya yathoktaṃ diṅmukhamupaveśayati | yathāvidhi hutvā yatra yatrokteṣu piṇḍāvṛtaitān piṇḍān dadāti | pātrasādanakāle ekasmin pātre ā pa āgantu pitaro devayānān samudrān salilān savarṇān | asmin yajñe sarvakāmān labhante'kṣīyamāṇamupaduhyantām imāṃ pitṛbhyo vo'rghyaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyo vo'rghyaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyo vo'rghyaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti prapitāmahebhyaḥ athānyasmin pātre pretāya te gṛhṇāmi iti pretāya apa ānayati | tilo'si somadevatyo gosave devanirmitaḥ | pratnavadbhiḥ prattaḥ svadha ehi pitṝnimān lokān prīṇayāhi naḥ svadhā namaḥ iti tilānāvapati | pitāmahān prapitāmahān imān lokān prīṇayāhi naḥ svadhā namaḥ iti ca | pretāya imān lokān iti ca ||1||
madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ | madhu jaktamutoṣasi madhumatpārthivam̐ rajaḥ | madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā | madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumām̐ astu sūryaḥ |
