mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu na iti madhvānayati | kuśalavamādāya somāsya tviṣirasi taveva me tviṣirbhūyādamṛtamasi mṛtyormā pāhi didyonmā pāhyaveṣṭā dantaśūkā iti mathitvā nirastaṃ namuceḥ śiraḥiti phenaṃ nirasya darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhaiḥ pracchādya śanno devīḥ ityavokṣya gandhādibhiralaṅkṛtya svadhāṃ yatra guptaṃ manyate tatra nidadhāti | pūrvavat pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā yathodaṅmukhānupaveśya viśvedevān kṣaṇaṃ karoti viśvedevāḥ kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti | prativacanam oṃ tathā ityuktvā prāpnotu bhavān ityāha prāpnavāni itītare pratyāhuḥ | māsiśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti māsi aṣṭakāśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya ityaṣṭakāsu nityaśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti nityaśrāddhe ekoddiṣṭaśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya ityekoddiṣṭe nakṣatraśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti nakṣatre tripakṣaśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti tripakṣe ṣaṇmāsaśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti ṣaṇmāse saṃvatsaraśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti saṃvatsare sapiṇḍīkaraṇaśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kartavya iti sapiṇḍīkaraṇe prativacanam oṃ tathā ityuktvā prāpnotu bhavān ityāha prāpnavāni itītare pratyāhuḥ | tebhyo gandhādibhirārādhya svadhāpātramārādhya vastrayugmaṃ kuṇḍalamaṅgulīyakaṃ ca dattvāthānnamabhimṛśati pṛthivī te pātram iti | bhuñjānān samīkṣate prāṇe niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi iti | brahmaṇi ma ātmāmṛtatvāya iti | pitṛliṅgaiḥ ṛgyajurbhiḥ śrāvayet | ācāntebhyastilodakaṃ pradāya pavitraṃ pitṛhaste nidhāya svadhāmānayati pitṛbhyo haste svadhāstu iti | astu svadhā iti prativacanam | evaṃ pitāmahāyaivam prapitāmahāyaivaṃ pretāya | tathaiva śuddhodakaṃ pradāya astu śuddhodakam iti prativacanam | yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā annaśeṣaiḥ kiṃ kriyatām iti iṣṭaiḥ sahopabhujyatām iti prativacanam | pratyetya śeṣaṃ sagaṇaḥ prāśnāti | yadi nityaśrāddhaṃ kurvan śaśaṃ vā mṛgaṃ vā kūrmaṃ vopākaroti śrapayitvā hiraṇyena parikrīya vā yathāṣṭakāsu dvitīye'hni tathā karoti | ekoddiṣṭavat tripakṣaśrāddhaṃ kurvanti | tripakṣavat ṣaṇmāsaśrāddhaṃ kurvanti | ṣaṇmāsavat saṃvatsaraśrāddhaṃ kurvanti | evamā saṃvatsarāt pretasya dahananakṣatreṣvevamevaṃ kurvanti ||2||
athā taḥ śrāddhaśeṣaṃvakṣyāmo madhuvātāṛtāyate iti dve |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.4 caturtho'dhyāyaḥ>
athāto dahanavidhiḥ | āhitāgneranāhitāgneḥ striyāścaiva maraṇasaṃśaye śucau same deśe gomayenopalipya avokṣya sikatābhiravakīrya tāsu dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣu dakṣiṇāśirasamenaṃ nidhāyāsvadhāyuktā brahmāṇyabhiśrāvayet āyuṣaḥ prāṇam̐ santanu iti | atha prāṇeṣūtkrānteṣu prācīnāvītyavācīnapāṇiḥ hiraṇyaśakalamāsye pratyasyāṅguṣṭhabandhaṃ prabadhya grāmyeṇālaṅkāreṇālaṅkṛtya pattodaśenāhatena vāsasā pracchādya sāyamāhutiṃ hutvā mātarāhutiṃ hutvā paurṇamāsyeneṣṭvāmāvāsyeneṣṭvātha gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā prāgudetya samidvatyāhavanīye juhoti mṛtyoradhiṣṭhānāya svāhā iti | caturo brāhmaṇān bāhayitvā grāmābhimukhena catuṣpathe nidhāya mukhaṃ darśayitvā śmaśānābhimukhena vāhayitvā śmaśānaṃ nirhṛtya sahāgnibhiḥ pretaṃ tatrainaṃ nidhāya dahanaṃ joṣayet dakṣiṇāpratyakpravaṇamabhaṅguramaniriṇamasuṣiraṃ samaṃ vā | apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto ye'tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ | ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktairyamo dadātvavasānamasmai iti hariṇyā palāśaśākhayaudumbaraśākhayā vā sataṃ sammṛjya dakṣiṇataḥ śākhāṃ nirasya apa upaspṛśyādbhiravokṣya hiraṇyaśakalamavadhāya apasarpata pretā ye ke ceha pūrvajāḥ svasti naḥ kuruta māśrupātaḥ punarāgamat iti dakṣiṇāpavargāḥ sphyena paraśunā vā tisraḥ karṣūḥ khātvādbhiravokṣya tilataṇḍulānāṃ muṣṭiṃ pūrayitvā yamāya pitṛpataye pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā nama iti prathamāyāṃ nivapati | evaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ tathā tṛtīyāyām | śeṣāṃstilataṇḍulān yadyāhitāgnirbhavati tasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ chittvā dakṣiṇāgrīvamadharalomāstṛṇāti | etasmin kāle snātvodakenauṣadhībhiśca kumbhaṃ pūrayitvā tena daśahotrā pattogrāt snāpayet | athāhataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpyālaṅkṛtya tataścitāmāropyātha saptaprāṇāyataneṣu sapta hiraṇyaśakalān pratyasyālābha ājyabindūnvā mukhe prathamamāsye dadhitaṇḍulāṃśca tilāṃśca juhoti idaṃ ta ātmanaḥ śarīramayaṃ ta ātmanasta ātmānaṃ śarīrād brahma nirbhinadmi bhūrbhuvaḥsvarasau svargāya lokāya svāhā iti | daśahotāraṃ cittiḥ srug ityādi grahavarjamevamevāgre nāsikācchidrayordvirjapet | āsīditi sarveṣu hotṛpadeṣvanuṣajatyanyatra ṣaḍḍhotṛpadebhyaḥ | āstāmiti dvivacanādiṣu | caturhotāraṃ pṛthivī hotā iti mukhe sṛkkikaṭayordviḥ pañcahotāram agnirhotā iti karṇayordviṣṣaḍḍhotāraṃ sūryam ta iti kīkasāsu dvissaptahotāraṃ mahāhavirhotā iti ||1||
athājyāni gṛhṇīte darśapūrṇamāsavat tūṣṇīṃ juhvāṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhyupabhṛti dadhi madhu ghṛtamiti dhruvāyāṃ payo'gnihotrahavaṇyām | apivājyameva sarvāsu | atra pātrāṇyupacinoti | yāni pātrāṇyāsecanavanti tāni sampūrayitvābhyukṣatītarāṇyariktatāyā iti vijñāyate | tasya dakṣiṇahaste juhūṃ sphyaṃ cādadhāti | savya upabhṛtamurasi dhruvāmupaveṣamaraṇīṃ ca mukhe'gnihotrahavaṇīṃ nāsikayoḥ sruvāvājyasruvau vā karṇayoḥ prāśitraharaṇaṃ bhittvaikaikam | hanvorulūkhalamusale datsu grāvāṇo bhavanti | śirasi kapālāni | lalāṭa ekakapālamudare ḍṣṭisaṃyavanīṃ pātrīṃ nābhyāmājyasthālīṃ patta upāvaharaṇīyaṃ kūrcaṃ śirasta upasādanīyaṃ kūrcaṃ pārśvayoḥ śūrpaṃ chittvaikaikaṃ vā ghrāṇayoḥ sānnāyyakumbhyau yadi sannayan bhavati aṇḍayordṛṣadupale śiśne vṛṣaravaṃ śamyāṃ ca pṛṣṭhayoragnihotrasthālīmanvāhāryasthālīm iḍāpātraṃ vedaṃ śikhāyām | athavāvaśiṣṭānyantareṇa sakthinī nivapati | tasya kṛṣṇājinaśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇāgrīvamuttaralomnā pracchādya bāndhavāḥ sigvātenopavījayanti | trayaḥ sigvātā bhavanti grāme pathi citāyāṃ ca | vātāste vāntu pathi puṇyagandhā manaḥśubhā gātraśubhā anulomāḥ | tvacassukhā māṃsasukhā asthisaukhyā vahantu tvā marutaḥ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ iti ||2||
yadyāhitāgnirbhavati apa naḥ śośucadagham ityaṅguṣṭhabandhaṃ visṛjya patnyudakumbhamādāyādhvaryurvā śīrṣannadhinidhāya trirapasalaiḥ pariṣiñcan paryeti | kiñcit paraśunā praharati | atha dhārāmanumantrayate imā āpo madhumatyo'smiṃste loka upaduhyantām iti | dvitīyaṃ parigatāyāṃ paścāt praharati imā āpo madhumatyo'ntarikṣe te loka upaduhyantām iti | tṛtīyaṃ parigatāyāṃ paścāt praharati imā āpo madhumatyaḥ svarge te loka upaduhyantām iti | bhinatti kṛmbham | yadi purastāt patati pāpīyān bhavati yadi paścāt patati vasīyān bhavati iti | atha kapālaśeṣā apaḥ pretasya prāṇasthāneṣu ninayati divi jātā apsu jātā iti | ārdrā oṣadhīrālabhyottiṣṭhati | gāṃ paśyati | brāhmaṇān paśyati | hiraṇyamālabhate | atra gurave varaṃ dadāti ||3||
athāsmā adhvaryurdakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśyāhavanīyamādīpayati nairṛtyāmanvāhāryapacanaṃ vāyavyāṃ gārhapatyamuttarataḥ sabhyāvasakthyau | saṃbhāraiḥ agniryajurbhiḥ patnībhiḥ senendrasya ityetaiḥ upoṣayet | grahaiḥ vācaspate vidhe nāman vācaspate vāco vīryeṇa somaḥ somasya vācaspate'cchidrayā vācā vācaspate hṛdidhe nāman ityetaiḥ ṛtumukhīyena vāgghotā ityetena brāhmaṇa ekahotā iti copasthānam | āhavanīya ekeṣāṃ kapālaḥ | santapanāgninā vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti | tamabhinivartate yaṃ gharmo'gnirabhijihartti yāṃ gatiṃ yānti yudhi yuddhaśūrā vidhṛtapāpā virajā viśokāstāṃ gatiṃ yāhi surabhirnākapṛṣṭhaḥ svadhā nama iti | yadyanāhitāgnirbhavati yāṃ gatiṃ yānti yudhi yuddhaśurāstanutyajo mokṣavido manīṣinaḥ sukṛtino'gnihotrahaviṣṭhāstāṃ gatiṃ yāhi surabhirnākapṛṣṭhaḥ svadhā nama iti | tato yajñopavītī saṃ tvā siñcāmi yajuṣā iti śāntiṃ kṛtvā jyotiṣmatyā ādityamupatiṣṭhate udvayaṃ tamasaspari udutyaṃ citram iti | putrabhrātṛsapiṇḍāḥ saṃviśanti | anavekṣamāṇāstīrthamāyānti | rājapuruṣo vā tānasagotro vā parṇaśākhayā śamīśākhayaudumbaraśākhayā vārayati mā tarata iti | na punarāgamiṣyāmaha ityuktvāturavyañjanāni kṛtvā keśāna saṃprakīrya pāṃsūnopyaikavāsaso'hatavāsaso vā dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ sakṛdunmajjyottīrya savyaṃ jānuṃ bhūmau nidhāya vāsaḥ pīḍayitvotthāyāñjalinodakamādāya tilamiśrā apastaṃ prati asāvetatta udakam iti evaṃ dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca kṛtvā athāpratīkṣā grāmamāyānti | kaniṣṭhaprathamāḥ pipīlikā yānti | niveśanadvāre nimbapatraṃ prāśyāpa ācamya gomayaṃ hiraṇyamapo'gniṃ sarṣapāṃstairlāmatyupaspṛśya śiraḥ prāṇān saṃmṛśyāśmānamākramya gṛhaṃ praviśya yat striya āhustat kurvanti | yatra prāṇā utkrāntā bhavanti tasmin gomayenopalipya vatsaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tilataṇḍulānyudakamiśrāṇi saṃprakīrya svastyastu gṛhāṇāṃ śeṣe śivamāstām iti pavanaṃ kṛtvāpakvāśī striyā ata ūrdhvaṃ brahmacaryamā daśarātrāt | sāyaṃprātaḥ sakṛdudakamutsicya daśame'hani trirudakamutsicya daśamyāṃ vikṛtāhāram ||4||
athāto'sthisaṃcayanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | anivṛtte'gnaukaraṇe dvyahe tryahe caturahe pañcāhe saptāhe vā navakumbhamādāya śmaśānaṃ nītvā pālāśaśaṅkunā śamīśaṅkunaudumbaraśaṅkunā vāṅguṣṭhopakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vā sarvābhiraṅgulībhirvāsthīni samudāyutya kṣīreṇa plāvayitvā ghṛtaṃ ninayed idaṃ ta ātmanaḥ śarīramayaṃ ta ātmā ātmanasta ātmānaṃ śarīrād brahma nirbhinadmi bhūrbhuvaḥsvarasau svargāya lokāya svāhā iti | atha yadi na daheyurulmukamādāya punardahed asmāttvamadhijāto'syayaṃ tvadadhijāyatām | agnaye vaiśvānarāya svargāya lokāya svāhā iti | athāsthyādāya nadītīreṣu vā samudratīreṣu vāpāhareyuḥ | api vā gajasammitaṃ puruṣasammitaṃ vā gartaṃ khātvāsthikumbhamavadhāya punarabhyajya purīṣeṇa pūrayet yavadeva tad bhavati tāvat svarge loke mahīyate iti ||5||
athātodahanavidhiḥ athājyānigṛhṇīte yadyāhitāgnirbhavati athāsmā adhvaryuḥ athāto'sthisaṃcayanaṃ pañca |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
<3.5 pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha yadyāhitāgnirnirmāraṃ gacchati upatapatā vā jarayā vā agniṣṭha evāsya yajamānāyatane śayanaṃ kalpayeyurjaghanena vā gārhapatyam | tadasmai bhakṣānāharanti yāvadalaṃ bhakṣāya manyate | sa yadyuhāgado bhavati punareti | yadyu vai praiti na payaḥ samāsiñcati | athedamagnihotraṃ sāyamupakramaṃ prātarapavargamācāryā bruvate | tatrodāharanti | sa yadi sāyaṃhute'gnihotre preyāt pratikṛṣya prātaragnihotraṃ juhuyāt | atha yadi prātaragnihotre hute kuśalam | athemau darśapūrṇamāsau paurṇamāsyamāvāsyāsaṃsthāvācāryā bruvate | tatrodāharanti | sa yadi paurṇamāsyāṃ vṛttāyāṃ preyāt pratikṛṣyāmāvāsyāṃ yajeteti | atha yadyamāvāsyāyāṃ vṛttāyāṃ kuśalam | atha yasyobhe parvaṇī atipanne syātām atipannaprāyaścittaṃ kurvīta | atha yadyārtasyāgnihotraṃ vicchidyeta yadyasya putro vāntevāsī vālaṃ karmaṇyaḥ syāt so'raṇyoragniṃ samāropyodavasāya mathitvāgnīnvihṛtyāgnaye tantumate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | śarāvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti | sā prasiddheṣṭiḥ santiṣṭhate | divi prakrānte preyāt tūṣṇīmetat tantram saṃsthāpyāpobhakṣānabhyavahareyuḥ | apobhakṣānabhyavaharanti iti vijñāyate | athainamādāyāntareṇa vedyutkarāvudaṅmukhamupanirhṛtyāthainaṃ pariśrayanti | tasya dakṣiṇā dvāraṃ kurvanti | athāsya keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayitvā lomāni saṃhṛtya nakhāni nikṛntayīta | athāsya dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣimupākṛṣya nispurīṣaṃ kṛtvādbhiḥ prakṣālya sarpiṣāntrāṇi pūrayitvā darbhaiḥ saṃsīvyati | tadu tathā na kuryāt kṣodhukā asya prajā bhavanti iti vijñāyate | apivā sapurīṣamevāplāvyācchādyālaṅkṛtyāthainamādāyāntareṇa vedyutkarau prapādya jaghanena gārhapatyamupasādayantyatra havirnirupyata iti | athainam ādāyāntarvedi prākcchirasamāsādayantyatra havirāsādyata iti | atha gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā prāgudetya samidvatyāhavanīye'dhāsya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumanvārabhya juhoti ||1||
pareyuvāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bahubhyaḥ panthāmanapaspaśānam | vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasyata svāhā iti | etenaiva gārhapatye juhoti | tūṣṇīmanvāhāryapacane hutvāthainamādāyāntareṇa vedyutkarau prapādya jaghanena gārhapatyamāsandyāṃ kṛṣṇājine dakṣiṇāśirasaṃ saṃveśya śirasto naladamālāṃ pratimucya pattodaśenāhatena vāsasā prorṇoti idaṃ tvā vastraṃ prathamaṃ nvāgan iti athaitadapohati apaitadūha yadihābibhaḥ purā | iṣṭāpūrtamanusaṃpaśya dakṣiṇāṃ yathā te dattaṃ bahudhā vibandhuṣu iti | tadasya putro vāntevāsī vā patnī vā paridadhīta | tadu hājarasameva vasītāhaśśeṣaṃ vā | atha trīñchakalānupakalpayate | atha yadi na śakalā bhavanti antarvedi parāgavahatānāṃ kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām anvāhāryapacane trīn carūn śrapayatyekaṃ vā | gārhapatya āmikṣāṃ śrapayati | athainān saṃbhārānupakalpayate dadhi ca sarpirmiśramājyaṃ codakumbhaṃ ca darbhāśca paristaraṇīyān hiraṇyaṃ cājaṃ ca śāsaṃ ceḍasūnaṃ ca kumbhīṃ ca pracyāvanīṃ sikatāśca śulbe ca tisraḥ parṇaśākhāśca | kathamu khalvenaṃ daheyuḥ iti | yo bahuyājī syāt taṃ pūrvāgninā daheyurityetadekam | ajasrairenaṃ daheyurityetadekam | nirmanthyairenaṃ daheyurityetadekam | apivā tisra ulaparājīrādīpya yatrāgnayaḥ saṃgaccheran tatrolmukamādāya tenainaṃ daheyurityetadekamaparam ||2||
athāto'nustaraṇīkalpaḥ | ānayantyetāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kūṭāṃ jaratīṃ mūrkhāṃ tajjaghanyāmanustaraṇīṃ pratibaddhām | savyapratibaddhā bhavati iti vijñāyate | etasmin kāle'syāmātyāḥ prakīrṇakeśāstisṛbhiraṅgulībhiḥ upahatya pāṃsūnaṃseṣvāvapante khalvaghaṃ nāsya khalvo evāgham iti | athāsya bhāryāḥ kaniṣṭhaprathamāḥ prakīrṇakeśyo vrajeyuḥ pāṃsūnaṃseṣvāvapamānāḥ khalvaghaṃ nāsya khalvo evāgham iti | etasmin kāle gārhapatye pālāśaṃ kāṣṭhamātapyātholmukaprathamāḥ pratipadyante | svadhitirathāgnayo'tha pātrāṇi dadhyājyaṃ darbhā rājagavīti | athainametayāsandyā talpena vā kaṭena vā saṃveṣṭya dāsāḥ pravayaso vā vaheyuḥ | athainamanasā vahanti ityekeṣām | anaśced yuñjyād imau yunajmi te vahnī asunīthāya voḍhave | yābhyāṃ yamasya sādanaṃ sukṛtāṃ cāpi gacchatāt iti samāropyāgnīn haranti | samāropya vāntareṇa vā kṛtvāgnīn haranti ||3||
athainamādadate | ādīyamānamanumantrayate pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pravidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ | sa tvaitebhyaḥ paridadāt pitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatrebhyaḥ iti | tṛtīyametasyādhvano gatvā nidadhati | athaiteṣāṃ śakalānāmekamaśastreṇa plakṣṇoti | atha yadi na śakalā bhavanti caruṃ mekṣaṇena prayauti | athavā eka eva sa bhavati carostṛtīyaṃ mekṣaṇena prayauti | loṣṭānupasaṃhṛtya teṣūpamṛjya kaniṣṭhaprathamāḥ prakīrṇakeśāstrirapasalaiḥ pariyanti sigbhirupavātayantaḥ | evamamātyā evaṃ striyaḥ saṃyamya keśān yathetaṃ triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | athainamādadate | ādīyamānamanumantrayate pūṣemā āśā anuveda sarvāḥ so asmām̐ abhayatamena neṣat | svastidā aghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayṛcchan pura etu pravidvān iti | ardhametasyādhvano gatvā nidadhati | athaiteṣāṃ śakalānāmekamaśastreṇa plakṣṇoti | atha yadi na śakalā bhavanti caruṃ mekṣaṇena prayauti | loṣṭānupasaṃhṛtya teṣūpamṛjya kaniṣṭhaprathamāḥ prakīrṇakeśāstrirapasalaiḥ pariyanti sigbhirupavātayantaḥ | evamamātyā evaṃ striyaḥ saṃyamya keśān yathetaṃ triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | athainamādadate | ādīyamānamanumantrayate āyurviśvāyuḥ paripāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt | yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu iti | samastametasyādhvano gatvā nidadhati | athaiteṣāṃ śakalānāmekamaśastreṇa plakṣṇoti | atha yadi śakalā na bhavanti caruṃ mekṣaṇena prayauti | yadyu vā eka eva bhavati caroravaśiṣṭaṃ mekṣaṇena prayauti | loṣṭānupasaṃhṛtya teṣūpamṛjya kaniṣṭhaprathamāḥ prakīrṇakeśāḥ trirapasalaiḥ pariyanti sigbhirupavātayantaḥ | evamamātyā evaṃ striyaḥ saṃyamya keśān yathetaṃ triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | athaitāṃ carusthālīṃ subhinnāṃ bhinatti yathāsyai kapāleṣūdakaṃ na tiṣṭhediti | yaccātra striya āhustatkurvanti ||4||
athāsyāvakāśaṃ joṣayate | paścādudakamanūṣaramanupahatamasrutahāryamaniriṇamabhaṅguramavalmīkamajāgartibahulauṣadhi yatra kṣīriṇo vṛkṣā oṣadhayo vyatiṣaktāḥ syuḥ yasmād dakṣiṇāpratīcya āpaḥ śanaiḥ pratiṣṭheran tāḥ pradakṣiṇamabhiparyāvṛtya mahānadīmabhyupetya prācyaḥ saṃpadyeran | dakṣiṇāpratyakpravaṇamityekeṣām | apivā yā samā subhūmiḥ | tasmādvīrudha uddhārayanti | kālāṃ ca pṛśnopaṇīṃ ca tilvakāṃ cāpāghāṃ cāpāmārgaṃ ca śuṇṭhīṃ ca bahuputrīṃ ca visraṃsinīkāṃ ca rājakṣapaṇīṃ ca yāścānyā kṣīriṇya oṣadhayo bhavanti | athainamuddhatyāvokṣya hiraṇyena parikrīya parṇaśākhayāpohati apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāta iti | dārucitāṃ kurvanti dakṣiṇāprācīm eṣā hi pitṛṇāṃ prācī dig iti vijñāyate | jaghanena citāṃ dakṣiṇāprācīṃ vihāraṃ kalpayitvā darbhairagniṃ pretaṃ citāṃ ca paristīrya dakṣiṇena vihāraṃ dakṣiṇāgnān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣvekaikaśo nyañci pātrāṇi sādayati | ekapavitreṇa prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣya pretaṃ citāṃ cājyaṃ nirupyādhiśritya paryagnikṛtvodvāsyotpūya tūṣṇīṃ darbhaiḥ pātrāṇi saṃmṛjya tūṣṇīṃ tūṣṇīṃ dārśapūrṇamāsikājyāni gṛhītvā ||5||
athāsya rājagavīmupākaroti bhuvanasya pate iti | tasyāṃ nipadyamānāyāṃ savyāni jānūnyupanighnate puruṣasya sayāvaryapedaghāni mṛjmahe | yathā no atra nāparaḥ purā jarasa āyati iti | tāmatraiva śastrād ghnanti | athaitasyai prāṇān visrasyamānānanumantrayate puruṣasya sayāvari vi te prāṇamasisrasam | śarīreṇa mahīmihi svadha ehi pitṝnupa prajayāsmānihāvaha iti | upotthāya pāṃsūnamavamṛśante maivaṃ māṃstā priye'haṃ devī satī pitṛlokaṃ yadaiṣi | viśvavārā nabhasā saṃ vyayantyubhau no lokau payasābhyāvavṛtsva iti | athainaṃ saṃśāsti aṅgādaṅgādanasthikāni piśitāni pracchidyāsaṃśrāvayanto'pracyāvayanta ekolmukena śrapayantaḥ prajñātāṃ vapāṃ nidhatta prajñātaṃ hṛdayaṃ prajñātāṃ jihvāṃ prajñātaṃ carma saśīrṣavālapādaṃ prajñāte ca matasre prajñātaṃ meda iti | athāsya bhāryāmupasaṃveśayati iyaṃ nārī patilokaṃ vṛṇānā nipadyata upa tvā martyapretam | viśvaṃ purāṇamanu pālayantī tasyai prajāṃ draviṇaṃ ceha dhehi iti | tāṃ patihitaḥ savye pāṇau gṛhītvotthāpayati udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokamitāsumetamupaśeṣa ehi | hastagrābhasya didhiṣostvametat patyurjanitvamabhi saṃbabhūva iti | athāsya svarṇena hastau nimṛjate svarṇe hastādādadānā mṛtasya śriyai brahmaṇe tejase balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suśevā viśvā spṛdho abhimātīrjayema iti brāhmaṇasya dhanurhastādādadānā mṛtasya śriyai kṣatrāyaujase balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suśevā viśvā spṛdho abhimātīrjayema iti rājanyasya maṇiṃ hastādādadānā mṛtasya śriyai viśe puṣṭyai balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suśevā viśvā spṛdho abhimātīrjayema iti vaiśyasya | yaccātra striya āhustatkurvanti | athainametayāsandyā saha citāvādadhāti | apakṛṣya rajjūrāsandīmapavidhyanti | kṛṣṇājine caiva rajjuṣu cottānaḥ śete | tasya prāṇeṣu hiraṇyaśakalān pratyasyati | nānā caturgṛhītābhyāmakṣṇorjuhoti citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkam ityardharcābhyāṃ juhotīti vijñāyate ||6||
kathamu khalvasya pātrāṇi yuñjyāditi | dadhnā sarpirmiśreṇa pūrayitvā mukhe'gnihotrahavaṇīṃ nāsikayoḥ sruvau akṣṇoḥ hiraṇyaśakalau ājyasruvau vā karṇayoḥ prāśitraharaṇaṃ bhittvaikaikaṃ hanvorulūkhalamusale śirasi kapālāni lalāṭe ekakapālaṃ śirastaḥ praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ camasaṃ nidadhāti imamagne camasaṃ mā vijīhvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta saumyānām | eṣa yaścamaso devapānastasmin devā amṛtā mādayantām iti | dakṣiṇe haste juhūṃ savye upabhṛtamurasi dhruvāmupaveṣamaraṇīṃ ca dakṣiṇe aṃse mekṣaṇaṃ savye piṣṭodvapanīṃ pṛṣṭhe sphyamudare dārupātrīṃ kukṣau camasau sānnāyyapidhānaṃ ceḍopavahanaṃ ca vaṅkṣṇayoḥ sānnāyyakumbhyau pādayoragnihotrasthālīmanvāhāryasthālīṃ corvorulūkhalamusale aṇḍayordṛṣadupale śiśne vṛṣāravaṃ śamyāṃ ca pārśvayoḥ śūrpaṃ chittvaikaikaṃ śirasta upasādanīyaṃ kūrcaṃ nidadhāti | patta upāvaharaṇīyaṃ kūrcam | athāvaśiṣṭānyantareṇa sakthinī nivapeyuḥ | apo mṛṇmayānyabhyavahareyuḥ | apo mṛṇmayānyabhyavaharanti iti vijñāyate | atraivopanidadhyuḥ | brāhmaṇebhyo'yasmayāni lohamayāni ca dadyuḥ | teṣāṃ yānyāsecanavanti tāni dadhnā sarpirmiśreṇa pūrayet | saṃspṛśeditarāṇi | ariktāni bhavanti iti vijñāyate | atraivādhyasyantyupavājinaṃ khārīṃ nalvam | athāsyādmikṣāmuddhṛtya pāṇyorādadhyāt mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā iti | athāsya matasnāmullikhya pāṇyorādadhyāt śyāmaśabalābhyāṃ tvā iti | dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇaṃ savye savyaṃ hṛdaye hṛdayamāsye jihvāṃ yathāṅgamaṅgairitarāṇi saṃpracchādya vapayāsya mukhaṃ pracchādayati | medasā srucau prorṇoti iti vijñāyate | athainaṃ carmaṇā saśīrṣavālapādenottaralomnā prarṇoti agnervarma parigobhirvyayasva saṃprorṇuṣva medasā pīvasā ca | netvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhadvidhakṣyan paryaṅkhayātai iti ||7||
atha yadyanustaraṇīṃ nānustariṣyanto bhavantyutsṛjedvainām | brāhmaṇebhyo vā dadyāt | dattvātraiva śreyase bhavanti iti vijñāyate | atha yadyutsrakṣyan bhavati tāmapasalaiḥ paryāṇayati apaśyāma yuvatimācarantīm iti tisṛbhistriḥ paryāṇīyottarataḥ pratiṣṭhitāmanumantrayate ye jīvā ye ca mṛtā ityetayā | athāsyāḥ karṇalomānyutpāṭya pāṇyorevādadhyāt śyāmaśavalābhyāṃ tvā iti | dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇaṃ savye savyam | athaināmutsṛjati mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasātityānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ | praṇuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya māgāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa | pibatūdakaṃ tṛṇānyattu | omutsṛjata iti | athainamupoṣayati purastādāhavanīyena dakṣiṇato'nvāhāryapacanena paścād gārhapatyenottarataḥ sabhyāvasakthyābhyām | atrāpyutprekṣā bhavanti | taṃ yadyāhavanīyaḥ prathamamabhyujjvaled devalokamabhyajaiṣīdityenaṃ jānīyāt | atha yadyanvāhāryapacanaḥ pitṛlokam | atha yadi gārhapatyaḥ svargalokam | atha yadi sabhyāvasakthau saptarṣīṇāṃ lokam | atha yadi sarva eva sahābhyujjvaled brahmalokamabhyajaiṣīd ityenaṃ jānīyāt | yaccātra striya āhustatkurvanti ||8||
athayadyāhitāgniḥ pareyuvāṃsam athāto'nustaraṇīkalpaḥ athainamādadateādīyamānamanumantrayate athāsyāvakāśaṃjoṣayate athāsyarājagavīmupākaroti kathamukhalvasyapātrā ṇiyuñjyāt athayadyanustaraṇīm aṣṭau |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.6 ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ>
athainamādīpayate | ādīpyamānamanumantrayate mainamagne vidaho mābhiśoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram | yadā śṛtaṃ karavo jātavedo'themenaṃ prahiṇutāt pitṛbhyaḥ iti | prajvalitamanumantrayate śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ paridattāt pitṛbhyaḥ | yadā gacchātyasunītimetāmathā devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti iti | atra ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyācaṣṭe sūryaṃ te cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā | apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ iti | atrainamajaṃ cityante'balena śulbena badhnāti ajo bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ | yāste śivāstanuvo jātavedastābhirvahemaṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ iti | sa yadyaho dravati nainamāvartayati | prāgu haika upoṣaṇāt | udakumbhena trirapasalaiḥ pariyanti vāruṇībhiḥ | tatpracchādyena parṇamayena sruveṇopaghātaṃ juhoti ya etasya patho goptārastebhyaḥ svāhā iti nava sruvāhutīḥ | athānyāṃ juhoti ayaṃ vai tvamasmādadhi tvametadayaṃ vai tadasya yonirasi | vaiśvānaraḥ putraḥ pitre lokakujjātavedo vahemaṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ svāhā iti | atraiva sruvamanu praharati | atraitānyavadānānīḍamūne pracchādyaudumbaryā darvyopaghātaṃ juhoti agnaye rayimate svāhā iti | atraiva darvīmanupraharati jaghanena citām | athainaṃ navarcena yāmyena sūktenopatiṣṭhate praketunā bṛhatā bhātyagniḥ iti | āsīnaḥ parācānuśaṃsati | jaghanena dahanaṃ tisro dakṣiṇāḥ karṣūḥ kurvanti | athainā adbhiranuplāvya sikatābhiravakīrya saṃgāhante yavīyān yavīyān pūrvaḥ saṃgāhante | aśmanvatī revatīḥ saṃrabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata prataratā sakhāyaḥ | atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivān vayamabhi vājānuttarema iti | jaghanena karṣūḥ parṇaśākhe nihatyābalena śulbena baddhvā vinisarpanti yadvai devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ sahasradhāraṃ vitatamantarikṣe | yenāpunādindramanārtamārtyai tenāhaṃ māṃ sarvatanuṃ punāmi iti | jaghanyo vyudasyati yā rāṣṭrāt pannādapayanti śākhā abhimṛtā nṛpatimicchamānāḥ | dhātustāḥ sarvāḥ pavanena pūtāḥ prajayāsmān rayyā varcasā saṃsṛjātha iti | yatrāpastadyantyanavekṣamāṇāḥ | apaḥ sacelā dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ samṛttikāḥ plavante dhātā punātu savitā punātu iti | nāmagrāhaṃ trirudakamutsicyottīryācamyādityamupatiṣṭhate udvayaṃ tamasaspari iti | atha gṛhānāyānti | yaccātra striya āhustat kurvanti ||1||
etasmin kāle'syāmātyāḥ prakīrṇakeśāḥ keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayante ye sannidhāne bhavanti | vikalpa itareṣu | vāpayeran nivartayeranvā | śrutavatā tu vaptavyamevāsannidhāne'pīti mataṃ bodhāyanasya kalpe | na samāvṛttā vaperannanyatra vihārādityeke | mātari pitaryācārya iti trirātraṃ kṣāralavaṇavarjitabhojanamadhaḥśayanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tryahaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadgrahaṇaṃ dvādaśāhāparārdham paramaguruṣvevamaghodakam itareṣu trirātram yāvajjīvaṃ pretapatnī | atha yadyāhitāgniranyatra preyādādīpyamānairāhūyamānairvasīran yāvadasya śarīramagnibhiḥ samāgamayeran | athaitadabhivānyāyai payo dohayitvā gārhapatye 'bhiviṣyandayitvāhavanīye'bhiviṣyandayet | adhastāt samidhamāharantyupariṣṭāddhi devebhyo haranti iti vijñāyate | athainamādāyāntareṇa vedyutkarāvudagupanirhṛtya prasiddhamupoṣeyuḥ | atha yadyāhitāgniranyatra preyādudakānte trīnagnyagārānālikhya sakṛt praviśya nimīlya nigṛhya skandakṣiṇāntānādityamudīkṣet | parikurvīta ca | anenaiva trirvideśasthe | atha yadi dagdhaḥ syādasthīnyāhṛtyāntarvedi śarīrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā teṣūpari pātrāṇi citvā kuśataruṇakaiḥ praticchādya prasiddhamupoṣeyuḥ | atha yadyasthīni na vindeta trayāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭiśatānāṃ parṇatsarūṇāmeva kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā teṣūpari pātrāṇi citvā kuśataruṇakaiḥ praticchādya prasiddhamupoṣeyuḥ | āhitāgnimagnibhirdahanti yajñapātraiśca iti vijñāyate | puruṣāhutirhyasya priyatamā ityetāmanukhyātāṃ dahanasya bruvate | athāpyudāharanti śarīradāyādā ha vāgnayo bhavanti iti | tadapi dāśataye vijñāyate śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ iti ||2||
athātaḥ saṃcayanam | ekasyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ tisṛṣu vā pañcasu vā saptasu vā nadhasvekādaśasu vāyugmeṣvahassu ardhamāseṣu māseṣu ṛtuṣu saṃvatsareṣu vā sampādya sañcinuyuriti | sa upakalpayate sataṃ ca kṣīraṃ cājyaṃ ca udakumbhaṃ ca darbhāṃśca paristaraṇīyān nīlalohite sūtre bṛhatīphalaṃ cāśmānaṃ cāpāmārgaṃ ca vaitasaśākhāṃ ca sikatāśca śulbe ca tisraśca parṇaśākhāśca | ata eva dahanādaṅgārānnirvartya tisro avasarjanīyā juhoti avasṛja punaragne pitṛbhyaḥ saṃgacchasva pitṛbhiḥ yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda iti | etasmin sate kṣīraṃ codakumbhaṃ ca nikṣipya vaitasaśākhayāvokṣya sampādayatyaprakāthayan śarīrāṇi yaṃ te agnimamanthāma iti ṣaḍbhiḥ | prathamāṃ vottamāṃ dvirabhyāvartayeyuḥ | athaitadādahanamudakumbhaiḥ svavokṣitamavokṣya yā asya strīṇāṃ mukhyā sā savye pāṇau bṛhatīphalaṃ nīlalohitābhyāṃ mūtrābhyāṃ viśrathyāśmānamanvāsthāyāpāmārgeṇa sakṛdupamṛjyānanvīkṣamāṇā pattaḥ śirasto vāsthīni gṛhṇāti uttiṣṭhātastanuvaṃ saṃbharasva meha gātramavahā mā śarīram | yatra bhūmyai vṛṇase tatra gaccha tatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu iti | idaṃ ta ekam iti dvitīyam | para ūta ekam iti tṛtīyam | tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃviśasva iti caturtham | saṃveśanastanuvai cāruredhi iti pañcamam | priyo devānāṃ parame sadhasthe iti ṣaṣṭham | athainaṃ susañcitaṃ saṃcitya piṇḍīkaroti | taṃ tathā karoti yathāsya kapotaḥ chāyāyāṃ nopaviśediti | athainam aparimitaiḥ kṣudramiśrairaśmabhiḥ paricinoti na tena paricinuyād yathāsya kapotaḥ chāyāyāmupaviśet | athaitānyasthīnyadbhiḥ prakṣālya kumbhe vā sate vā kṛtvopottiṣṭhati uttiṣṭha prehi pradravaukaḥ kṛṇuṣva parame vyoman | yamena tvaṃ yamyā saṃvidānottamaṃ nākamadhirohemam iti | saṃpraveśaṃ kumbhaṃ nidhāya athāto haviryajñiyaṃ nivapanam yaṃ kāmayetānantalokaḥ syāt iti | tamasyā uddhate sikatopopte pariśrite nidadhāti pṛthivyāstvā akṣityā apāmoṣadhīnāṃ rase svarge loke nākasya tvā pṛṣṭhe bradhnasya tvā viṣṭape sādayāmyamumasau iti | anantaloko havai bhavati iti vijñāyate | jaghanena kumbhaṃ tisro dakṣiṇāḥ karṣūḥ kurvanti | tat purastād vyākhyātam | jaghanena karṣūḥ parṇaśākhe nihatyābalena śulbena baddhvā vinisarpanti | tat purastāt vyākhyātam | yatrāpastadyantyanavekṣamāṇāḥ | apaḥ sacelā dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ samṛttikāḥ plavante dhātā punātu savitā punātu iti | nāmagrāhaṃ trirudakamutsicyottīryācamyāthādityamupatiṣṭhate udvayaṃ tamasaspari iti | atha gṛhānāyānti | yaścātra striya āhustat kurvanti ||3||
atha yadi punardhakṣyanto bhavanti purastādevāvaśeṣayeyurjuhūṃ cāraṇīṃ ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ dṛṣadupale śamyāmiti | atha yadyanuhṛtāḥ syuryasyakasyacidaśvatthasyāraṇī gṛhītvā mathitvāgnimupasamādhāya paristīrya kṛṣṇājine śamyāyāṃ dṛṣadupale yuktvāsthīnyevāñjanaṃ piṣṭvā purāṇena sarpiṣā samudāyutya juhvā prasekaṃ juhoti asmāttvamadhijāto'smayaṃ tvadadhijāyatām | agnaye vaiśvānarāya svargāya lokāya svāhā iti | atraivānupraharati juhūṃ cāraṇīṃ ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ dṛṣadupale śamyāmiti | atrāpyutprekṣā bhavanti | taṃ yadi jvālordhvamabhyujjvaled devalokamabhyajaiṣīdityenaṃ jānīyād atha yadi muhūrtamudetya vā bhramedantarikṣamabhyajaiṣīdityenaṃ jānīyād atha yadīmāmanuvinamedihaivetyenaṃ jānīyāt | yaccātra striya āhustat kurvanti | na cāsyāta ūrdhvaṃ śmaśānaṃ kartumādriyeta | kṛtīrvāsya dahane vapedapasyābhirvā paricinuyāt | tamabhyevādityastapati abhi vā vātaḥ pavate sa nādityasya sakāśānna vāyornāpāṃ sparśācchidyate | yamevaṃ nidadhyurya u cainamevaṃ vidurevamu hāhīnā hāyanā vāśvatthaṃ nidadhyustaṃ ho evaṃ cakre tasyo heme'hīnā hāyanā śreyasī śreyasī hyasmai vasyasī vasyasī prajā bhavati | yamevaṃ nidadhyurya u cainamevaṃ viduretāṃ ha kauṣītakirvidāṃcakāra | tasyo heme kauṣītakinaḥ śreyasī śreyasī hyasmai vyucchantī vyucchantyasmai vasyasī vasyasī prajā bhavati yamevaṃ nidadhyurya u cainamevaṃ vidurya u cainamevaṃ viduḥ ||4||
athainamādīpayate ādīpyamānamanumantrayate etasminkāle asyāmātyā athātaḥ saṃcayanam athayadipunardhakṣyantaḥ catvāri |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
<3.7 saptamo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha gṛhāneṣyannupakalpayate vāraṇaṃ srucaṃ ca sruvaṃ ca vāraṇān paridhīn kuśamayaṃ barhiḥ parṇamayamidhmaṃ rohitaṃ carmānaḍuhaṃ navaṃ ca sarpirāñjanaṃ cāśmānaṃ cānaḍvāhaṃ ca śamīśākhāṃ ca kuśataruṇakāni ca darbhastambhaṃ cājaṃ ca yavāṃśca iti | athāntareṇa grāmaṃ ca śmaśānaṃ ca tadvṛdhāgnimupasamādhāya kṛśamayaṃ barhistīrtvā vāraṇān paridhīn paridhāya parṇamayamidhmamabhyajya svāhākāreṇābhyādhāyāthaitadrohitaṃ carmānaḍuhaṃ jaghanenāgniṃ prācīnagrīvamuttaralomopastṛṇāti | tadārohanti yāvanto'sya jñātayo bhavanti ārohatāyurjarasaṃ gṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānāya tiṣṭa | iha tvaṣṭā sujanimā suratno dirghamāyuḥ karatu jīvase va iti | athainānanupūrvaṃ kalpayanti yathāhānyanupūrvaṃ bhavanti yathartava ṛtubhiryanti kḷptāḥ | yathā na pūrvamaparo jahātyevā dhātarāyūm̐ṣi kalpayaiṣām iti | atha vāraṇena sruveṇa vāraṇyāṃ sruci caturgṛhītvā juhoti na hi te agne tanuvai krūraṃ cakāra martyaḥ | kapirbabhasti te janaṃ punarjarāyugauriva | apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśudhyā rayim | apa naḥ śośucadaghaṃ mṛtyave svāhā iti | atha vāraṇena sruveṇopaghātaṃ juhoti apa naḥ śośucadagham iti dvādaśa sruvāhutīḥ | athopotthāya anuḍvāhamanvārabhante anaḍvāhamanvārabhāmahe svastaye | sa na indra iva devebhyo vahniḥ saṃpāraṇo bhava iti | prāñco yānti ime jīvā vimṛtairāvavartinnabhūd bhadrā devahūtiṃ no adya | prāñco gāmānṛtaye hasāya drāghīya āyuḥ pratarāṃ dadhānāḥ | mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto yadaima drāghīya āyuḥ pratarāṃ dadhānāḥ | āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtā bhavatha yajñiyāsaḥ iti ||1||
athāntarenāgniṃ ca grāmaṃ cāśmānamavadadhāti imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi mā no'nugādaparo ardhametam | śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīstiro mṛtyuṃ dadmahe parvatena iti | athaitāḥ patnayo navena sarpiṣā saṃmṛśante imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃmṛśantām iti | kuśataruṇakaiḥ traikakudenāñjanenāṅkte yadāñjanaṃ traikakudaṃ jātaṃ himavataspari | tenāmṛtasya mūlenārātīrjambhayāmasi iti | athaitāni kuśataruṇakāni samuccitya darbhastambe nidadhāti | yathā tvamudbhinatsyoṣadhe pṛthivyā adhi | evamima udbhindantu kīrttyā yaśasā brahmavarcasena iti | pratyetya gṛhānāsandīṃ preṣṭhanītyārohanti anaśravo anamīvāḥ suśevā ārohantu janayo yonimagre iti | ajaṃ caitadahaḥ pacante | yavaudanaṃ ca | ajaṃ cāśnāti | ajo'syajāsmadadhād dveṣām̐si iti | yavaudanasya prāśnāti | yavo'si yavayāsmadaghād dveṣām̐si iti | athāsya śrāddhaṃ kurvanti | ekasyāṃ vā vyuṣṭāyāṃ tisṛṣu vā pañcasu vā saptasu vā navasu vaikādaśasu vāyugmeṣvahassu ardhamāseṣu vā dadyāt | kāmamaharaharekādaśamāsān dadyāt | na dvādaśamāsamabhyārohayet | saṃvatsare saṃvatsare vā etasminnahani dadyāt | sa eṣa evaṃ vihitaḥ | evamanāhitāgneḥ striyāḥ pulliṅgāḥ pātracayeṣṭakāḥ keśavapanavarjaṃ piturmāturācāryasya vā kriyeta | sahasradakṣiṇo vāpyanyatra | santiṣṭhate pitṛmedhaḥ santiṣṭhate pitṛmedhaḥ ||2||
yatho etadāhitāgnernirmāraṃ gacchataḥ pratikṛṣya prātaragnihotraṃ juhuyāt pratikṛṣyāmāvāsyāṃ yajeteti | tayaite karmaṇī abhisañcaredyathā vā jīvataḥ kṛte syātām | so cedahute prātaragnihotre'vyuṣṭāyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ preyāt tadānīmevāsya tūṣṇīṃ prātaragnihotraṃ yādṛk kīdṛk ca hotavyaṃ tadānīmevāsya tūṣṇīmamāvāsyāyāṃ yādṛśīṃ kīdṛśīṃ vā yajeta | so cet punaragadaḥ syāt punarevāsya prātaragnihotraṃ kālyamavyāpannaṃ hotavyam | punarevāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ kālyāmavyāpannāṃ yajeteti | yatho etanna payaḥ samāsiñcatyāmikṣārthaṃ payo'vaśeṣayedityevedamuktaṃ bhavati | yatho etadāsandyāmityevedamuktaṃ bhavati | yatho etadantarvedi śarīrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā teṣūpari pātrāṇi citvā kuśataruṇakaiḥ praticchādya prasiddhamupoṣeyuriti vijñāyate | pātracayanaprabhṛti siddhamata ūrdhvam | etāvadeva nānā nātra gorālambho'nustaraṇīkāle kuśataruṇakaiḥ śuṣkamomayairghṛtenetyanustṛṇīyād agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva ityetadeva parṇatsaruṣu | api vā yatheṣṭikalpe | api vā tūṣṇīmeva sarvaṃ kriyetānyatra caiva gorālambhāditi | atha vai bhavati | prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā vṛtto'śayat | taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ rasaṃ tejassambhṛtya tenainamabhiṣajyanniti | caturhotāramityevaṃ brūyāt | tasya sagrahaiḥ hotṛbhirhomaḥ bhartuḥ sūktena bharaṇaṃ patnībhirupasaṃveśanaṃ dakṣiṇāpratigrahairnirmārgo hṛdayairhiraṇyaśakalān sambhāraiśca pātracayo vyotiṣyatībhirupoṣaṇaṃ nārāyaṇābhyāṃ brāhmaṇa ekahotā iti copasthānaṃ prayāsāya svāhā ityājyāhutīḥ cittaṃ santānena iti piśitahomo mṛtyusūktenānuśaṃsanaṃ saumyayā saṃgāhanam īyuṣṭyāvagāhanaṃ sauryeṇādityasyopasthānamiti | tānetān paraṃ brahmetyācakṣate | tānna sādhāraṇe śmaśāne prayuñjīta nānācāryāya nāśrotriyāya nāgurave | patho etaddhaviryajñiyaṃ nivapanaṃ punardahanaṃ ceti yadahaḥ saṃcinuyāt tadaharevaitat kuryāt | kumbhāntamanāhitāgneśca striyāśca | nivapanāntaṃ haviryaśayājinaḥ punardahanāntaṃ somayājinaḥ cityantamagnicitaḥ | yadītaraṃ yadautaramaghodakamutsicya daśarātramāśaucaṃ kṛtvā śāntiḥ | atha yadi citiścityante śaucam | cityāḥ prāk karṣūbhyaḥ kṛtvā śvobhūte dhuvanenaiva pratipadyate | siddhamata ūrdhvam ||3||
athaiteṣāmudakasapiṇḍānāṃ vāndhavānāṃ mātuśca yonisambandhebhyaḥ pituśca saptamāt puruṣādācāryāntevāsinośca sapatnīkānāṃ sāpatyānāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ daśarātram | trirātramitareṣām | bāle deśāntarasye ca sadyaḥ śaucamityeke | evaṃ nityodakatarpaṇe'nusmaraṇaṃ strīyājyaśiṣyāṇām | na prāk caulāt pramītānāṃ dahanaṃ vidyate | āpaśuyājināṃ gorālambhaḥ nāsannayatāmāmikṣā nāgnicitāṃ citiḥ | na strīṇāṃ keśavapanaṃ vidyate na citirneṣṭakā na punardāhaḥ | dāruvat strīṇāṃ pātrāṇi bhavanti | bahvṛcāṃ pitṛmedhe strīṇāmimān mantrānapoddharet | iyaṃ nārī patilokam udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokaṃ svarṇaṃ hastādādadānā mṛtasya dhanurhastādādadānā mṛtasya maṇiṃ hastādādadānā mṛtasya mainamagne vidaho mābhiśocaḥ mṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedaḥ ajo bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva ayaṃ vai tvamasmādadhi tvametat idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ūta ekaṃ yau te śvānau yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda uttiṣṭha prehi pradravaukaḥ kṛṇuṣva asmāttvamadhijāto'si apeta vīta vi ca sarpatātaḥ ucchmañcasva pṛthivi mā vivādhiyā iti | mṛtapatnīkaḥ kratūnāhariṣyan jāyāmupayamyāgnīnādadhyāt | vijñāyate ca tasmādeko dve jāye vindata iti | mṛtapatikāyā aupāsanena pitṛmedhaḥ | nahyasyā apatitvāt punaragnyādheyaṃ vidyate | vijñāyate ca tasmānnaikā dvau patī vindate iti | āhitāgnimagnibhirdahanti yajñapātraiścetyaviśeṣād jāyāpatyorāhitāgnyorityevedamuktaṃ bhavati | tayoryaḥ pūrvo mriyeta tasyāgnitretayā yajñapātraiśca pitṛmedhaḥ yaḥ paścāt tasyaupāsanena | sahapramītayoḥ sahaikaḥ pitṛmedhaḥ | aupāsanaṃ colmukārthaṃ syāt | aupāsanenānāhitāgneḥ striyāśca nirmanthyena | uttapanīyenaike samāmananti | nirmanthyena strīkumāraṃ daheyurityekeṣām | mṛtapatnīkasamāgnibhirjāyāyāṃ dagdhāyāmaupāsanena kā pratipattiriti | kratuṃ cedāhariṣyan syād brāhmodanikamenaṃ kuryāt | vanaṃ cedātiṣṭhed aupāsanamevopāsyaṃ syāt | atha cet saṃnyasennainamādriyeta | nāśuciḥ kāmyaṃ tapa ātiṣṭhenna yajenna svādhyāyamadhīyītānyatrāgnihotradarśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ dadyāt | kāmamṛtvigbhyo dadyāt | yatho etad gṛhānepyannupakalpayate iti svān gṛhasthadharmān pratipatsyannityevedamuktaṃ bhavati | kathamu khalu prācīnāvītinā pitṛmedhaḥ kāryo yajñopavītineti | prācīnāvītinetyevaṃ brūyāt | pitṛṇāṃ vā eṣa medho devānāṃ vā anye medhā iti | nivītinaścaivedam hareyuścitāyāṃ cādadhyuścitāyāṃ cādadhyuḥ ||4||
athagṛhāneṣyannupakalpayate athāntareṇāgniṃcagrāmaṃca yathoetadāhitāgneḥ athaiteṣāmudakasapiṇḍānāṃ catvāri
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.8 aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ>
ekāhaṃ dhunupustrīṇyahāni dhunuyuḥ pañcasaptanavaikādaśārdhamāsān dhunuyuḥ ayugmarātrīrardhamāsān māsānṛtūn saṃvatsaraṃ vā saṃpādya dhunuyuriti | sa upakalpayate dadhi ca vājinamiśraṃ kumbhīṃ ca śatātṛṣṇāṃ tisraḥ pālāśyo medhyo rohitaṃ carmānaḍuham āhananārthamapasalāvṛttarajjuṃ parivyayaṇīṃ ca ṣaṭcchatānīṣṭakā āmamayā aparimitāśca lokaṃpṛṇā dvayā dhānāstilamiśrāścātilabhiśrāścābhivānyāyai dugdhamardhapātraṃ samūlaṃ barhirnaleṣikāṃ bhuktabhogaṃ ca vāsaḥ kṣetravitṝṇṇīṃ caturo loṣṭān pañca carūn pañcāpūpān ghṛtenaikaḥ kṣīreṇaiko dadhnaiko madhunaikaḥ caturaḥ stambān arjunastambaṃ dūrvāstambaṃ kāśastambaṃ kuśastambaṃ caturo nānāvṛkṣyān paridhīn parṇamayavāraṇavetasaśamīmayān dve dve vāraṇaśākhāṃ ca kṣetravitṛṇṇīṃ vidhṛtiṃ yavamayaṃ sarvauṣadhaṃ ca sikatāśca śulbañca tisraśca palāśaśākhāḥ | athāntareṇa vā grāmaṃ ca śmaśānaṃ cāgāraṃ vā vimitaṃ vā kāritaṃ vā bhavati | tadvṛdhāgnimupasamādhāyāpareṇāgniṃ tisraḥ pālāśyo medhyo nihatya tāsāmantareṇāsthikumbhaṃ nidhāya tadupariṣṭācchatātṛṇṇāmadhyudyamya dadhnā vājinamiśreṇa pūrayati vaiśvānare haviridaṃ juhomi imaṃ samudraṃ śatadhāramutsam iti dvābhyām | anumantrayate drapasaścaskanda iti | athaitatpurastādrohitena carmaṇānaḍuhenābhighātaṃ trirapasalaiḥ pariyanti | ajinamau ajinamau iti | tristrireva rātreḥ pariyanti trirahnaḥ | evamamātyā evaṃ striyaḥ | tadanu nartakyaścānunṛtyeyuḥ | yaścāhanyate svāryāṃ vā palvale vā samavaśamayante | yadeṣāṃ samavaśamayitaṃ sambhavati te na tathā prayayuryadaharna purastānna paścāccandramasaṃ paśyeyuḥ | te mahārātra utthāya prayayurjñātvā śmaśānakaraṇam | athaite brāhmaṇāścatvāro'bhrimādāyottarato gatvā loṣṭānupasaṃharantīṣṭakā vā | athaitadādahanamudakumbhaiḥ svavokṣitamavokṣati apeta vīta vi dca sarpatātaḥ iti | yathājīvamupasarpe syāt na jīvantamabhidadhyājjīvato hyeṣa prāṇānabhinidadhyāt iti | parnaśākhayā pīḍayitvā apasalavṛttayā rajjvā pariyanti premāṃ mātrāmupasnuhi iti | tasya mātrā yadi grīvadaghnaṃ purastānnābhidaghnaṃ paścādyadi jānudaghnaṃ purastād gulphadaghnaṃ paścādyadi gulphadaghnaṃ purastāt samaṃ bhūmeḥ paścāt puruṣamātraṃ bhavatīti vijñāyate | uktavidhābhyāṃ samanu spandyāṃ lekhāṃ likhati | apoddhatya spandyāṃ karṣūḥ khānayanti | ucchrayantyasyā dakṣiṇataḥ paścād bhūyasīḥ kurvanti ||1||
atha dvābhyām ātmanyagniṃ gṛhṇīte mayi gṛhṇāmyagre agnim yo no agniḥ iti | svayaṃ citiṃ japati yāste agne samidho yāni dhāma iti | śvetamaśvamabhimṛśyāntaḥ śarkarāmimāmupadadhāti prajāpatistvā sādayatu tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda iti | athaitatpurastādevaudumbaraṃ yugalāṅgalaṃ kāritaṃ bhavati saptagavaṃ vā śayodaśagavaṃ vā śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ nārāḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam | śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunamuṣṭrāmudiṅgaya śunāsīrā śunamasmāsu dhattam śunāsīrāvimāṃ vācam iti dvābhyām | sītāṃ pratyavekṣate sīte vandāmahe tvārvācī subhage bhava | yathā naḥ subhagā sasi yathā naḥ suphalā sasi iti | athāsthikumbhaṃ sītāyāṃ nidadhāti savitaitāni śarīrāṇi pṛthivyai māturupastha ādadhe | tebhiradite śaṃ bhava iti | athānaḍuho vimuñcati vimucyadhvamaghniyā devayānā atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya | jyotirāpāma suvaraganma iti | ata ete'dhvaryayo bhavanti yadi dakṣiṇāvān pitṛmedhaḥ | yadyu vai satriyo'gniryathāgavaṃ vyudañcati | yatraivānaḍvāhastadyugalāṅgalamiti | athainamupavātayate pravātā vānti patayanti vidyuta udoṣadhīrjihate pinvate svaḥ | irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yatparjanyaḥ pṛthivīṃ retasāvati iti | agnivatsarvauṣadhīrvapati yathā yamāya hārmyamavapan pañca mānavāḥ | evaṃ vapāmi hārmyaṃ yathā sāma jīvaloke bhūrayaḥ iti | atra sikatā nivapati agne tava śravo vaya iti ṣaḍbhiranucchandasam | athordhvacita upadadhāti citasstha paricita ūrdhvacitaḥ śrayadhvaṃ pitaro devatā | prajāpatirvaḥ sādayatu tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda iti | athānuvyūhati ā pyāyasva iti gāyatryā brāhmaṇasya | saṃ te payām̐si iti triṣṭubhā rājanyasya yathāsuṣṭu yathāśarkaramanuvyūhati | atha dvābhyāmātmanyagniṃ gṛhṇīte mayi gṛhṇāmyagre agniṃ yo no agniḥ iti | svayaṃ citiṃ japati yāste agne samidho yāni dhāma iti | śvetamaśvamabhimṛśyābhidravaṇaṃ japati apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ namasta iti dve | atha kṣetravitṛṇṇyāṃ caturo loṣṭānupadadhāti utte tabhnomi pṛthivīṃ tvatparīmaṃ lokaṃ nidadhanmo aham̐riṣam | etām̐ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayantu tetrā yamassādanātte minotu iti purastādupadadhāti | upasarpa mātaraṃ bhūmimetāmuruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām | ūrṇaṃ mṛdā yuvatirdakṣiṇāvatyeṣā tvā pātu nirṛtyā upasthe ityuttarataḥ | ucchmañcasva pṛthivi mā vibādhithāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpavañcanā | mātā putraṃ yathāsi cābhyenaṃ bhūmi vṛṇu iti paścāt | ucchmañcamānā pṛthivī hi tiṣṭhasi sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām | te gṛhāso madhuścuto viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santvatra iti dakṣiṇataḥ | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | athainaṃ tilamiśrābhirdhānābhirupakirati eṇīrdhānā hariṇīrarjunīḥ santu dhenavaḥ | tilavatsā ūrjamasmai duhānā viśvāhāḥ santvanapasphurantīḥ iti | athainamabhivānyāyai dugdhamardhapātraṃ dakṣiṇata upadadhāti eṣā te yamasādane svadhā nidhīyate gṛhe | akṣitirnāma te asau iti yajamānasya nāma gṛhṇāti | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | dakṣiṇataḥ samūlaṃ barhirupadadhāti idaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prabharema barhirdevebhyo jīvanta uttaraṃ bharema | tattvamārohāso medhyo bhavaṃ yamena tvaṃ yamyā saṃvidānaḥ iti | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | atha naleṣikāmupadadhāti nalaṃ plavamārohaitannalena patho'nvihi | sa tvaṃ nalaplavo bhūtvā santara pratarottara iti | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | athainamasthikumbhaṃ bhuktabhogena vāsasā nirṇijya yathāṅgaṃ cinoti savitaitāni śarīrāṇi pṛthivyai māturupastha ādadhe | tebhyaḥ pṛthivi śaṃ bhava iti | atra ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyācaṣṭe ṣaḍḍhotā sūryaṃ te cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā | apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ iti paraṃ bhṛtyoranuparehi panthām iti ca | athainamupavātayati śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃ hite ghṛṇiḥ śamu te santvoṣadhīḥ | kalpantāṃ me diśaḥ śagmāḥ iti | athainān pañca carūn sāpūpānupadadhāti apūpavān ghṛtavāṃścarureha sīdatūttabhnuvan pṛthivīṃ dyāmutopari | yonikṛtaḥ pathikṛtaḥ saparyata ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā iha stha eṣā te yamasādane svadhā nidhīyate gṛhe'sau iti yajamānasya nāma gṛhṇāti | daśākṣarā tāṃ rakṣasva tāṃ gopāyasva tāṃ te paridadāmi | tasyāṃ tvāmādabhan pitaro devatā prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayāṅgirasva ddhruvā sīda iti purastādupadadhāti | apūpavāñchṛtavān iti dakṣiṇataḥ apūpavān kṣīravān iti paścāt apūpavān dadhivān ityuttarataḥ apūpavān madhumān iti madhye śatākṣarā sahasrākṣarā iti pratidiśamanuṣajati | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | athainaṃ tilamiśrābhirdhānābhirupakirati etāste svadhā amṛtāḥ karomi iti | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | atha caturaḥ stambānupadadhāti ||2||
carūṇāmupariṣṭāt tvāmarjunauṣadhīnāṃ payo brahmāṇa idviduḥ | tāsāṃ tvā madhyādādade carubhyo api dhātave iti purastād arjunastambaṃ dūrvāṇāṃ stambamāharaitāṃ priyatamāṃ mama | imāṃ diśaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhūyiṣṭhānuvirohatu ityuttarato dūrvāstambaṃ kāśānāṃ stambamāhara rakṣasāmapahatyai | ya etasyai diśaḥ parābhavannaghāyavo yathā te nābhavān punaḥ iti paścāt kāśastambaṃ darbhāṇāṃ stambamāhara pitṛṇāmoṣadhīṃ priyām | anvasyai mūlaṃ jīvādanukāṇḍamatho phalam iti darbhastambaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ | caturṇāṃ stambānām agre madhyaṃ ca carumupadadhāti etaireva caturbhirmantraiḥ | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | atha caturo nānāvṛkṣyān paridhīn paridadhāti mā tvā vṛkṣau saṃbādhiṣṭaṃ mā mātā pṛthivi tvam | vaivasvataṃ hi gacchāsi yamarājye virājasi iti vaitasaśamīmayau purastāccottarataśca | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | atha kleṣīkāvityeke | atha loṣṭānupadadhāti | pṛthivyāstvā loke sādayāmi | prajāpatistvā sādayatu tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda iti śataṃ purastādupadadhāti antarikṣasya tvā loke sādayāmi iti śatamuttarataḥ divastvā loke sādayāmi iti śataṃ paścāt diśāṃ tvā loke sādayāmi iti śataṃ dakṣiṇataḥ nākasya tvā pṛṣṭhe bradhnasya tvā viṣṭape sādayāmi iti dviśataṃ madhye | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasam karoti | atha lokaṃpṛṇā upadadhāti lokaṃ pṛṇacchidraṃ pṛṇa iti lokaṃpṛṇābhiḥ sahasraṃ sampadyate | dviṣāhasrādiṣvetāvadeva punaḥ punarupadadhyāt | kāṭhakāgnicitāvapi pañcāśītiśatamupadadhyāt | vijñāyate agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta maitrāvaruṇyāmikṣayā vā iti kāṭhakāgnīnāṃ brāhmaṇam | tayā devataṃ kṛtvā sūdadohasaṃ karoti | athainamupavātayati śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃ hite ghṛṇiḥ śamu te santvoṣadhīḥ | kalpantāṃ te diśaḥ sarvāḥ iti | athainamabhimṛśati idameva meto'parāmārtimārāmakāñcana | tathā tadaśvibhyāṃ kṛtaṃ mitreṇa varuṇena ca iti | purastād vāraṇaśākhāṃ nidadhāti varaṇo vārayādidaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ ārtyai nirṛtyai dveṣācca vanaspatiḥ iti | uttarataḥ kṣetravitṛṇṇīṃ nidadhāti vidhṛtirasi vidhārayāsmadaghād dveṣām̐si iti | paścācchamīśākhāṃ nidadhāti śami śamayāsmadaghād dveṣām̐si iti | dakṣiṇato yavān nidadhāti yava yavayāsmadaghād dveṣām̐si iti | athainamupatiṣṭhate pṛthivīṃ gacchāntarikṣaṃ gaccha divaṃ gaccha diśo gaccha svargaccha svargaccha diśo gaccha divaṃ gacchāntarikṣaṃ gaccha pṛthivīṃ gacchāpo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ iti | jaghanena citāṃ tisro dakṣiṇāprācīḥ karṣūḥ kurvantīti | tat purastād vyākhyātam | jaghanena karṣūḥ parṇaśākhe nihatyābalena śulbena baddhvā vinisarpantīti | tat purastāt vyākhyātam | yatrāpastadyantyanavekṣamāṇāḥ | apaḥ sacelā dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ samṛttikā āplavante dhātā punātu savitā punātu iti | nāmagrāhaṃ trirudakamutsicyocīryācamyādityamupatiṣṭhate udvayaṃ tamasaspari iti | atha gṛhānāyānti | yaccātra striya āhustatkurvanti | atra śāniṃ kurvanti sautrāmaṇyāḥ pratyāmnāyo bhavatīti | atrāmikṣayā kuryāt | santiṣṭhate loṣṭacitiḥ santiṣṭhate loṣṭacitiḥ ||3||
ekāhaṃdhunuyuḥ athadvābhyāmā tmanyagniṃgṛhṇīte carūṇāmupariṣṭāt trīṇi | ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.9 navamo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha yadi naṣṭāgnirapahṛtāgnirvā yajamānaḥ preyād yadyasya putro vāntevāsī bālaṃkarmaṇyaḥ syāt | prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvoddhatyāvokṣya yajamānāyatane pretaṃ nidhāya gārhapatyasyāyatane araṇīṃ nidhāya pretasya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumanvārabhya manthati ye'syāgnayo juhvato māṃsakāmāḥ saṃkalpayante yajamānaṃ jāyantu te haviṣe svāditāya svargaṃ lokamimaṃ pretaṃ nayantu iti | tūṣṇīṃ vihṛtya dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā puruṣasūktena manasānudrutyāhavanīye juhoti | etenaiva gārhapatye juhoti | tūṣṇīmanvāhāryapacane hutvā ūrdhvaṃ paitṛmedhikaṃ karma pratipadyeta | yatho etatparokṣaṃ pretasya yajamānasyāsthīnyāhṛtya saṃskuryāt | kathamatrāharaṇaṃ vidyata iti | śirastaḥ prathamaṃ gṛhītvāthorasto'tha jaṭharato'thorubāhubhyāmatha patta iti trayastriṃśatamasthīni gṛhṇātīti vijñāyate trayastriṃśat puruṣaḥ iti | athaitānyasthīnyadbhiḥ prakṣālya kaṇyājinaṃ dakṣiṇāgrīvamuttaralomāstīrya tasminnasthīni saṃbharati indro dadhīco asthabhiḥ ityetenānuvākena | tayā devataṃ karoti tayā devatayāṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda iti | atha sūdadohasaṃ karoti tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ | janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvārocane divaḥ iti | dīrghavaṃśe vigrathyākṣāralavaṇāśino mṛṇmayabhājane āharanti | tāni grāmamaryādāyāṃ nidhāyāgnīnāhareyuḥ | yadyatihareyuragnayo laukikāḥ sampadyeran | vijñāyate ca pravasan yajamāno'gnibhyaḥ paridāya gṛhāneti | yato grāmamaryādāṃ nātivrajanti | tasmād grāmamaryādāṃ nātiharet iti ||1||
atha yadyātmani samārūḍheṣvagniṣu araṇyorvā yajamānaḥ preyād yadyasya putro vāntevāsī vālaṃkarmaṇyaḥ syāt | prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvoddhatyāvokṣya yajamānāyatane pretaṃ nidhāya gārhapatyasyāyatane laukikamagnimupasamādhāya pretasya pradakṣiṇaṃ bāhumanvārabhya japati upāvaroha jātaveda imaṃ pretaṃ svargāya lokāya naya prajānan | āyuḥ prajāṃ rayimasmāsu dhehi pretāhutīścāsya juṣasva sarvāḥ iti | api vāraṇyorupāvarohya manthediti | tūṣṇīṃ vihṛtya dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā durgāṃ manasvatīṃ mahāvyāhṛtīrhutvā tadyamo rājā iti dvābhyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā yadyarthino vinderan tebhyo dhenuṃ dadāti | atha parokṣagatapretasya yajamānasya digeva prajñāyate | tāṃ diśaṃ vihāraṃ kalpayitvā asāvehi iti nāmagrāhamāhūya parṇatsarūṇāmeva kṛṣṇāne puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā teṣūpari pātrāṇi citvā kuśataruṇakaiḥ pracchādya prasiddhamupoṣeyuḥ | yadyevaṃ kṛte'gnibhistīrya yajamānaḥ punarāgacchet kathaṃ tatra kuryāditi ||2||
atha yājñikāt kāṣṭhādagniṃ mathitvā agnimupasamādhāya paristīryāgnimukhāt kṛtvā pakvājjuhoti hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre iti dvābhyām | athājyāhutīrupajuhoti sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ ityetenānuvākena svāhākāraiḥ | sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | apareṇāgniṃ sauvarṇena pātreṇa navena vā mṛṇmayena kṛṣṇājinena vā dṛtibhūtena ghṛtenā pābhiḥ pūrayitvā jīvapituścet pitābhimantrayate viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu iti | athainaṃ praveśayati yāṃ pūṣan śivatamāmerayasva iti | sa garbho bhūtvā kṛṣṇājine dṛtibhūte rātriṃ vasati | vyuṣṭāyāṃ jaghanārdhādātmānaṃ pratikṛṣya jāyeta | jātasya jātakarmaprabhṛti saṃskārān kārayitvā daśarātravrataṃ caret | tathaiva jāyayāgnīnādhāya vrātyena paśuneṣṭvā giriṃ gatvāgnaye kāmāyeṣṭiṃ nirvapedāyuṣmatīṃ śatakṛṣṇalām | diśāmaveṣṭyā yajeta | ata ūrdhvaṃ īpsitairyajñakratubhiryajeteti vijñāyate | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sambhūto brāhmaṇastīrṇanirṇayaḥ pratyutthānaṃ na kasyāpi kuryād devasamastu saḥ iti vijñāyate tasmāt proṣite yajamāne caturviṃśativarṣāṇi paripālyāgnihotraṃ saṃskuryāditi sa yadyaśrutaḥ syāt | athāgrayaṇeṣṭipaśucāturmāsyādhvarāṇāmasamāpte vratāntarāle pramīyeta yadyasya putro vāntevāsī vā śeṣāṃścaikatantraṃ samāpnuyāt | yaddaivatyaṃ paśumālabheta taddaivatyaṃ puroḍāśamāmikṣāṃ vā yajeta | atha vai bhavati tamaso vā eṣa tamaḥ praviśati saha tenāhitāgnimanyairagnibhiḥ saṃskuryād iti | athāpyudāharanti śarīradāyādā ha vāpnayo bhavanti iti | maraṇe kṣeyo'sti | ya evaṃ vidvānudagayane pramīyate sauryeṇa pathā svargaṃ lokametyatha yo dakṣiṇe pramīyate cāndramasena pathā pitṛlokameti iti vijñāyate | tā sūryācandramasā viśvabhṛttamā mahad ityāhutībhirevainaṃ rātrāvaparapakṣe dakṣiṇāyanena yadudagayane āpūryamāṇapakṣe divā kratvante śreyo maraṇamityupadiśanti | anyeṣu niyamabhūteṣu satreṣu dīkṣitapramītavadekāhe'hīne ca kuryāditi ||3||
athayadinaṣṭāgniḥ athayadyātmanisamārūḍheṣu athayājñikātkāṣṭāt trīṇi
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne navamo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.10 daśamo'dhyāyaḥ>
atha haike tūṣṇīmitareṣām ityatrodāharanti bhāryāsaṃjñitā nārī puruṣo brāhmaṇasaṃjñakaḥ ta ete hotṛsaṃskārā itare'mantrasaṃskṛtāḥ | iti tānanu vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | anupeta unmatto jalo'ndho mūko badhiraḥ kṛṣṭhī kilāsī kubjaḥ paṅgurhīnāṅgo'dhikāṅgaḥ sahāñjagato brāhmaṇo'nātho rājanyo'nagnirgṛhastho vaiśyasya striyāmutpannaputrāḥ kanyā vidhavā bandhyā ceti | teṣāṃ prāṇeṣūtkānteṣu tūṣṇīṃ snāpayet | śmaśānaṃ nītvā dahanaṃ joṣayedamantreṇa | śākhayā saṃbhṛjya samprakīrya tilataṇḍulān samprakīrya citāṃ kalpayitvā citāyāṃ pretaṃ nidhāyāvyenāsye ninayet idaṃ ta ātmanaḥ śarīram ayaṃ ta ātmā ātmanasta ātmānaṃ śarīrād brahma nirbhinatti bhūrbhuvasvarasau svargāya lokāya svāhā iti | mantreṇa sigvātenopavījayanti | tūṣṇīmudakumbhenāpasavyaṃ pariṣiñcati | uttapanenāgninā saṃyojayet asmāttvamadhijāto'si ayaṃ tvadadhijāyatām | agnaye vaiśvānarāya svargāya lokāya svāhā iti | tīrthe'bhiṣiñcet ||1||
atha garbhiṇyāstaiṣyāṃ kṛtāyām ata ūrdhvaṃ sriyeta bhartā śmaśānaṃ nītvā dahanaṃ joṣayet | citāṃ kalpayitvāpareṇa citāyāḥ pretaṃ nidhāya nābheḥ savyasyopariṣṭād lekhyena hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre ityavalekhanam | kumāraṃ dṛśyamānamanumantrayate jīvatānmama putra iti | atha kumāraṃ snāpayeyuḥ | hiraṇyamantardhāya jīvatā grāmamāyānti | yaste stanaḥ śaśayaḥ iti stanaṃ pradāya tasminnudara ājyāhutīrjuhoti śatāyudhāya śatavīryāya ityetābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ prayāsāya svāhā ityetenānuvākena | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā ityetenānuvākenāvraṇaṃ kuryāt | pretaṃ citāmāropya vidhinā dāhayet | aṣṭakādhenuṃ tiladhenuṃ bhūmidhenuṃ vā dadyāt | atha narāṇāmaśucirbhaved brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ sūtake pretake vānyeṣvaśucirmṛtiḥ pañcagavyena surabhimatyā abliṅgābhirvāruṇībhirhiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhiragnirmūrdhetyāntādanuvākasya śatarudrīyaṃ prokṣayitvā yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā paitṛmedhikakarma pratipadyata iti ||2||
atha gṛhastho bahujāyāṃ vindeta dāsāmanyatamā mriyetāgninaiva paitṛmedhikam karma pratipadyeta | atha ūrdhvaṃ daśarātraṃ vrataṃ caret | adhaḥśayanaṃ brahmacaryam anaṅgaveṣamanaktāśanaṃ nāsapiṇḍānyonyasparśanamanyonyānnabhojanamityevamādi vrataṃ caret | anyeṣvaghāheṣu ca | ekādaśa ekoddiṣṭaṃ kurvanti | itarābhiḥ patnībhiragnimanvādhāya tasmin gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi kriyante | gṛhastho bahujāyāṃ vindedaupāsanaṃ tantraṃ na kṛtvā tasyāṃ vā mriyeta prasiddhaṃ tatra kalpena tantraṃ kṛtvāgninā dāhayet | ata ūrdhvamitarābhiḥ patnībhiragnimanvādhāya tasmin gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi kriyante | tāsāmaparā mriyeta pūrvāgnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya sruksruvaṃ niṣṭapya sammṛjya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā anvārabdhāyāṃ patnyāṃ yajamāno juhoti namastarṣe gada | avyadhāyai tvā svadhāyai tvā | mā na indrābhitastvadṛṣvāriṣṭāsaḥ | evābrahman tavedastu svāhā iti | athainamagniṃ samāropya ayaṃ te yonirṛtviya iti aparāgnau samidhamabhyādadhāti ājuhvānaḥ udbudhyasva iti dvābhyām | samparistīryājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruksruvaṃ niṣṭapya sammṛjya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvānvārabdhapretasya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumanvārabhya juhoti yo brahmā brahmaṇa ujjahāra ityetena sūktena | ekaikaśaścaturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā catuśśarāvamodanaṃ śrapayitvā abhighāryodañcamudvāsyādhiṣṭhitamabhighārayati | paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā pakvājjuhoti samitaṃ saṅkalpethām iti puronuvākyāmanūcya agne purīṣyādhipā bhavā tvanna iti yājyayā juhoti | śvabhre kāṣṭhe'thājyāhutīrupajuhoti purīṣyastvamagna ityāntānanuvākasya | sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | gurave gāṃ dadāti | vidhinā dāhayet | daśarātrādata ūrdhvaṃ itarābhiḥ patnībhiragnimanvādhāya tasmin gṛhyāṇi kriyante ||3||
praṇamya vandanaṃ kāyaiḥ sadākhyaṃ parameśvaram patīnāṃ pretasaṃskāravidhiṃ vakṣye viśeṣataḥ vipro gṛhasthaḥ śuddhātmā yatisaṃskāramācaret śikye śarīramāropya gandhamālyairalaṅkṛtam tuṣāgnimatra codvāsya saṃskartānuharedyatim ghoṣitaṃ jayaśabdena dundubhīnāṃ ravairapi prācīmudīcīṃ vā gatvā śuddhaṃ deśaṃ samāśrayet khātvā vyāhṛtibhirdeśaṃ daṇḍāyāmapramāṇakam saptavyāhṛtibhiḥ prokṣya tatra dārucitiṃ kriyāt yājñikaistu yathāśakti kāṣṭhairanyairathāpi vā tataḥ śarīraṃ prakṣipya sāvitryā śuddhamānasaḥ viṣṇo ivyaṃ rakṣasveti havistasyāṃ nidhāpayet pavitraṃ teti mantreṇa pavitraṃ sthāpayenmukhe tridaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇe pāṇāvidaṃviṣṇvādinā nyaset savye śikyaṃ yadasyeti svāhāntena nidhāpayet sāvitryā tūdare pātraṃ guhyasthāne kamaṇḍalum bhūmirbhūmnā mamāgneti sthāpayet kaupanaṃ tataḥ adhyena kṣiptasarvasādhanasaṃyutam śarīraraṃ hotṛbhiḥ kartā sagrahairupatiṣṭhate tuṣāgninā dahed dehaṃ yātavātaha saha bhaviṣyati athāpyudāharantyeyaṃ vedārthanipuṇā budhāḥ viṣekādiśmaśānāntā vidhayo brāhmaṇāśrayāḥ tasmin yateśca saṃskāraṃ mantravat kurute gṛhī ātmanyagniṃ samāropya yaḥ pretamavadahyati tasya putro vidhānena hyavaropyāgninā dahet api hotṛvidhānena gāyatryā praṇavena ca sannikṛṣṭe tu saṃnyaste pitaryuparate sutaḥ dahanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍodakakriyā ādāveva vikalpena brahmacārī yatirbhavet tatra śrāddhaṃ gṛhasthasya kartavyaṃ sannidhau bhavet yatiṃ vahan dahan sparśan snānamātreṇa śudhyati aśvamedhaphalaṃ sarve prāpnuvanti pṛthak sutaiḥ karmaniṣṭe tu saṃnyaste pitaryuparate'sya taiḥ dāhastasya na kartavyaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍodakakriyā sarvasaṅganivṛttasya dhyānayogaratasya ca na tasya dahanaṃ kāryaṃ nāśaucaṃ nodakaṃ tataḥ ||4||
athātaḥ punaḥsaṃskāraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | trīṇi ṣaṣṭiśatāni palāśavṛntānāṃ taiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā yadi śarīraṃ naśyeyuḥ punaḥ saṃskāraṃ kurvanti | aharaharañjalinaikottaravṛddhirā tryahāt tasyāgnibhirdaheyuḥ iti vijñāyate | palāśavalkaiḥ kuśairvā sandhiṣu saṃveṣṭayati | catvāriṃśatā śiraḥ daśabhirgrīvāṃ viṃśatyorastriṃśatodaraṃ pañcāśatā pañcāśataikaikaṃ bāhuṃ teṣāmeva pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiraṅgulīrupakalpayate | saptatyā saptatyaikaikaṃ pādaṃ teṣāmeva pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiraṅgulīrupakalpayate | aṣṭābhiḥ śiśnaṃ dvādaśabhirvṛṣaṇam | tān snāpayitvālaṅkṛtya ahatena vāsasā pracchādyāntarvedyāṃ nidhāya bāndhavāḥ paryupaviśyābhimantrayante yamasyāsau yamasya sa ime yamagnaya iti | etadādikarma pratipadyante ||5||
athahaiketūṣṇīm athagarbhiṇyāstaiṣyāṃkṛtāyām athagṛhasthobahuvāyāṃvindeta praṇamya vandanaṃ athātaḥpunaḥsaṃskāraṃ pañca |
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.11 ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ>
athāto mṛtabaliṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayitvā snātvodakaṃ kriyeta | prāgdakṣiṇāyatane caturaśraṃ gomayenopalipya triraśmānaṃ madhye nidhāya sakṛdullikhyādbhirabhyukṣya dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān saṃstīrya sakṛttilamiśraṃ carumavadyati muṣṭipramāṇaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ vā | prakīrṇakeśaḥ savyaṃ jānuṃ bhūmau nidhāyāśmani piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | etatte'muṣmai piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | āñjanābhyañjane vāsaśca dadyāt | pātreṇodakaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ ninayet | atra pretāḥ kākādabhiharanti | evaṃ sāyaṃprātaḥ kṛtvā daśamyāṃ vikṛtāhāraṃ sāyaṃ baliṃ dattvāvyuṣṭakāle upaninīya brāhmaṇān hīnāṅgānatiriktāṅgān kuṣṭhīn kunasvīn śyāvadantān rogīn vṛṣalīpatīn unmattān pāpīn varjayitvā śucīn śrotriyān suvṛttān adhyayanasampannān gṛhasthān daridrān kriyāpūrvān pātrabhūtān sadyo'dhigamyān asagotrasambandhayuktān āyantrya karmasu vyākhyātān etatte pitā samanaso yat kiñcit pretāyānumataḥ śvobhūte me piturekoddiṣṭaśrāddhaṃ bhuñjatāṃ bhavanta iti | bhujyate iti prativacanam ||1||
ekādaśyāmekoddiṣṭaṃ kurvanti | avyuṣṭe kāle brāhmaiṇamāhūya kiñciddattvā nivedyānumantrayate śvobhūte'nnaṃ saṃskṛtya luptaśmaśrulomanakhāya brāhmaṇāya dantakāṣṭhaṃ dattvā dhanadhānyapātraṃ saṃspṛṣṭvā deśe pātrāṇītyādi dattvā brāhmaṇamudaṅmukhamupaveśayet | tilamiśreṇodakārthaṃ dadyādanyatra prācamanāt | ekapavitrāntarhite pātre'pa ānīya pavitreṇotpūya tilānopya darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhairapidadhāti | brāhmaṇāya gandhādi dattvā piṇḍaṃ nivapāmi ityāha | piṇḍaṃ nivapa iti prativacanam | atha darbheṣu piṇḍaṃ nidadhyāt ayamodanaḥ kāmadugho'stvananto'kṣīyamāṇaḥ surabhiḥ sarvakāmaiḥ | sa tvopatiṣṭhatvajaro nityabhūtaḥ svadhāṃ duhānāmamṛtāṃstarpayantvasau iti | ekaṃ piṇḍaṃ dattvā tilodakaiḥ prasavyaṃ pariṣiñcati ūrjasvatīḥ svadhayā vandamānāstāste śrayantīḥ syonā ūrjaṃ vahantīḥ svadhāmakṣitodakāḥ kṣīramudakaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutam iti | añjanādinā piṇḍamalaṅkṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ sampūjyāṅguṣṭhamūlamupasaṃgṛhya bhuṅkṣva ityāha bhujyata ityuktvā atha bhuñjāne sarveṣāmucchiṣṭaṃ nidhāyācānte barhīṣyavakīrya nyubjapātraṃ svaditam iti brāhmaṇo brūyāt | atha pavitraṃ nidhāyānyubjetanapramāṇa svadhāstvityuñcaiḥ ityuktvā astu svadhā iti prativacanam | yajñopavītyavokṣya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvotthāpya annaśeṣaiḥ kiṃ kriyatām ityāha | iṣṭaiḥ sahopabhujyatām iti prativacanam | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pratyetya piṇḍaṃ tyājyāpsu snātvā devāgāraṃ praviśya adakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvāñjaliṃ kṛtvālaṅkṛtya gṛhānetya puṇyāhādīni vācayitvā annaśeṣaṃ sagaṇaḥ prāśnāti | paśyati putraṃ paśyati pautraṃ na ca śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ jāyata iti kuśahārītaḥ ||2||
saṃvatsare sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt | prācīnāvītyagnimupasamādhāya dakṣiṇāprāgagrairdarbhaiḥ paristīrya teṣu catvāryudapātrāṇi nidhāya ekapavitreṇa prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣya teṣāmekaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ pretapātraṃ nidhāyārdhodakapātramānīya pavitreṇotpūya tilānopya darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhairapidadhāti | itareṣu triṣvapa ānayati ūrjasvatīḥ svadhayā vandamānā iti | dakṣiṇa āñjanābhyañjanamudakumbhaṃ nidhāya dakṣiṇato brāhmaṇān suprakṣālitapāṇipādān darbheṣvāsaneṣu viśvān devān prāṅmukhānupaveśya itarānudaṅmukhānupaveśya prāpnotu bhavān ityāha prāpnavāni itītare pratyāhuḥ | tebhyo dhūpadīpavarjaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tato'pasavyaṃ pariṣiñcati | audumbaramidhmamabhyādhāyaudumbaryā darvyā juhoti | homārheṇājyena somāya pitṛmata ityādiṣaḍbhirmantrairhutvātha nāmadheyairjuhoti amuṣmai svadhā namo'muṣmai svadhā nama ityaṣṭābāhutayaḥ | etā aṣṭau juhoti | evamannasya hutvā agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namaḥ svāhā iti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe hutvānuprahṛtya darvīmapasavyaṃ pariṣicya dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣvekaṃ pretapiṇḍaṃ nidadhyāt ayamodanaḥ kāmadugha iti | ūrjasvatīḥ svadhayā vandamānā iti tilodakairapasavyaṃ pariṣicya piṇḍāvṛtaitān piṇḍān dattvā śraddhābhimarśanenābhimṛśyaitena brāhmaṇān vidyāvataḥ pariviśati bhuṅkṣveti | bhuñjānān samīkṣate prāṇe niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi brahmaṇi ma ātmāmṛtatvāya iti | pitṛliṅgaiḥ ṛgyajurbhiḥ śrāvayet | ācāntebhyastilodakaṃ pradāya svadhāstu iti vācayitvā astu svadhā iti prativacanam | yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tataḥ pretapātraṃ pitṛpātreṣu ninayet samānī ca ākūtiḥ ityāvartya | tataḥ pretapiṇḍaṃ pitṛpiṇḍeṣu nidadhyāt saṃgacchadhvaṃ saṃvadadhvaṃ samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ iti dvābhyām | tānupatiṣṭhate ye samānāḥ ye sajātāḥ iti dvābhyām | atra paitṛkamanuvākaṃ japati uśantastvā havāmaha iti | ūrdhvaṃ pituḥ kriyā syāt | sarvataḥ śeṣaṃ samavadāyāśnīyāt | siddhametat sapiṇḍīkaraṇam ||3||
athāto nārāyaṇabliṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | dakṣiṇottarāyaṇe'parapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ kriyeta | śrutavṛttasampannān dvādaśa ṣaḍvā brāhmaṇānāmantrayate | devagṛhe nadītīre vātha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā upotthāyāgreṇāgniṃ devamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhuvaḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi oṃ svaḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ puruṣamāvāhayāmi om ityāvāhya paridhānaprabhṛtyāgnimukhāt kṛtvā daivatamarcayitvā āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuva iti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena mārjayitvā sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa ityetenānuvākenākṣatagandhapuṣpadhūpadīpairaṣṭākṣareṇa vā dadyāt | paścimāṃ diśamupaveśya pradhānāhutīrjuhoti viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pravocam iti puronuvākyāmanūcya paro mātrayā iti yājyayā juhoti | athājyāhutīrupajuhoti keśavāya svāhā iti dvādaśa sruvāhutīḥ | gulapāyasaṃ ghṛtamiśraṃ devasya tvā iti mahāviṣṇave havirnivedayati | keśavāya iti dvādaśabhirnamaskārairbrāhmaṇānāhūya sadarbhopakḷpteṣvāsaneṣu udaṅmukhānupaveśya vāso'ṅgulīyaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | trivṛtānnena brāhmaṇān paritoṣayati | svasti vācayitvānujñāpya vācaṃ yacchet | ājyaṃ tilaṃ haviḥ samudāyutyeḍāpātramānīya hastena juhuyāt pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātṛbhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | pitāmahībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | prapitāmahībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātuḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātuḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātāmahībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātuḥ pitāmahībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | mātuḥ prapitāmahībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | ācāryebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | ācāryapatnībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | gurubhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | gurupatnībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | sakhibhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | sakhipatnībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | jñātibhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | jñātipatnībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | amātyebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | amātyapatnībhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | sarvebhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | sarvābhyaḥ svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā | agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namo viṣṇave svāhā iti | sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāt | dakṣiṇenāgniṃ dakṣiṇāgrān darbhān saṃstīrya teṣu baliṃ dadāti viśvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ sādhyebhyo devebhyo namaḥ sarvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ sarvābhyo devatābhyo namaḥ asāvidaṃ te namo brāhmaṇebhyo namaḥ namo brahmapriyāya namaḥ | yastu sarvān samadhigacchati pitṛbhyo nārāyaṇāya baliṃ dadāti | uparyuktaṃ pretavidhānam | evameva śastraviparajjujaladarvīkaramārutatarupāṣāṇocchāsanādiṣvātmanihatasya vā gobrāhmaṇavidhavāpatiteṣvāpatitasya vā śarīrasaṃskārān varjayet | deśāntaramṛte saṃgrāmahate vyāghrahate śarīramānīya vidhinā dāhayet | yadyekāṅgaṃ darśayed dviraṅgaṃ vā pṛthivīṃ śarīraṃ saktvārdhayitaḥ kuryāt | madhusarpiṣābhyajya vidhinā dāhayet | atha yadi jīvet punarāgacchediti ||4||
athātomṛtabalim ekādaśyāmekoddiṣṭaṃkurvanti saṃvatsaresapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt athātonārāyaṇabaliṃ catvāri
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
<3.12 dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ>
bhuktvā śrāddhaṃ tato vidvān yathāśāstramagarhitam chardayettu tataḥ samyak kuśavārijalaṃ pibet punarjalāśaye snātvā mānastokaṛcaṃ japet gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā prāṇāyāmāṃstu ṣoḍaśa bhuktaṃ cenmāsikaśrāddhaṃ prājāpatyena śudhyati aṣṭakāṃ hi tato bhuktvā pūrvokena viśudhyati ekoddiṣṭaṃ tato bhuktvā tatra cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret atikṛcchraṃ cared vidvān bhuktvā nakṣatrabhojanam kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ ṣaṇmāse tripakṣe taptameva ca tathā saṃvatsare śrāddhe sapiṇḍe tu tathaiva ca baliṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhuktvā kṛcchramekaṃ cared budhaḥ aśaktau tu tathā sarvaṃ kṛcchramekaṃ cared budhaḥ athavāpi trirātraṃ syādekāhaṃ vāpi durbalam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrāddhagehaṃ na gacchati dātāraṃ tārayet pakvāt tvāmadātā tu granthinam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena āmaśrāddhaṃ pratigrahet sarvāṇyādāya dravyāṇi nayed brāhmaṇasannidhau sarvāṇīmāni gṛhṇīṣva me pituḥ puṣṭikāṅkṣayā bhagavannanugṛhṇīṣva piṇḍaṃ deyaṃ hi madgṛhe nivapet piṇḍamityuktvā nivapeyamitītaraḥ brāhmaṇenābhyanujñāto gatvā tu svagṛhaṃ prati dattvā piṇḍaṃ yathāśāstramudakasyāñjaliṃ tathā svadhāmādāya tad gatvā brāhmaṇasyāñjalau nayet svadhāstviti tataḥ paścāt svadhā māstvādinābravīt evamukte tato dattvā dakṣiṇāṃ brāhmaṇasya tu pradakṣiṇaṃ hi kṛtvā tu kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ tathā dravyapradānāt pūrvaṃ hi hutvā homaṃ yathāvidhi svagṛhaṃ prāpya tad gatvā sapiṇḍaiḥ saha bhojayet ||1||
atha sarvaprāyaścittāni juhoti | palāśaśakalamaudumbaraśakalaṃ vānyāni yājñikaśakalāni vāṣṭau gṛhṇīyāt | pañca mahāyajñān kṛtvāgniṃ paristīryājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya samantaṃ pariṣecanaṃ karoti | purastādopariṣṭāśca vyāhṛtibhirvihṛtābhiḥ samastābhiśca hutvā śakalānājyenābhyajya ekaikaśo juhuyāt devakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | manuṣyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | pitṛkṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | ātmakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | anyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | yaddivā ca naktaṃ cainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | yadvidvām̐saścāvidvām̐saścainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | yatsvapantaśca jāgrataścainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | enasa enaso'vayajanamasi svāhā iti | tathaiva pariṣicya evamevāharahaḥ sāyaṃ prātaḥ śakalahomaṃ hutvā sarvasmāt kilbiṣāt pūto bhavati sarvasmāt kilbiṣāt pūto bhavatītyāha bhagavānāgniveśyaḥ ||2||
bhuktvāśrāddham athasarvaprāyaścittāni dve
ityāgniveśyagṛhyasūtre tṛtīyapraśne dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
tṛtīyaḥ praśnaḥ samāptaḥ samāptaṃ
cāgniveśyagṛhyasūtram śubhaṃ bhūyāt
